Please note: This role is not with Zendrop, but with our parent company, Zenpire. You can learn more about Zenpire on their website:

About Zenpire:

Zenpire (formerly StayTuned Digital) is building the modern commerce stack for eCommerce brands.

We acquire and scale high-impact apps that help merchants grow faster across acquisition, conversion, fulfillment, and retention. By integrating AI into our products and operations, we give founders smarter tools to automate workflows, increase revenue, and compete at scale.

Our portfolio powers thousands of merchants and processes millions of orders every month.

Our guiding principles:

  • You are a builder. Whatever your role, you’re building something. When you see a way to make it better, act.
  • Build, learn, repeat. Ship fast, learn from real results, and iterate.
  • Outcomes over output. Measure success by impact not activity.
  • Play to win. Operate with urgency and treat the company's outcomes as your own.
  • Win together, fail alone. Work as a team, challenge constructively, and support shared decisions.

We’re looking for a highly product-driven Product Manager to lead the strategy, execution, and growth of commerce apps and product features from concept to launch and beyond.

This role is ideal for someone with experience working on Shopify or other e-commerce platforms, or commerce-focused software such as payments, subscriptions, loyalty, CRM, fulfillment, or inventory, or experience founding, building, or scaling Shopify apps or other commerce-related products.

This role requires someone who can take full responsibility over a product roadmap, including day-to-day operations, project execution, prioritization, and risk management.

From conception to launch and beyond, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally and communicate with senior leadership while owning the narrative and execution for your product area.

We care deeply about builders who combine product intuition, execution speed, customer empathy, and commercial thinking — especially people excited about using AI-native workflows to build better products faster.

Location:

This role is fully remote and open to candidates based in Europe. LinkedIn makes us pick one country, so Spain is listed, but you don’t need to live there. We’re not able to consider candidates based in the US for this role. Our team works across US time zones, so you’ll need at least 5 hours of overlap with US working hours.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the full product lifecycle from ideation and validation to launch, growth, optimization, and maintenance
  • Define and manage the product roadmap, priorities, timelines, and execution aligned with company objectives
  • Partner closely with Engineering and collaborate across Marketing, Customer Success, and Leadership to ensure effective product delivery
  • Define and measure success metrics, goals, and KPIs to maximize business impact
  • Drive decisions through data analysis, market research, customer feedback, and company strategy
  • Monitor product performance closely and continuously improve key metrics such as activation, conversion, engagement, and revenue
  • Translate complex merchant problems into simple, intuitive user experiences and lead product development from concept to launch
  • Communicate product vision, priorities, and outcomes clearly while proactively identifying and solving execution risks
  • Completely own your product area and act as the go-to person for your features

Required Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager working on Shopify or other e-commerce platforms, or commerce-focused software such as payments, subscriptions, loyalty, CRM, fulfillment, or inventory
    OR
  • Experience founding, building, or scaling Shopify apps or other commerce-related products

Core Requirements:

  • Product-minded thinker who focuses on business outcomes and measurable impact — not just shipping features
  • Experience owning product strategy, roadmap, execution, and delivery
  • Strong analytical acumen and business sense with an ROI-driven approach to prioritization
  • Strong understanding of UX/UI principles and the ability to build intuitive, user-friendly experiences
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage priorities and drive cross-functional execution
  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate product development and prototyping (Claude, Cursor, AI coding agents, etc.) and leveraging them to amplify existing product skills and workflows
  • Experience conducting customer research, usability testing, and translating insights into product improvements
  • Experience working in agile environments with an iterative approach to building, testing, learning, and shipping
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with high ownership and bias toward action
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in SaaS, ecommerce, or B2B products
  • Familiarity with Shopify APIs, themes, app architecture, and the Shopify ecosystem
  • Experience working closely with growth, lifecycle, or monetization teams
  • Technical understanding of modern product development workflows

What Success Looks Like:

  • Shipping high-impact features that improve key business and customer metrics
  • Building scalable product experiences merchants genuinely love using
  • Creating clarity and momentum across teams
  • Continuously improving product quality, usability, and performance through iteration and data

The Interview Process:

1️⃣ Intro conversation with our HR Manager

2️⃣ Conversation with our Product Manager

3️⃣ Short take home assignment, followed by a walkthrough with our COO

4️⃣ Conversation with our CEO and Co-Founder

Please Note: All employment offers at Zenpire are subject to verification steps completed prior to the candidate's start date. For W2 employees, this includes a thorough background check and employment verification. For 1099 contractor roles, this includes live identity verification and employment verification.

For all roles at Zenpire, regardless of job classification (W2 employee or contractor) or work arrangement (fully remote or hybrid/onsite), the final stage of our interview process includes an in-person interview with our team. Due to the rise of AI-assisted interviews and identity fraud in remote hiring, this is a standard step in our process. For US-based candidates, this will take place at one of our office locations or a convenient hub. For international candidates, we will coordinate with a local team member in your region. All travel will be arranged and covered by Zenpire.

At this time, we are unable to sponsor visas for candidates based in the US.

Our hiring team may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist with certain stages of the hiring process, including reviewing applications, evaluating resumes, and assessing candidate responses. These tools are intended to support our recruitment process and are not a substitute for human judgment. All final hiring decisions are made by people.

jobs.description:
Wholesale Sales & Account Manager

Location: Woodstock, GA (Primarily Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

A growing consumer products company is seeking an experienced Wholesale Sales & Account Manager to drive sales, develop new retail partnerships, and grow its wholesale business across two unique brands.

This is an opportunity for a relationship-driven sales professional who understands the boutique and specialty retail market and knows how to turn product interest into orders, build lasting retailer relationships, and generate repeat business.

The role supports two brands: an established luxury accessories brand specializing in authenticated vintage handbags and accessories, sold through boutiques, gift shops, resorts, and specialty retailers; and an emerging faith-forward wellness brand preparing to expand into the wholesale market.

The ideal candidate has experience representing consumer products to retailers, presenting collections, developing new accounts, and managing the full wholesale sales cycle. You'll have the opportunity to leverage existing relationships while identifying new markets, opening doors with prospective retailers, and helping grow both brands.

Key Responsibilities

Wholesale Sales & New Business Development

  • Identify, prospect, and develop new wholesale accounts with boutiques, gift shops, specialty retailers, resorts, and other relevant retail partners.
  • Build relationships with boutique owners, retail buyers, and purchasing decision-makers.
  • Proactively reach out to prospective accounts through phone, email, social media, industry connections, and wholesale platforms.
  • Present products, collections, and brand offerings to prospective retailers and secure new orders.
  • Follow up on sales opportunities, maintain an active pipeline, and move prospects through the buying process.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce existing retail partners to additional products and complementary brands.

Wholesale Account Management & Growth

  • Manage and grow an assigned portfolio of wholesale accounts, taking ownership of ongoing retailer relationships.
  • Develop strategies to increase order frequency, average order size, and overall account revenue.
  • Build repeat business by consistently following up with customers, identifying reorder opportunities, and introducing new products and collections.
  • Re-engage inactive accounts and turn first-time buyers into long-term wholesale partners.
  • Understand individual retailer needs, buying cycles, product preferences, and customer demographics to recommend relevant products.
  • Maintain regular communication with accounts before and after orders to strengthen relationships and encourage continued business.

Trade Shows, Markets & Product Representation

  • Represent the brands at major wholesale markets, trade shows, and industry events.
  • Schedule and conduct appointments with current and prospective retail buyers.
  • Present product collections, communicate brand value, and develop new sales opportunities.
  • Follow up with leads and buyers after events to convert interest into wholesale orders.
  • Help prepare for markets and coordinate outreach to existing and prospective accounts.

Sales Operations & Account Coordination

  • Maintain organized records of customer interactions, sales opportunities, orders, and follow-up activities.
  • Track account performance, outreach, new business development, and reorder activity.
  • Utilize Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and other wholesale platforms to manage customer relationships and sales activity.
  • Coordinate with internal operations and fulfillment teams to ensure a smooth customer experience.
  • Assist wholesale customers with order questions, shipping updates, and product information as needed.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded wholesale sales professional who enjoys building relationships, developing business, and taking ownership of sales results.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of direct wholesale sales, B2B sales, or wholesale account management experience.
  • Experience selling consumer products to boutiques, independent retailers, gift shops, apparel stores, or specialty retailers.
  • Demonstrated success developing new business, securing orders, and growing existing customer accounts.
  • Experience working directly with retail buyers, boutique owners, or purchasing decision-makers.
  • Comfortable with outbound prospecting, product presentations, sales conversations, and consistent follow-up.
  • Strong understanding of repeat business, account development, and the wholesale buying cycle.
  • Self-motivated and able to independently manage a sales pipeline and portfolio of accounts.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and organizational skills.

Preferred Experience:

  • Background in women's apparel, accessories, handbags, jewelry, beauty, gifts, or lifestyle products.
  • Experience representing multiple brands or product collections.
  • Previous showroom sales, territory sales, or national wholesale sales experience.
  • Experience attending wholesale markets, trade shows, or buyer appointments.
  • Familiarity with Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and online wholesale platforms.
  • Remote Work Experience: Previous experience working remotely and the ability to work independently, stay organized, and manage daily responsibilities with minimal supervision.
  • Technology Requirements: Must have a reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional workspace suitable for virtual meetings, customer communication, and daily sales activities.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position open to qualified candidates nationwide. The ideal candidate will have prior remote work experience and be comfortable working independently, managing their schedule, and maintaining consistent communication with the team.

Sales and account management activities will be conducted remotely through phone, email, virtual presentations, wholesale platforms, and other sales tools. Occasional in-person meetings and trade show participation may be required.

This is not a daily road-sales position, but it does require proactive outreach, new business development, and the ability to confidently sell products, manage wholesale relationships, and grow accounts.

Why This Role Matters

The company has an established wholesale customer base and significant opportunity to expand its retail presence. There is an opportunity to develop new wholesale partnerships, reactivate existing accounts, increase repeat purchasing, and introduce an emerging brand to an established network of retailers.

The person in this role will have a direct impact on wholesale revenue and brand growth. Success will be measured by the ability to:

  • Develop and secure new wholesale accounts.
  • Grow revenue across existing customer relationships.
  • Increase reorder frequency and average order size.
  • Reactivate inactive accounts and generate repeat business.
  • Build a strong network of retail partners.
  • Support the wholesale expansion of an emerging consumer brand.

Target Start Date: December 2026, with the goal of being fully prepared for the January wholesale market.

Salary: $50,000 – $60,000 / year

The Development Operations Associate is a high-impact role that keeps WomenHeart’s fundraising operations accurate, organized, and on schedule. Supporting Development team leadership, including the Sr. Director, Fundraising & Development, and the Sr. Director, Corporate Relations, this position manages gift processing and donor records, supports stewardship and funder submissions across a portfolio of individual donors, corporate sponsorships, and grants, and provides the administrative and event support that helps the team meet its fundraising goals.

Duties & Responsibilities:
Donor Relations & Stewardship
  • Process all gifts in a timely and accurate manner, including entry into the CRM.
  • Generate and send donor acknowledgements and stewardship mailings, ensuring they are personalized, accurate, and aligned with WomenHeart messaging.
  • Maintain clean and up-to-date donor records, including contact information, giving history, outreach touchpoints, and stewardship activity.
  • Support donor moves management, tracking portfolio progress, flagging next steps, and updating records to advance donor relationships.
  • Support donor segmentation, reporting, and list pulls for campaigns and outreach.
  • Track pledges, payments, sponsorship commitments, and campaign progress.
  • Support development of proposals, sponsorship decks, and briefing materials for donor meetings and partnership outreach.
  • Conduct research to support fundraising strategies and donor engagement initiatives.
Grants, Sponsorships & Funder Submissions
  • Manage submission workflows for grants and funder proposals, whether developed proactively by the team or prepared in response to funder requests, including entering applications into funder portals, tracking deadlines, and maintaining a submission calendar.
  • Monitor reporting requirements and deliverable deadlines for active grants and sponsorship agreements, ensuring timely and accurate follow-through.
  • Track sponsorship benefits and fulfillment for corporate partners, coordinating with Corporate Relations, Communications, and event staff to deliver on commitments.
  • Maintain organized records of proposals, grants, and sponsorship agreements in the CRM, including submission history, outcomes, and follow-up notes.
Team & Administrative Support
  • Manage scheduling and calendar coordination for the Development team including internal meetings and external stakeholder appointments.
  • Prepare and distribute materials for Development team meetings, including agendas, pre-reads, and follow-up notes.
  • Support Development team leadership on special projects, presentations, and correspondence.
Event Support
  • Provide administrative and logistical support for fundraising and cultivation events.
  • Manage guest tracking, RSVP management, and follow-up communications to ensure a seamless guest experience.
  • Support coordination with event vendors, sponsors, and partners.
CRM, Data & Systems
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in the CRM system (Salesforce, Raiser's Edge, EveryAction, Virtuous, or similar).
  • Generate reports, dashboards, and donor lists to support stewardship, fundraising, and development tracking.
  • Take initiative in improving systems and workflows, contributing to a more organized and efficient team environment.
  • Help manage competing priorities and ensure the team is prepared and organized for upcoming work.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal degree requirements.
  • 1–3 years of experience in nonprofit development or fundraising operations, ideally across individual giving, corporate sponsorships, and grants.
  • Hands-on experience processing gifts, generating donor acknowledgments, and reconciling gift records with finance.
  • Experience supporting stewardship strategies, including tracking, follow-through, and operationalizing engagement plans.
  • Experience coordinating team calendars, meetings, and event logistics.
  • CRM/database experience (EveryAction, Salesforce, Raiser’s Edge, or similar).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience supporting donor engagement, development operations, or event coordination.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems, including data imports and funder or grant portal management.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management tools.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

With a staff that cares deeply about health equity and the women we serve, we believe diverse perspectives and backgrounds create a strong work environment and enhance our ability to pursue our mission. We value diverse experiences and know that the right candidate may not check every box. If you believe you would excel in this role and have a passion for public health and women’s health, we strongly encourage you to apply.

We are committed to building an organization that is intentional about inclusion in how we show up for women living with heart disease and in how we show up for one another. We hope you will join us as we continue to build a people-centered organization where individuals from all backgrounds are welcomed and valued.

Today, we're looking for a Growth Manager, Marketing & Sales to join our team. Our new Growth Manager will be the first conversation many senior marketing leaders have with Silverback, and the person who helps turn those conversations into clients. You'll work on new business from first touch to signed contract: qualifying inbound leads, building the pitches and proposals that win the work, keeping prospects engaged until they're ready to buy, and supporting the marketing programs that bring the next ones in.

This isn't an account management role. Once a client signs, our account teams own the relationship and the day-to-day work, so you stay focused on winning the next one. It's also not a cold-calling job: you'll work inbound leads that come from our marketing, referrals and thought leadership. You don't need formal sales training. You'll learn our methodology and sales process on live deals alongside our Chief Revenue Officer, then take on more of the pitching yourself over time. This role is ideal for a marketer who's comfortable in front of a CMO, picks up new frameworks fast, and wants to see their work show up as new revenue.

Here's what we expect from our Growth Manager, Marketing & Sales.

—What You'll Do—

  • Lead Qualification & Discovery: Be the first point of contact for every inbound lead. Research each company, judge how well it fits the clients we serve best, and run intro and discovery calls to find the opportunities worth pursuing.

  • Qualification Automation: Use HubSpot and AI tools like Claude to automate how leads are routed, researched, scored and followed up with, so we respond faster and more accurately as volume grows.

  • Sales Materials: Build the decks, audits, proposals and contracts that win new business. Partner with experts across our Paid Media, SEO, Measurement and Creative teams to tell a story that speaks to each buyer's goals.

  • Pitching & Opportunity Management: Start by supporting pitches alongside our Chief Revenue Officer, then grow into leading them yourself: presenting our approach, managing deals from first call to signed contract, and bringing in the right Silverback experts along the way.

  • Pipeline Management: Own HubSpot as our record of every lead, contact and deal. Keep it current so our forecasts are reliable and every lead gets the right follow-up.

  • Prospect Nurture: Segment our HubSpot contacts by engagement, fit and readiness to buy, then build and run email programs that keep Silverback top of mind with prospects who aren't ready yet and past opportunities worth reopening.

  • Gifting & Customer Marketing: Run and grow our client and prospect gifting program around personal and professional milestones, and expand it into a broader customer marketing program that drives referrals, repeat business and growth with existing clients.

—What We're Looking For—

  • Years of Experience: 4-6 years in marketing, account management or growth roles, ideally at a digital marketing agency or professional services firm.

  • Executive Presence: You're comfortable leading a conversation with a VP, CMO or CEO. You listen well, ask sharp questions and hold the room.

  • Sales Acumen: You know how to uncover what a prospect needs, handle objections and move a decision forward. Experience as an account executive is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Marketing Fluency: You have a background in paid media, SEO or measurement, so our methodology clicks quickly and you can speak credibly about what drives results.

  • Writing: You write and edit cleanly and pick up a brand voice fast. You can take a rough draft and make it sound like a person wrote it.

  • Frameworks in Plain Language: You pick up a framework quickly and can explain it to a buyer in plain English.

  • CRM & Automation: You have hands-on HubSpot experience. You keep records clean, segment lists by engagement and fit, and build workflows. You're curious about using AI to take manual work out of the process.

  • Ownership: You don't need a perfect playbook. You can be handed a problem or goal, and you run with it.

—Why Silverback?—

    Silverback isn't for everybody. If you're an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you're a B player, you will be miserable.

  • Make an impact: We're a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.

  • Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.

  • Do cool shit: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

  • Virtual Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture

  • Company-paid ClassPass membership

  • 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Summer Fridays

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

—Work Environment—

  • We're a fully remote agency with employees working across the continental United States. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication.

  • Travel is light: an occasional in-person pitch when the opportunity calls for it.

  • We at Silverback pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly "work hard, play hard" mentality.

jobs.description:
Description

Are you looking to make a difference in patients’ lives with a company that values your expertise? Join us in our mission of delivering compassionate healthcare where it matters most –– at home.

Pinnacle Home Care Holdings, LLC ("Pinnacle") is a leading Florida-based provider of home healthcare services. We're seeking an experienced Clinical Review Specialist to join our growing team and ensure every patient's care plan starts with clinical excellence, regulatory compliance, and a compassionate touch.

*** SCHEDULE*** Saturday and Sunday, 8:00 AM–6:30 PM, plus two additional weekdays (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday), based on organizational needs. All hours are Eastern Time (ET).

Key Responsibilities

  • Review all incoming home health orders for clinical appropriateness.
  • Determine appropriate disciplines, frequencies, and visit types in line with agency protocols and referral source requirements.
  • Confirm compliance with CMS guidelines, Medicare Conditions of Participation (COPs), and internal agency standards.
  • Take and document verbal orders from physicians and referral sources accurately and efficiently.
  • Perform patient welcome calls to ensure a smooth, positive onboarding experience.
  • Triage and troubleshoot patient needs or concerns during intake conversations.
  • Maintain a warm, empathetic, and professional phone presence to reassure patients and referral partners.
  • Accurately document all intake and order-related activities in the EMR (WellSky or similar).
  • Ensure physician orders, care plans, and required documentation are completed, accurate, and properly uploaded.
  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of home health regulatory requirements, including Medicare, CMS, and state guidelines.
  • Proficient in EMR data entry (WellSky training provided).
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Outlook, Teams, and internal reporting tools.
  • Follow daily reporting and tracking requirements to support transparency.
  • Partner closely with Intake, Care Coordination, and Branch leadership to ensure timely patient starts of care.
  • Escalate clinical concerns or regulatory issues promptly to the Clinical Review Manager.
  • Support branch and central teams with troubleshooting and guidance on referral-related issues.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Current LPN with equivalent experience in home health intake/clinical review.
  • 2+ years of clinical experience in home health, intake, or care coordination.
  • Knowledge of Medicare COPs, CMS guidelines, and general home health regulations.
  • Strong critical thinking and clinical decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication and phone skills; ability to build trust with patients, referral sources, and colleagues.
  • Proficiency with EMR systems (WellSky preferred) and Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Teams, Excel).
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume environment with accuracy and composure.

Benefits

Why Choose Pinnacle?

  • Personalized, One-on-One Care: Help patients heal and regain their independence by delivering individualized care in the comfort of their homes.
  • Growth & Stability: Over two decades as Florida’s largest independent home health agency.
  • Ongoing Professional Development: Free Continuing Education Units (CEUs) to support licensure and career advancement.
  • Competitive Benefits & Perks: Including an employee referral program where you can earn rewards.
  • Recognized Excellence: Ranked as a USA Today Top Workplace.
  • Flexible Scheduling: Enjoy a schedule that aligns with your personal priorities.
  • Supportive & Fun Culture: Join a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values both professional excellence and personal fulfillment.

Pinnacle promotes an inclusive environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

Be part of a company that empowers clinicians to make a difference in the lives of over 10,000 patients across Florida every day. Apply now!

jobs.title: Sr. Tax & Compliance Analyst II
jobs.excerpt: What You'll DoAvalara is seeking a senior-level indirect tax analyst to join our Premium Returns for Communications (PRS) team.
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

Avalara is seeking a senior-level indirect tax analyst to join our Premium Returns for Communications (PRS) team. This role is designed for a highly experienced, technically sophisticated tax professional who is ready to operate at an elite level, serve our most complex customers, and actively raise the bar for the team around them. As a senior contributor, you will bring deep multi-jurisdictional communications tax compliance expertise, a proven ability to drive process and automation improvements, and the mindset of someone who makes every team they join stronger.

The Senior Tax Analyst II is the primary point of contact for a select portfolio of Premium Returns for Communications customers with highly complex compliance needs. You will own the end-to-end relationship and filing lifecycle for your accounts, serve as a trusted escalation resource, and lead process improvement and automation initiatives that benefit the broader Premium Returns for Communications team. This role requires a professional who is self-directed, proactive, and deeply committed to both customer outcomes and team excellence.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

  • Protects customer revenue through accurate, on-time state, local, and federal communications tax compliance support.
  • Reduces compliance risk by applying deep jurisdictional expertise and robust variance, exception, and notice management.
  • Increases operational scale by designing and refining Premium Returns for Communications workflows, data ingestion patterns, and automation that reduce manual effort.
  • Enhances customer trust as a knowledgeable, proactive, senior point of contact for complex portfolios on Premium Returns for Communications products.
  • Raises team capability by mentoring junior analysts and sharing documentation, process improvements, and AI best practices.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Own end-to-end preparation, review, and filing of complex, multi-jurisdiction communications tax returns – including state, local, federal, and regulatory obligations (e.g., USF, E911, FUSF, PUC) – for assigned customer portfolios, achieving on-time performance aligned to SLAs.
  • Serve as primary compliance contact for assigned customers using Premium Returns for Communications products, handling advanced questions and escalations with minimal supervision.
  • Analyze transactional and configuration data across AvaTax, Returns Console, and source systems to identify discrepancies, filing risks, and root causes before submission.
  • Design and continuously improve Premium Returns for Communications workflows (data ingestion, validation, approvals, filing, archiving) to reduce manual touches, rework, and notice volume.
  • Perform and improve month-end reconciliations and variance analysis to align reported liability with customer expectations.
  • Engage state, local, and federal jurisdictions on behalf of customers to resolve complex compliance issues, notices, and exceptions.
  • Participate in QA/UAT for new forms, filing automation, and Premium Returns for Communications Returns Console features; provide clear, risk-based feedback from a compliance perspective.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Onboarding, Professional Services, and CX to strengthen compliance execution and the Premium Returns for Communications experience.
  • Mentor and coach junior analysts on complex jurisdictions, Premium Returns for Communications best practices, customer communication, and AI-enabled workflows.

What You'll Need to be Successful

Qualifications (Required)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax AND 7+ years of hands-on practical experience in multi-jurisdiction indirect tax compliance – both are required; a degree alone or experience alone is not sufficient.
  • Proven experience preparing and filing complex, multi-state communications tax returns, including exposure to federal and state regulatory obligations such as USF, E911, FUSF, and PUC filings.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of communications-specific tax complexity, including multi-jurisdictional rate structures, exemption management, and telecom billing configurations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, PivotTables, Power Pivot or similar) and demonstrated ability to analyze large, complex datasets.
  • Experience working across multiple systems and tools (e.g., AvaTax for Communications, Returns Console/ARA, ERP or billing platforms, CSV/API extractors) with the ability to troubleshoot data and configuration issues end-to-end.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills; able to operate calmly and methodically under strict filing deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex tax and system topics in clear, simple language to non-experts.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a high-volume environment while maintaining quality.
  • Proven application of AI tools in a professional context to improve efficiency, accuracy, or customer experience (e.g., analysis, summarization, drafting, documentation) – this is a required capability, not a nice-to-have.

12-Month Success Signals

  • Independently manage a portfolio of complex, multijurisdictional Premium Returns for Communications customers with minimal escalation.
  • Achieve consistent 100% on-time filing performance (or agreed SLA targets) for assigned portfolios.
  • Maintain high accuracy with visible reductions in rework, variances, and notices relative to baseline.
  • Implement at least one documented AI-driven workflow or process improvement adopted by the broader team.
  • Demonstrate strong working knowledge of AvaTax for Communications, Returns Console, and Premium Returns for Communications, including data flows and key configuration patterns.
  • Contribute meaningfully to at least one cross-functional initiative (e.g., product feedback loop, automation pilot, training series) with clear, documented outcomes.
  • Recognized by peers and leaders as a go-to SME for Premium Returns for Communications-based compliance in at least one or two critical domains (e.g., specific jurisdictions, customer segment, workflow type).

Bar Raiser Expectations

At Avalara, every senior hire is expected to make the team better than it was before they arrived. This is not a maintenance role – it is a role for someone who raises the bar for everyone around them. You will join this team and leave it stronger: stronger processes, stronger knowledge, stronger people, and a higher standard of excellence. If you are the kind of person who makes teams better, this is the right opportunity.

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability for customer outcomes, deadlines, and quality – not just your own portfolio but the health of the team’s work.
  • Exercise sound judgment in decisions that impact customers, scalability, and risk, using data and AI insights where appropriate.
  • Act as a go-to SME for critical Premium Returns for Communications compliance functions or customers, leading through influence across teams.
  • Leave processes, workflows, and documentation stronger than you found them by identifying issues, proposing solutions, and driving them to completion.
  • Elevate peer performance through mentoring, knowledge sharing, constructive feedback, and modeling Avalara’s AI-first, customer-obsessed culture.
  • Set and hold a higher standard – not by authority but by example.

AI Bar Raiser Expectations

This candidate is expected to join Avalara as an AI Bar Raiser. That means you bring AI fluency, habits, and applied expertise that exceed the current team’s capability – and you are expected to actively elevate the team’s AI capability through your work, coaching, and innovation. Generic AI tool usage is not sufficient for this role. You must be the person who raises the standard for what “good” looks like when it comes to AI-enabled compliance work.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate data analysis, reconciliations, exception review, and return preparation while maintaining or improving quality.
  • Use AI to draft clear, professional customer and jurisdiction communications; apply judgment and domain expertise before sending.
  • Summarize complex issues, root cause analyses, and action plans with AI to improve clarity and reduce preparation time for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Design and implement at least one AI-enabled workflow enhancement (e.g., standardized prompts, variance review patterns, notice response templates) within the first 12 months.
  • Quantify measurable AI impact such as reduced review hours, faster cycle times, or lower notice/rework rates.
  • Apply AI responsibly in alignment with Avalara security, privacy, and compliance standards.
  • Proactively share AI methods, prompt patterns, and lessons learned so that the team’s collective AI capability grows because you are here.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.description:
Overview

Lynker Corporation is a leading provider of innovative solutions in weather and climate science. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for innovation, Lynker leverages cutting-edge technologies and scientific expertise to support the creation and delivery of improved operational weather forecasts. As part of our ongoing growth and expansion, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Scientific Developer for AI/ML Forecasting to join our growing team.

Responsibilities

Duties of the Scientific Developer for AI/ML Forecasting will include the following:

  • Conduct cutting-edge development and innovation in next-generation forecasting models and technologies driven by Super Intelligence/Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (SI/AI/ML).
  • Serve as a key technical resource for SI/AI/ML-based modeling suites (including AIGFS, AIGEFS, and HGEFS).
  • Identify, prototype, evaluate, and refine emerging machine learning approaches; conduct numerical experiments, analyze performance results, and apply parallelization and code optimization to develop successful experimental models for operational implementation.
  • Establish best practices, standards, and scalable CPU- and GPU-based workflows for training and inference across high-performance computing (HPC) and cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to build, optimize, and maintain efficient data-loading pipelines handling diverse meteorological data types.
  • Integrate SI/AI/ML tools, models, and workflows directly into Office of Modeling and Development (OMD) modeling suites.
  • Collaborate with the OMD team, partners, and the broader research community to advance state-of-the-art weather and climate forecasting through data-driven approaches and innovative machine learning methodologies.
  • Stay current on the latest scientific, methodological, and technological advances in SI/AI/ML-driven weather forecasting.
  • Promote software engineering and research best practices through regular code reviews, documentation, and maintenance of high code quality standards.
  • Train and mentor scientists on machine learning capabilities, AI tools, and frameworks, and participate in technical workshops and professional conferences to communicate findings.

Qualifications

The Scientific Developer for AI/ML Forecasting selected should have the following:

  • Background in machine learning/data science, meteorology/NWP, physical sciences, mathematics, computer science, scientific computing, or a closely related field with demonstrated SI/AI/ML-related or closely related computing experience.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Python programming and work experience in ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX, coding/scripting, and automated workflow development (Bash, Python).
  • Strong working knowledge of core ML lifecycle principles, including data wrangling, model training, validation, and operationalization, as well as architectures including Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Transformers, and Diffusion Models.
  • Demonstrated experience or working understanding of Earth systems data, modeling, and workflows, or other scientific computing experience.
  • Experience leveraging SI/AI tools (LLMs, agents) to advance code and documentation development, or willingness to learn.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently identify, prioritize, and implement bug fixes and new features.
  • Working knowledge of version control, collaborative code management, automated code testing, and other modern software engineering practices.
  • Ability to work effectively and professionally as part of a diverse, customer-focused team, collaborating with physical scientists, software engineers, and inter-agency partner teams.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder.

The Ideal Scientific Developer for AI/ML Forecasting will have the following:

  • Demonstrated experience with SI/AI/ML-driven weather forecasting methodologies, including bias correction, full-SI/AI/ML forecasts, physics-informed neural nets, etc.
  • Familiarity with SI/AI/ML forecast models and frameworks (Google DeepMind, WeatherNext, Earth-2, Anemoi), as well as training data sets (ERA5, GDAS/GFS).
  • Experience with code optimization, including for GPU and other parallel computing.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Podman, Singularity/Apptainer), continuous integration (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins), and DevOps and Agile methodologies.
  • Build systems and software dependency management (pip, Conda, Spack).

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. jobs.description:
We're Hiring

Remote Academic Coach & Student Assistant (Part-Time, ~10 hours/week)

The steady partner who helps a high-achieving student master hard material and never miss a deadline.

About the Role

Seamless Assist is hiring a part-time Academic Coach & Student Assistant for a US-based family. You will work one-on-one, online, with their daughter, a motivated high-school student taking classes a year ahead of her grade, including several college-level Advanced Placement (AP) courses. This role reports to the student's parent.

Why This Role Exists

The student doesn't need to be taught from scratch. She is carrying a demanding, writing-heavy course load, and the pressure is in the volume: essays, problem sets, labs, tests and extracurricular deadlines all landing in the same week. This role exists to give her a sharp, organised partner who can keep up with advanced material, help her work through the hardest parts, and keep her schedule under control so nothing slips.

Her Current Classes

  • AP Microeconomics & Macroeconomics
  • AP Biology
  • AP English Language & Composition
  • AP US History
  • Pre-Calculus
  • Spanish 4
  • Journalism & News Production

You don't need to be an expert in every subject. You do need to be strong in several of them, especially writing-heavy courses (AP English Language, AP US History) and at least one of economics, biology or maths.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Academic coaching (about 70% of your time)

  • Run live one-on-one video sessions to work through homework, problem sets, essays and test preparation.
  • Explain difficult concepts clearly and check that she can explain them back.
  • Review essays and written work for argument, structure, evidence and citations, including AP-style timed essays.
  • Build practice questions, review plans and study guides ahead of tests and the AP exams in May.
  • Learn how each course is taught and graded (syllabi, teacher rubrics, the College Board AP course frameworks) and coach to them.
  • Coach, never complete. Her work must always be her own, in line with her school's academic integrity rules.

Planning and student assistant support (about 30% of your time)

  • Run a weekly planning session: map every class's assignments, tests and deadlines into a shared calendar and task list.
  • Keep her schedule current across classes, activities and appointments, with study time blocked in.
  • Send short reminders before deadlines and confirm work was actually submitted.
  • Track grades and flag early when something starts to slip.
  • Send the parent a short weekly progress update.

Schedule

About 10 hours per week. Sessions fall on weekday afternoons and evenings, US Pacific Time (roughly 3:30–8:30 pm PT), plus one short weekend planning session. You must be reliably available in that window.

Who Will Succeed in This Role

This is a high-trust role with a bright, busy teenager. You will need real subject depth, patience, and the organisational discipline of a strong executive assistant.

  • You explain things clearly and can tell the difference between "I get it" and actually getting it.
  • You are a strong writer and can give specific, useful feedback on an argumentative essay.
  • You run your own life from a calendar and a task list, and you follow up without being asked.
  • You are warm, steady and encouraging, and you hold a high standard.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher, ideally in education, English, history, economics, biology, mathematics or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of tutoring or teaching high-school or first-year university students.
  • Strong command of the material in several of the subjects listed above.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. Your writing will be assessed during screening.
  • Uses AI tools in your daily work (for example Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) to build study materials and plan faster, and can teach a student to use them responsibly and within school rules.
  • Able to work US Pacific Time afternoons and evenings, about 10 hours per week.
  • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a webcam and a backup power or internet plan.
  • Willing to complete a national police clearance or background check and provide two professional references before starting.

Nice to have

  • Experience with the US Advanced Placement (AP) programme, or strong AP, SAT, IB or A-Level results of your own.
  • Conversational or better Spanish.
  • Journalism, editing or newsroom experience.
  • Comfortable in Google Workspace (Calendar, Docs, Drive) and a task tool such as Notion or Todoist.

How We Work

Because this role involves working one-on-one with a teenager, clear safeguards apply. All sessions run on a family-owned video account and are recorded. All messages go through a group channel that includes a parent. There is no private messaging or social-media contact with the student. A background check and references are required before the first paid session.

Pay

Competitive hourly pay, paid monthly in USD. Pay varies by country.

How to Apply

Apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short AI-led video interview, a written subject task, an interview with the family and a paid trial session.

What We're Looking For

  • Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Network Engineering, or a related field with 2–4 years of relevant experience, or approximately 3 years of applicable experience without a degree.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (such as Security+) and an approved Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Hands-on experience supporting SD-WAN and MPLS environments, including underlay/overlay architectures, routing policies, and network segmentation.
  • Knowledge of LAN/WAN, BGP, TCP/UDP, IPSec, VPNs, Layer 2/Layer 3 routing, and firewalls.
  • Experience with network device patching, upgrades, configuration management, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Experience with at least one network management platform, such as:
    • Palo Alto Panorama
    • Cisco Prime
    • Cisco DNA
    • Junos Space
  • Hands-on experience with at least two of the following:
    • Cisco
    • Juniper
    • Palo Alto
    • Dell Networking
    • Remote Access VPN (RAVPN)
    • GlobalProtect
    • AppGate
  • Experience supporting DoD STIGs and network security hardening.
  • Familiarity with SFTP, SSH, SCP, MPLS, SNMP, and NTP.
  • Ability to troubleshoot network issues independently or with senior engineering support.
  • Strong communication, teamwork, and technical documentation skills.
  • Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts when needed for migration activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience creating network diagrams, configuration records, and technical documentation.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to develop your networking expertise while supporting a mission that directly impacts the U.S. Army's global communications.

jobs.description:
This role is open to applicants living in the Philippines.

Operations Assistant VA

Keep Every Order Moving, From Vendor to Warehouse

Why This Role Matters
Before a lab can order from Filtrous, the product has to be on our shelves, and that starts with a purchase order placed well in advance. When that order goes out late, a vendor falls behind, or a shipment arrives wrong, our stock runs low and customers wait. As our Operations Assistant VA, you'll own the purchasing and vendor pipeline end-to-end, from the reorder sheet to the warehouse door. You'll make sure purchase orders go out on time, vendors stay on schedule, and shipments don't fall apart. In a business built on speed and reliability, your work keeps products in stock and our customers' labs running.

What You'll Do
• Turn the Reorder Sheet into Purchase Orders: Work from our reorder sheet to figure out what we need, build purchase orders in our ERP system with the purchasing team, and route them to leadership for approval.
• Source Product with Vendors: Find supplier options, request and compare quotes, and work through product specs and minimum order quantities before an order is placed.
• Confirm Every Order Detail: Send purchase orders to vendors, get the proforma invoice back, and work out adjustments like carton quantities and price changes. Verify barcodes with our operations team before anything is confirmed, and send vendors the full item package: photos, Certificate of Analysis (CoA), and packing list.
• Keep Payments and Production on Track: Send vendor invoices to our finance team for payment, share proof of payment with the vendor, and get a production timeline back. Follow up with every vendor at least weekly, every three days if they go quiet, and escalate if they stop responding. WeChat must be used during business hours for faster turnaround on vendor communication.
• Coordinate Shipping, Tariffs, and Customs: Work with our logistics team and freight partners on shipping and tariffs, consolidating across open purchase orders so we never ship a partial container. Handle customs declarations, declared values, and product classifications using information provided or approved by the company.
• Keep the Warehouse Ready for Every Delivery: Update our ERP system as soon as a delivery date is set and share it with the warehouse right away, then send reminders a week out, three days out, and the morning of delivery.
• Fix Problems and Track Every Order: If a shipment arrives incorrect or damaged, contact the vendor promptly and arrange a timely re-shipment at the vendor's cost. Keep a tracking sheet with each PO number, its exact status, and dates for everything, and other duties as assigned.

Problems You Will Solve
• Purchase orders go out late: Without one person working the reorder sheet and pushing orders through approval, purchase orders slip and stock runs low before replacements are on the way.
• Vendors drift off schedule: When no one follows up on a steady rhythm, suppliers go quiet, production timelines slide, and delays surface only when it is too late to recover.
• Order details slip through the cracks: When carton quantities, price changes, barcodes, and product documents are not checked before an order is confirmed, small mistakes turn into wrong labels, wrong quantities, and costly rework.
• Shipping costs more than it should: Partial containers, orders that are not consolidated, and incomplete customs paperwork add freight costs, tariff surprises, and delays at the border.
• Deliveries catch the warehouse off guard: Without accurate delivery dates and timely reminders, shipments show up unannounced, receiving gets rushed, and damaged or incorrect goods are not sent back to the vendor in time.

How Success is Measured
• Get purchase orders built, approved, and sent to vendors on time, every month
• Follow up on every open order at least weekly, with a confirmed production timeline
• Ship zero partial containers by consolidating open orders on every shipment
• Keep the tracking sheet and ERP current, and give the warehouse notice before every delivery

Why You'll Love It Here
At Filtrous, you won't be a back-office clerk pushing paperwork. You'll own a pipeline that keeps real laboratories stocked with the supplies they rely on every day. You'll work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where your ideas for faster, smoother purchasing actually get implemented. You'll collaborate closely with our purchasing, finance, logistics, and warehouse teams, and your impact on on-time orders and in-stock products will be visible and celebrated. As we grow, so will your career, with opportunities to shape how Filtrous buys and ships from the ground up.

Who You Are
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related field (required)
• Experience in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain coordination, working directly with vendors (required)
• Proficient with ERP and inventory systems (e.g., Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP) and spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets)
• Comfortable with international shipping basics: freight, tariffs, customs declarations, and product classifications
• Strong written English and the persistence to keep vendors responsive across time zones
• Highly organized with a process-driven mindset and commitment to follow-through

Bonus points if you have:

  • Background in the life sciences, biotechnology, or laboratory supplies industry
    • Experience importing from overseas suppliers, including container consolidation and vendor communication on WeChat

About Filtrous
Founded in 2017, Filtrous delivers speed, quality, and value to agile labs. We're a lab supplies distributor serving laboratories across a wide range of scientific and industrial sectors. Our secret? We combine uncompromising product quality with customer service that actually picks up the phone.

Job Type Part-time (20 hours per week)

Location Remote
Schedule Monday to Friday, 3:00–7:00 PM PST (7:00–11:00 AM Philippine Time, Tuesday to Saturday)

Ready to Join Us?
If you love keeping complex orders on track, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help shape how a growing company buys and ships, we'd love to hear from you.

Er setzt die Prioritäten und gibt Inhalte frei, zu Beginn jedes Dokument vor der Nutzung. Den Kontakt zu VP Sales Europe, Country Heads of Sales, Product Management und Sales Operations führt er anfangs, mit der Zeit übernimmst du Themen direkt. Du hältst Inhalte über Märkte hinweg aligned und berücksichtigst lokale Unterschiede.

Requirements

  • Strukturiertes Denken: Du verstehst Prioritäten und übersetzt sie in klare Aufgaben. Du erkennst Lücken früh, sprichst sie an und machst komplexe Themen einfach und verständlich.

  • Umsetzungsstärke: Du lieferst präzise Dokumentation und Trainingsunterstützung pünktlich, lernst aus Feedback und wirst besser. Du nutzt Daten, um zu prüfen, ob Inhalte und Trainings tatsächlich genutzt werden.

  • Kundenverständnis: Du baust ein gutes Verständnis für den Vertriebsprozess und unsere Kunden auf, bringst Erkenntnisse aus dem Feld ein und hilfst dem Team mit dem richtigen Wissen zu stärkeren Kundengesprächen.

  • Zusammenarbeit und Vertrauen: Du baust Vertrauen im Vertriebsteam und funktionsübergreifend auf, bist ein guter Sparringspartner für den Sales Enablement Manager und findest die Balance zwischen Konsistenz über Märkte hinweg und lokalen Bedürfnissen.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du trittst souverän auf Deutsch und Englisch auf.

Deine Benefits

  • 30 Tage Urlaub plus 5 zusätzliche Tage für besondere Anlässe

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten

  • MacBook oder Windows-Laptop sowie ein Apple-Smartphone

Das ist Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. Wir entwickeln die weltweit fortschrittlichsten mobilen Energiesysteme und schaffen damit neue Freiheit für die Art und Weise, wie Menschen arbeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir gestalten wir eine Zukunft, in der moderne Technologie und ökologische Verantwortung Hand in Hand gehen und nachhaltige Wirkung entfalten. Getrieben von Neugier und dem Anspruch, die Welt von morgen sauberer zu hinterlassen als die von gestern, treiben wir den Wandel von Verbrennungsgeneratoren hin zu einer sauberen Alternative voran – schnell, messbar und mit echtem Impact. Was wir bisher erreicht haben, ist erst der Anfang.

Bei Instagrid stehen wir für echte Chancengleichheit, denn wir glauben an die Stärke vielfältiger Teams. Wir schätzen Diversität nicht nur, wir suchen aktiv nach den besten Talenten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Nationalität. Wir arbeiten als Team, begegnen uns mit Respekt und schätzen unterschiedliche Perspektiven, um gemeinsam Großes zu erreichen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

• Senior ML Engineer
  • Pay: $60–$120/hour
  • Location: Global, fully remote
  • Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)
  • Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for highly skilled Machine Learning Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving model development, training and inference systems, numerical computing, performance optimization, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging machine-learning engineering tasks. A representative task may require implementing or modifying a model, constructing a reproducible training or inference workflow, optimizing memory or throughput, debugging numerical or system-level failures, and verifying that the resulting implementation satisfies objective correctness and performance requirements.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Develop and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure.
  2. Implement model components, data pipelines, evaluation systems, and numerical methods.
  3. Build reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools.

Required Qualifications

  1. A BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.
  2. Strong professional or research experience in machine learning.
  3. Practical proficiency withPython and coding agents.
  4. Experience in one or more of the following ML Engineering camps:Inference/Serving, Evaluation, Data & Feature Engineering, Retrieval/Ranking/RAG, MLOps, Model Compression/Optimization and/or GPU/kernel optimization.

Equivalent tools may also be considered when the candidate demonstrates directly relevant depth.

Experience at a well-established technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or other recognized engineering environment is strongly preferred. Exceptional open-source or academic experience may also qualify.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

A very attractive and competitive package is offered.

jobs.description:
Vice President of Marketing

Location: Remote (US) — up to 35% travel to our Santa Barbara, CA headquarters, customer sites, industry events, and analyst meetings

Come build with us. In this role, you will own how the market sees CrossnoKaye — defining the story, positioning, and brand that make ATLAS and our Advanced Process Control (APC) the recognized standard for Software-Defined Automation in heavy industry, and building the team that turns that story into pipeline.

We’re hiring: A player-coach marketing executive from industrial automation, controls, or manufacturing technology. You have marketed AI or other new technology to conservative industrial buyers. You will personally own positioning, segment messaging, product marketing, and analyst relations, and you will build and lead the team that runs demand generation, ABM, and events.

This role reports to: Chief Revenue Officer (CRO)

What you’ll be doing:

What you’ll own directly (player):

  • Marketing strategy: Own CK’s 2026–2028 Marketing Strategy — finalize the strategy deck, keep it current, and bring in the findings of our ARC Advisory Group engagement. Food Processing (APC) is the primary market; Cold Storage stays in maintenance mode.
  • Positioning, segment messaging & personas: Own company and product positioning, the messaging house, and the messaging and buyer personas for each segment. You make the final call; our Product Marketing Manager builds the work.
  • Brand & category: Lead CK’s Software-Defined Automation (SDA) category strategy — the manifesto, the annual State of SDA report, and our point of view — and stand up brand measurement (share of voice, branded search, analyst positioning), reported to the executive team every quarter.
  • Product marketing & launches: Lead product marketing for ATLAS, APC, Energy AI and AURA, and for new products as they ramp (Intelligence, DCS). Install a Pragmatic-style launch framework with product, starting with the next major release.
  • Analyst relations: Own CK’s analyst relationships — ARC Advisory Group and LNS Research first, then ABI and IDC — with a goal of a named ARC research note by the end of 2027. There is no separate analyst relations role; the Channel & Partner Marketing Manager supports from Q4 2027.
  • Executive visibility & PR: Raise the profile of CrossnoKaye and our founders through founder-led bylines, podcasts, speaking, and tier-1 trade media, working with our PR agency.
  • Plan, budget & pipeline: Own the annual marketing plan, budget, and headcount, and the company’s marketing-sourced pipeline target (10% → 25% → 35% from 2026 to 2028), with a pipeline definition and attribution model agreed with sales (and RevOps once the open Director of Revenue Operations seat is filled).

What you’ll build and lead (coach):

  • Demand generation & ABM: Lead our Director of Demand Generation & Marketing Operations and the ABM & Demand Generation Manager (joining in 2027) as they scale ABM across the Top 200 North American food & beverage processors. You set the targeting, tiers, and messaging; the team runs the engine.
  • Product marketing: Lead our Product Marketing Manager (PMM), who covers Food Processing and Cold Storage. Add a second PMM for new products and verticals in the second half of 2027, gated on product releases (Intelligence, DCS) and new verticals.
  • Events: Lead our Events Lead and the three-tier program: the Innovation Summit (75 → 150 → 200 attendees), a food processing trade-show footprint (IPPE, Pack Expo, FA&M, NAMI, ARC Industry Forum; IIAR for cold storage), and road shows and dinners that produce pipeline.
  • Customer marketing & sales enablement: Build case study, reference, and customer advisory board programs, and make sure sales has the plays, battlecards, ROI tools, and proof from every pilot and deployment.
  • Channel & partner marketing: Hire and lead a Channel & Partner Marketing Manager by Q4 2027 to build co-marketing with Amazon, Koch, systems integrators, analysts, and other partners.
  • Team, agencies & culture: Hire, coach, and grow a high-performing team and agency bench (PR, creative, SEO, events) with clear goals, an operating cadence, and career paths.

What we’re looking for:

  • 15+ years of B2B marketing, including 7+ years leading marketing teams and at least 5 years in industrial automation, controls, or manufacturing technology — ideally at (or competing with) Siemens, Schneider Electric, Rockwell Automation, Emerson, Honeywell, ABB, AspenTech, AVEVA, or similar.
  • Experience marketing AI, software, or other new technology to manufacturing and heavy industry — for example industrial AI, advanced process control (APC), Software-Defined Automation (SDA), IIoT, or energy optimization.
  • Fluency with industrial buying committees (VP of Operations, plant manager, Director of Controls & Automation, engineering, CFO, CIO/CDO) and the credibility to hold your own with each of them.
  • A track record of positioning and launching new products end to end — from market definition and messaging through sales enablement and measured adoption.
  • Hands-on analyst relations experience that turned briefings into coverage and category validation.
  • Proven ownership of brand strategy and brand measurement, and of a marketing-sourced pipeline number that you hit.
  • A genuine player-coach: you write the positioning document yourself, and you have built teams and leaders who run demand generation, ABM, and events at scale.
  • Executive presence and judgment — at ease with the CEO, the board, customers, analysts, and the press.

Nice to Have:

  • Category-creation experience — you have named, evangelized, and defended a category before.
  • An engineering, controls, or automation background (or a degree that lets you keep pace with one).
  • Experience in food & beverage processing, industrial refrigeration, or aggregates.
  • Experience with the Pragmatic Institute framework and a modern, AI-enabled marketing stack.

What Success Looks Like:

  • 3 months — Marketing Strategy Deck finalized with ARC’s findings; positioning, messaging house, and segment personas adopted by sales and leadership; brand baseline set; ARC and LNS briefings held; 2027 plan, budget, and pipeline definition agreed with sales and RevOps.
  • 6 months — First major launch delivered end to end under the new launch framework; ABM live across the Top 200 food processor tiers, with the ABM & Demand Gen Manager in seat; State of SDA report published; 2028 Summit and events calendar locked.
  • 9 months — On track for a named ARC research note by year-end; brand metrics up against baseline; marketing-sourced pipeline on track for 25% in 2027 on the way to ~35% in 2028; core team (Director, PMM, ABM Manager, Events Lead) performing; Channel & Partner Marketing Manager hired.

Compensation:

The estimated base salary range for this role is $225,000-$250,000. In addition to base pay, full-time team members are eligible for a company-wide bonus and equity options - giving you the opportunity to grow alongside the company and share in the long-term success we’re building together. Estimated total cash compensation may range from approximately $255,000- $283,000.

Final compensation is determined by several factors including prior experience, skills, and alignment with the role. The range above is intended to provide a helpful benchmark, though it may be updated as needed.

Why Join CrossnoKaye?

  • Impactful Mission: Be part of a team driving sustainable transformation in a resource-heavy industry.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology: Work with advanced IoT solutions and industry-leading experts.
  • Career Growth: As we scale, you’ll have opportunities for personal and professional advancement.
  • Inclusive Culture: We love innovation, embrace curiosity, and value well-being and professional development.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive salary with equity opportunities
  • Health, dental, vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan and parental leave
  • Untracked PTO and sick days
  • Cell phone reimbursements and other perks

At CrossnoKaye, we believe industrial performance is unlocked, not built. Our AI-native platform understands how a plant operates, predicts what’s changing, and either guides the crew or runs the controls itself, driving continuous improvements in throughput, yield, energy and uptime. Join us to help heavy industry get more from the plants it already owns.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from all backgrounds. We seek to build a diverse pool of applicants that will help to push our company forward. We believe that our true success will come from a diverse, dynamic, and inclusive environment. jobs.title: Director, EMEA OCM & Adoption Leader
jobs.excerpt: Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way.
jobs.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

PTC's Organizational Change Management (OCM) practice has grown from a founding idea into a profitable, high-demand business in the U.S., backed by a rapidly expanding pipeline and a roster of Fortune 500 aerospace, defense, MedTech and industrial manufacturing customers. The next chapter of this growth story is EMEA, and we're looking for a Director, EMEA OCM & Customer Adoption leader to lead it.

This is a rare opportunity for a leader who wants to build and run a business, not simply deliver a service. You will take full, end-to-end ownership of the EMEA region. This includes adapting a proven U.S. playbook to Europe's customers, culture, and market dynamics, with accountability for regional bookings and revenue, direct people leadership, and a mandate to shape how digital transformation and change management show up across strategic EMEA customers.


This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: equal parts regional general manager, change-management practitioner, and cross-functional orchestrator, working \with Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, Customer Success Managers, Business Solution Managers, and Market/Regional leaders across Europe. It reports directly to PTC's Global OCM & Adoption Leader and carries the same level of strategic visibility as our most senior Customer Success leadership roles.

OCM is not a niche delivery function at PTC, it is a named growth priority with active, ongoing sponsorship from PTC's CEO and Customer Success leadership.


Key Responsibilities


1. Regional Commercial Leadership & GTM Strategy

Build and execute an EMEA-specific go-to-market strategy for OCM and digital transformation, in partnership with Business Solution Managers, Market Leads, and Regional Directors.

Own EMEA OCM bookings and revenue targets, with disciplined forecasting and reporting into the global OCM leadership cadence.

Personally shape, scope, and price complex OCM opportunities; especially Director+ and executive-level conversations that require deep change-management and transformation expertise.

Convert the existing and emerging EMEA pipeline, spanning global aerospace, industrial equipment, and automotive manufacturers, into signed, delivered engagements.

Partner with Sales, BSMs, and Market Leads so OCM is embedded into the deal cycle from the start.


2. Global Methodology Partnership & Regional Adaptation

Partner closely with the Global OCM and Adoption Delivery Leader — who owns and drives PTC's global OCM methodology — to adapt and localize the delivery playbook and toolkits for EMEA, ensuring the region applies the methodology consistently and with fidelity to the global standard.

Identify where EMEA-specific adaptation is required -- language, works councils, data residency, and customer culture, and lead that localization effort.

Maintain delivery quality and consistency with the global framework as the region scales.

Represent the EMEA perspective in the ongoing evolution of the global methodology, helping it mature into a truly global capability.


3. Team & Cross-Functional Leadership Across Europe

Directly manage and grow the EMEA OCM delivery team, starting with the regional delivery hub and scaling headcount as pipeline converts to backlog.

Partner day-to-day with Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, and Customer Success leadership across Europe to embed OCM into delivery engagements from kickoff through go-live.

Represent OCM in regional leadership forums, quarterly business reviews, and strategic account planning sessions.

Build strong working relationships with country and market leads to ensure OCM is positioned consistently across every EMEA geography.


4. Coaching, Mentoring & Executive Presence

Coach and mentor direct reports and extended EMEA adoption/OCM contributors, including Customer Success Managers delivering OCM packages.

Represent OCM at EMEA leadership meetings, quarterly business reviews, customer executive sessions, and industry events.

Build trusted-advisor relationships with customer executives, PTC's regional leadership, and cross-functional peers.

Champion OCM's value story internally so EMEA Customer Success Managers, BSMs, and sales leaders confidently and consistently bring OCM into customer conversations.


5. Delivery Excellence & Practice Economics

Own delivery quality and customer outcomes across all EMEA OCM and digital-transformation engagements.

Manage the practice's economics, staffing, utilization, and margin, for the regional team.

Develop reusable, scalable delivery assets tailored to EMEA-specific needs.

Cultivate customer success stories and reference-ability across the region.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in organizational change management, digital transformation, or large-scale enterprise system implementations, including leadership of a regional or country-level business unit.

Proven track record of building and scaling a services or consulting practice, owning bookings, revenue, and margin, not delivery alone.

Deep OCM/change-management expertise (Prosci or equivalent certification preferred), ideally applied to PLM, ALM, CAD, or other enterprise digital transformation programs.

Demonstrated ability to lead a direct team while operating as a peer to Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, and Sales leadership across multiple countries and cultures.

Executive presence to engage Director-level and C-suite stakeholders in complex change and transformation conversations.

Experience building go-to-market strategy and enabling sales/BSM teams to position, scope, and sell a specialized offering.

Based in, or with strong professional ties to, Europe; fluent English required, additional European languages a strong plus.

Willingness and ability to travel extensively across the EMEA region.


Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
