jobs.description:
Head of Marketing

Town Web · HeyGov

Remote · Full-time contractor

The Quick Version

Have you ever seen a company create their own National Holiday as part of its marketing efforts?

We did!

Speaking of silly stuff, we even wrote and produced our own comedic commercial about the real pains that our customers have, and it helped make one of our tools the fastest growing AI tool in the industry!

Ultimately we want our marketing to be funny, human, and memorable, because honestly a lot of the stuff out there in the government industry (which is where we compete) is boring.

Now we're looking for someone exceptionally creative to lead our marketing department — a person with the freedom to take big creative swings and the resources to execute their own.

Our brands — Town Web, HeyGov, and ClerkMinutes — form a suite of tools built specifically for municipal clerks, and each one is crafted to be exceptional at its job. If you're a highly effective, exceptional marketing professional, we'd love for you to apply. Below are more details about who we are and what we're trying to achieve.

Here's a video to tell you more about this role!

The details

Who we are

We're a small, bootstrapped company approaching $3M in ARR, competing against large, private-equity-owned firms with far deeper pockets. That's why our marketing has to be exceptional on two fronts at once: creative work that is unique and memorable, and follow-through to match it — multi-channel campaigns, disciplined measurement, and sophisticated execution that turns attention into pipeline.

Our customers are municipal clerks at cities, counties, and municipalities of all sizes. They are busy, under-resourced, deeply practical, and they talk to each other (which as you can guess is why we are emphasising the need to have exceptional marketing!)

We build focused products for the clerk specifically, designed to work together as a suite. ClerkMinutes became one of the most widely adopted tools in its category largely on the strength of marketing that looked like nothing else in this space, and your job is to push that further across the whole portfolio. We run on EOS, and the marketing department's cadence — L10s, quarterly Rocks, scorecards — will be yours to run.

What you'll own

  • Strategy and positioning across the portfolio, and the department's EOS operating cadence
  • Demand and revenue — building a qualified pipeline for Sales through targeted campaigns and similar initiatives. This is how success is measured.
  • Full-channel execution — conferences, webinars, direct mail, PR, and outbound alongside digital and paid. Clerks trust people who show up in person, so you will too.
  • Lifecycle marketing — from first touch through trial to customer, along with the tech, tracking, and attribution behind it
  • The quality bar — you're the final day-to-day reviewer on copy, design, campaigns, and launches
  • Go-to-market with Product and Sales — new product launches and targeted campaigns that get us early beta testers, help build awareness for product pilots, and than formal product releases.

Who does well here

Isn’t it clear we’re looking for somebody extremely creative and ambitious!? 😛Are you “THE ONE?”

We’re looking for a creative strategist and an enthusiastic builder who can lead the team from the front line. Think of a special-forces team leader: they plan the mission, and when it's time to move, they're also the first one through the door. That's the posture this role needs — you set the strategy, and then you're in the weeds executing it right alongside the team.

And there is a team. You'll work directly with our copywriters, internal product managers, the sales team, and the people who handle data connection and attribution through Salesforce and our other marketing tools. You'll have a team around you, but want to be clear: we’re not looking for a “manager of managers”.

AI tools like Claude or Codex are part of your daily workflow, and you rely on them to get competent quickly in unfamiliar territory, whether that's GEO, GA4, or something we haven't thought of yet. You also know how to work with a highly creative founder: turning a lot of ideas into focused priorities, pushing back when something won't work, and making sure the good ones actually ship.

This role suits someone who's comfortable working without a finished playbook, and who would rather be in the work than above it.

What we need to see

  • Exceptional Enthusiasm
  • Extremely Creative Energy
  • You've led a marketing function and been accountable for its results
  • You've made a traditional or crowded category stand out with ideas of your own
  • AI is central to how you work, and you're comfortable enough with code to build or fix small things yourself
  • Real paid acquisition experience across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Bing, and you can run SEO and GEO by directing AI tools well
  • Hands-on experience with direct mail, paid ads, conferences, PR, or other high-attention channels, and you're happy traveling to meet clerks and work conferences alongside Sales
  • B2B SaaS background, and you've managed employees, contractors, and agencies

Nice to have: GovTech or public-sector experience, marketing more than one product at a time, and building measurement where little existed. EOS familiarity helps too!

How to apply

  1. Complete the Workable Form, and make sure to include your resume.
  2. There will questions to answer. Please make sure you answer them- we read these!

Requirements

jobs.excerpt: About Binance Binance is the global leading blockchain ecosystem, operating the world's largest digital asset trading platform by volume, serving over 300 million users across 100+ countries and regions.
jobs.description:
About Binance
Binance is the global leading blockchain ecosystem, operating the world's largest digital asset trading platform by volume, serving over 300 million users across 100+ countries and regions. We are committed to building a more open financial ecosystem and improving global access to financial services.

Binance is continuously building stock and related financial market products for global users. The relevant data will serve user-facing stock products and Binance AI business scenarios. We are seeking professionals with stock market experience to jointly build reliable, scalable data and financial AI capabilities.

Role Overview
You will participate in building the core data foundation for Binance's stock and related financial market businesses, responsible for the full pipeline from data source discovery, evaluation, ingestion, and integration to unified modeling, real-time processing, quality governance, and data services. Beyond completing defined integrations, we expect you to leverage industry expertise to continuously identify better data sources and technical solutions, enabling new markets, products, and data to serve trading products and AI quickly and reliably.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct research, technical evaluation, ingestion, integration, cleansing, standardization, computation, storage, and servicing of financial market data, covering securities master data, real-time and historical market data, fundamentals, corporate actions, indices, and business-required product and risk data; responsible for source ingestion, raw retention, and stable delivery to knowledge engineering pipelines for content-type data such as announcements, news, and research reports.
  • Design scalable unified data models and integration frameworks, handling different markets' trading calendars, time zones, currencies, security identifiers, listing relationships, lifecycles, and data corrections, supporting rapid onboarding of new markets and sources.
  • Build batch-stream unified data pipelines centered on Flink, continuously optimizing latency, throughput, query performance, stability, and cost, while supporting consumer trading products, research analysis, and AI scenarios.
  • Establish data quality and service level frameworks, taking responsibility for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency, and traceability; build automated reconciliation, anomaly detection, monitoring and alerting, raw data replay, backfill, and fault recovery capabilities.
  • Evaluate different sources (vendors, exchanges, APIs, file feeds, compliance collection) for coverage, quality, stability, revision mechanisms, and technical fit; collaborate with product, procurement, legal, and compliance teams to clarify usage, display, derivative, retention, and redistribution boundaries; drive rational primary/backup source strategies and alternatives.
  • Define data semantics, metric definitions, and service contracts jointly with trading product, data platform, AI engineering, and algorithm teams, ensuring consistent and reliable usage of the same stock facts across different products.
  • Drive data engineering efficiency and technical quality improvements, including metadata, data lineage, automated testing, CI/CD, task orchestration, capacity governance, and AI-assisted development.

Requirements

  • Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field; 5+ years of experience in data development, big data, or data platforms.
  • Familiar with stock markets and the investor research and decision-making workflow; understand trading mechanisms, market data, fundamentals and financial reports, corporate actions, valuation, and major market events; able to explain the complete pipeline of at least one type of financial data from source to user-facing product and key quality risks.
  • Proficient in SQL and Flink, with experience in large-scale real-time data processing, performance tuning, stability governance, and production issue troubleshooting.
  • Proficient in at least one of Java, Scala, or Python; familiar with Kafka, Spark, and ClickHouse, Doris, HBase, Elasticsearch, or other distributed storage and analytics technologies.
  • Familiar with data modeling, task scheduling, metadata, data lineage, data governance, and service levels; able to independently resolve cross-system data consistency issues.
  • High standards for data quality; able to design reproducible reconciliation, anomaly detection, backfill, and degradation strategies — not just completing data development tasks.
  • Experience with data source selection or production ingestion; able to articulate trade-offs between build vs. buy, multi-source verification, vendor dependency, and alternative solutions.
  • Strong business understanding and cross-team collaboration skills; able to translate trading, risk, research, or AI problems into clear data models and data contracts.

    • Bonus

  • Experience with stock data at brokerages, market data services, financial data, wealth management, or fintech platforms.
  • Familiarity with US stock market structure, trading calendars, pre/post-market sessions, corporate actions, and adjustment rules; experience with other stock markets also a plus.
  • Data experience with stock-related derivatives, ETFs, indices, or tokenized products.
  • Experience building low-latency market data pipelines, securities master data platforms, multi-market data models, quantitative research platforms, or large-scale backtesting data systems.
  • Experience with data anomaly detection, knowledge graphs, financial entity alignment, or building high-quality financial datasets for LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

Working at Binance

• Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow and offers excellent career development opportunities
• Work alongside diverse, world-class talent in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless
• Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects
• Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure
• Competitive salary and benefits
• Flexible working hours, remote-first, and casual work attire

The Promotions Strategy Manager will help determine what offers Fliff runs, who receives them, how success is measured, and how promotional spend can be optimized to drive customer engagement and long-term value.

Train a Hedgehog virtual assistant to answer customer questions by feeding your technical documentation and marketing material into Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) for an open source Large Language Model (LLM).

Guide prospective customers through virtual lab exercises so they can evaluate the same product features that you demonstrate in videos and discovery calls.

Assist prospective customers in designing, planning and scoping their AI cloud infrastructure.

Assist prospective customers in documenting their infrastructure as code, implementing Gitops, and integrating Hedgehog into their Gitops process.

Position Hedgehog relative to our partners and competitors.

Handle customer objections and build objection handling playbooks for SDRs using Hubspot.

Write blogs on AI network topics, Hedgehog capabilities, and Hedgehog customer stories.

Train new sellers at Hedgehog and our GTM partners on how to position Hedgehog in AI cloud infrastructure solutions.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or Graduate's Degree in computer science, data science, electronics, or engineering.

  • Industry experience with cloud networking and/or a strong understanding of cloud networking concepts like VPC, BGP EVPN, VXLAN, NAT, DHCP, ZTP, SDN, RoCEv2, ECN, PFC

  • Strong technical writing skills demonstrated by a reference portfolio

  • Strong oral communication with a gift to simply explain complex technical concepts with stories that non-technical people can easily understand

  • Basic video editing skills

Bonus:

  • Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field

  • Curious nature and desire to tinker: you want to pull things apart to see how they work

  • Love of new and emerging technologies

  • Ability to distill complicated ideas to just the right number of words

  • Experienced with technical writing using Markdown and Material for MkDocs

  • Experience with AI/ML models

  • Experience with open source software

  • Experience in embedded or network engineering, technical support, product testing, or QA

Hedgehog Benefits

  • World-class team

  • Engaging and interesting engineering problems
  • Competitive salary

  • Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision)

About Hedgehog

AI needs a new network. Hedgehog is the AI network. AI developers need new cloud infrastructure with high performance compute that trains and tunes generative AI models quickly and efficiently. They need ultra-low latency for AI inference so users get a human experience. Traditional cloud networks lack the congestion control and adaptive routing required to minimize AI job completion time. AI cloud builders find current reference architectures expensive and difficult to operate because they require specialized network engineers from a very limited number of vendors. Hedgehog delivers a high performance AI network that reduces AI job completion time up to 35% with flow scheduling and buffer management for congestion control and adaptive routing. Our low latency cloud network is multi-tenant for so that many teams can tune models, and many people can use model. A Hedgehog cloud network is easy to operate. If you know how to use AWS, Azure to Google Cloud, you can run a Hedgehog cloud. Die Upgrade Circular Economy ist ein vielversprechendes Konzept, um signifikante ökologische Einsparungen mit ökonomischen Chancen zu verbinden. Ihre Realisierung erfordert einen konstanten, planbaren Rückfluss gebrauchter Produkte. Nur dann können sie aufbereitet, upgegradet und erneut vermarktet werden. Doch genau hier liegen aktuell große Hürden: Viele Unternehmen kämpfen mit beschränkter Produktverfügbarkeit, intransparentem Zustandswissen und fragmentierten Rückführungskanälen. Beispiele wie Rebuy oder Backmarket zeigen in eng umrissenen Nischen das Potenzial, welches digitale Plattformen für die Rückführung und Realisierung der Upgrade Circular Economy haben können. Im Rahmen dieser Abschlussarbeit soll ein strukturiertes Vorgehensmodell für den Reverse Logistics Prozess in der Upgrade Circular Economy entwickelt werden.

  • Du entwickelst ein praxisnahes Vorgehensmodell zum Aufbau zirkulärer Plattformgeschäftsmodelle
  • Du validierst dein Modell in Workshops oder Experteninterviews mit namhaften Industrie‑ und Forschungspartnern

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Du studierst Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Informatik oder ähnliches
  • Du zeichnest Dich durch unternehmerisches Denken aus und hast idealerweise bereits darin erste Projekterfahrungen sammeln können

  • interessante, anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem qualifizierten und dynamischen Team

2015 riefen Parker und Van Alstyne die „Platform Revolution“ aus. Seither haben digitale Plattformen komplette Industrien in kürzester Zeit transformiert. Genau dieses disruptive Potenzial kann zum Katalysator der Circular Economy werden: Marktplätze und Sharing‑Plattformen wie Too Good To Go oder Metcycle zeigen bereits, wie Plattformen die zirkuläre Transformation beschleunigen können. Während Sharing‑Modelle sowie Reuse‑ und Recycling‑Ansätze bereits intensiv untersucht sind, fehlt es bislang an Wissen zu digitalen Plattformen für höherwertige Strategien wie Remanufacturing oder Upgrades. In dieser Abschlussarbeit analysierst du bestehende Plattformlösungen, identifizierst Best Practices und modellierst die Interaktionen der Akteure in einem skalierbaren Plattformökosystem. Am Ende entsteht ein Vorgehensmodell, das zeigt, wie digitale Plattformen ökologischen Impact und wirtschaftliche Attraktivität gleichermaßen steigern können.

Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.

The Director, Analytics is a senior level position responsible for shaping analytic strategy and delivering high-impact insights across complex customer engagements. This role reports directly to the VP of Analytics and operates as the highest-level analytic authority on our productionalized analytics engines and dashboards; driving methodological rigor, influencing business strategy, and ensuring analytics directly support contractual commitments and measurable performance outcomes.

Given the scale, visibility, and complexity of the work, this role requires deep healthcare domain expertise, advanced technical capability, strong executive presence, and the ability to operate autonomously in ambiguous environments.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives requiring advanced methodological expertise
  • Serve as trusted advisor on medical economics, risk, episodes, and dashboarding
  • Create rigorous performance management framework for team to be evaluated against
  • Ensure AI integration into analytics workflows

  • Influence strategic decisions through data-backed recommendations
  • Demonstrate measurable impact on customer performance outcomes and business growth
  • Build durable analytic infrastructure and frameworks that scale across engagements

What You'll Be Doing

  • Define and lead analytic strategy across large-scale, high-visibility engagements
  • Architect advanced analytic frameworks supporting medical economics, performance measurement, population health, and value-based care initiatives
  • Serve as the senior-most analytic escalation point for complex methodological or data integrity questions built in DBT (Spark, SQL) and Amazon Quicksight
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Actuarial, Data Science, Finance, and Customer Success
  • Ensure technical excellence and rigor in all analytic deliverables; establish quality standards and governance practices
  • Identify scalable opportunities for automation, reusable intellectual property, and analytic innovation
  • Present insights and strategic recommendations to senior and executive-level stakeholders
  • Mentor and develop Lead, Senior, and Data Analysts, elevating analytic capability across the team
  • Influence product and roadmap decisions through data-driven thought leadership

What You'll Bring

  • 8–10+ years of healthcare analytics experience, with experience in medical economics or risk and dashboarding required
  • Advanced SQL proficiency, including optimization of complex queries in large data environments
  • Advanced Dashboarding proficiency, experience with Quicksight a plus (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, etc. are acceptable)
  • Experience designing analytic methodologies and scalable frameworks
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior or executive stakeholders
  • Proven experience leading large, complex analytic initiatives and teams with significant business impact

  • Proficiency in DBT pipelines a plus
  • Experience shaping product or analytics roadmaps at a strategic level

What You'll Get

  • A flexible, remote friendly company with personality and heart
  • Employee driven programs and initiatives for personal and professional development
  • Become a member of the talented, energized, diverse and purpose-driven Arcadian Community.

About Arcadia

Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. We are growing fast and have emerged as a market leader in the highly competitive population health management software market and have been recognized by industry analysts KLAS, IDC, Forrester, and Chilmark for our leadership. For a better sense of our brand and products, please explore our website.

Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role:

We are looking for an SDE-2 Frontend-leaning Full-Stack Engineer to build the interface of CRM Opportunities, the deal and pipeline engine at the heart of our CRM. Opportunities is the system of record for every revenue motion our customers run, from lead conversion to closed-won, and the pipeline board is where our customers spend their working day.

This role is frontend-first. The hard problems here are interface problems: a drag-and-drop pipeline board that stays smooth with thousands of cards on screen, optimistic updates that roll back cleanly when a write fails, deal detail views assembled from arbitrary customer-defined custom fields, filters and saved views that hold up under real use, and keeping all of it coherent as several people move deals in the same pipeline at once. Getting this right is the difference between a CRM customers tolerate and one they trust.

You will own frontend features end-to-end in Vue.js, and you will go into the backend as the work requires — extending an API, shaping a response so the client does not have to over-fetch, adding an endpoint that serves the view you are building. You do not need to be a backend specialist; you do need to be unafraid of the server side and happy to work in it rather than filing a ticket. Senior engineers own the broader architecture and are there for design guidance and review.

What You Will Do:


    • Own frontend features across Opportunities in Vue.js — the pipeline board, deal detail views, stage and pipeline configuration, filters and saved views, bulk actions, and reporting surfaces

    • Build interactions that have to feel instant: drag-and-drop stage moves, inline edits, optimistic updates with clean rollback and clear error states when a write fails

    • Make large pipelines fast in the browser — virtualized and windowed lists, pagination and lazy loading, render and re-render cost, bundle size, and time to first meaningful paint on a board with thousands of deals

    • Design and maintain client-side state and data-fetching patterns (Pinia/Vuex, caching, invalidation) so the UI stays consistent without redundant round-trips

    • Handle concurrency in the interface: live updates when a teammate moves a deal, stale-data detection, and sensible conflict resolution

    • Render dynamic, customer-defined schemas — custom fields, custom objects, and per-workspace configuration — without special-casing every variation

    • Build reusable, well-composed components, and contribute to the shared design system rather than growing one-off UI

    • Work directly from designs, and push back with product and design where an interaction will not hold up in practice

    • Extend the backend where your feature needs it: adding or reshaping NestJS API endpoints, trimming over-fetching, and adjusting payloads for the view you are building

    • Write tests that matter — component and unit tests, plus end-to-end coverage of the flows customers cannot afford to have broken

    • Instrument the frontend: error tracking, real-user performance monitoring, and the event data needed to see how a feature is actually used

    • Care about accessibility, keyboard support, responsive layout, and cross-browser behavior as part of shipping, not as a follow-up

    • Take part in on-call for the surfaces you own, debug production issues, and contribute to postmortems

    • Write clear design docs for the features you own, and participate actively in design and code review

What You will Need:

    • 3+ years building and shipping production frontend applications

    • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, and depth in a component framework — Vue preferred, React fine if you are willing to work in Vue

    • Real experience with complex, stateful interfaces — not just forms and CRUD screens

    • Practical grasp of frontend performance: rendering cost, long lists, network waterfalls, bundle size, and how to profile rather than guess

    • Comfortable consuming and debugging REST APIs, and confident enough in a backend codebase (Node.js/NestJS or similar) to make the change your feature needs

    • Solid CSS and layout skills, and an eye for whether a build matches the design

    • Experience shipping and supporting features you wrote — design through deploy

    • Comfort working with a degree of ambiguity, asking good questions, and driving a task to done

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Built a board, kanban, table, grid, or calendar interface with drag-and-drop and large data volumes

    • Exposure to CRM, sales, pipeline, or workflow products

    • Experience with dynamic or schema-driven UI — rendering interfaces from customer-defined configuration

    • Worked on real-time or collaborative interfaces (WebSockets, polling, optimistic concurrency)

    • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, including white-labelled or themeable products

    • Familiarity with Vue 3, Pinia, Vite, and end-to-end testing (Playwright or Cypress)

    • Backend experience with Node.js/NestJS and MongoDB

    • Product instincts and a portfolio or GitHub of shipped work — we will want to look at interfaces you have built

Tech Skill Set:

    Vue.js (Vue 3, Pinia, Vite), TypeScript, modern CSS — backed by Node.js (NestJS) APIs, MongoDB, and Redis, running on a distributed microservices architecture over Istio service mesh.

What Success Looks Like:

    • Ships Opportunities frontend features to production reliably, with steadily less guidance over time

    • Builds interfaces that stay fast and predictable as workspaces grow from hundreds to millions of deals

    • Turns fiddly interaction problems into implementations that hold up in real customer use, not just in a demo

    • Leaves the component layer better composed and more reusable than they found it

    • Makes the backend change their feature needs instead of waiting on someone else

    • Debugs production issues independently and leaves behind better instrumentation than they found

    • Grows into owning larger, more ambiguous pieces of the product

Job Description:

ML Engineer

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As an ML Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the pipelines that power AI in our Healthcare Information Systems (HIS). We are looking for a practical, detail-oriented engineer who is passionate about MLOps, data reliability, and production stability.

In this role, you won’t just be building models; you will be ensuring those models work reliably in the real world. You will help bridge the gap between data science and software engineering by implementing automated workflows, managing cloud infrastructure, and ensuring our AI services are secure and scalable.

Key Responsibilities

1. MLOps & Deployment

  • Pipeline Development: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for machine learning, focusing on automated testing, model deployment, and version control (using tools like MLflow or Git).

  • Model Serving: Deploy ML models as scalable APIs and microservices, ensuring they meet performance and latency requirements for clinical use.

  • Monitoring: Implement basic monitoring tools to track model performance, data drift, and system health in production.

2. Data Engineering & Integration

  • Data Pipelines: Develop and optimize ETL processes to transform healthcare data (FHIR, HL7) into clean, usable datasets for model training and inference.

  • Feature Management: Help build and maintain feature stores and data layers that ensure consistency between training and production environments.

  • System Integration: Work closely with backend teams to integrate ML outputs into our core healthcare applications.

3. Engineering Best Practices

  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented Python code. Participate in code reviews to ensure system reliability.

  • Containerization: Use Docker and Kubernetes to package and orchestrate ML workloads across different environments.

  • Security & Compliance: Follow established protocols to ensure all data handling and deployments meet HIPAA and HITRUST security standards.

Your Skills and Expertise
To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in software engineering or data engineering, with at least 2 years focused on machine learning production environments.

AND

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with SQL. Knowledge of a compiled language (like Go or Java) is a plus.

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker).

  • ML Tools: Familiarity with ML libraries (PyTorch or Scikit-learn) and MLOps tools (like Airflow, Prefect, BentoML, or Kubeflow).

  • Data Tools: Experience with data processing frameworks (like Pandas, Spark, or dbt).

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Familiarity with deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) or using frameworks like LangChain.

  • Experience working in a regulated environment (Healthcare, Finance, etc.).

  • Understanding of API design and microservices architecture.

Work location:

  • Remote

Travel: May include up to 10% domestic

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for

You’ll own the day-to-day Payment Operations function supporting Circle Payments Network, with accountability for operational coverage, queue performance, escalations, investigation quality, team capability, and process execution across a 24x7 environment. You’ll develop analysts from onboarding through independent case ownership, maintain a high bar for operational quality, and ensure the team has the processes, training, documentation, and performance management needed to operate effectively. You’ll also be the domain expert on the network and the senior operational escalation point for issues that cannot be resolved within the team.

What you'll work on

  • Own shift design, rostering, coverage planning, and handoffs across a 24x7 model, including leave, surge and holiday planning, and the coverage math that sits behind it.

  • Own live queue management, ensuring incoming partner queries and detected exceptions are picked up, triaged, worked, and closed within SLA.

  • Own the escalation path. Senior Analysts are the first escalation point and work the hardest cases; you take what they cannot resolve and decide when an issue needs to leave the team and move to Engineering, Product, or partner-facing leadership.

  • Build and run analyst onboarding, continuous training, certification, and competency development, using actual case output to identify individual gaps, build targeted improvement plans, and develop analysts from day one through independent handling of the full query mix.

  • Establish and operate the QC program, including case sampling, review, calibration, error taxonomy, investigation standards, and feedback loops into training and SOPs.

  • Own the operational metrics the function reports on, including Time to Acknowledge (TTA), Time to Resolve (TTR), SLA compliance, and volume and failure trends by shift, partner, and rail; produce the weekly operations readout and be able to explain any number in it.

  • Develop and maintain current, usable SOPs and runbooks that reflect how the team actually works; close gaps between practice and documentation, and run process changes through communication, training, adoption verification, and measurement.

What you'll bring to Circle

Core requirements

  • 8+ years in payment operations, payment investigations, settlement operations, or a comparable operations function at a payments company, fintech, or bank.

  • 2+ years directly managing a team of operations analysts as a Team Lead, Assistant Manager, or Manager, with real accountability for their output and not just work allocation; you are still hands-on and want to stay that way.

  • Hands-on ownership of at least one full shift roster in a 24x7 or extended-coverage operation; you have built the roster, run the coverage math, and handled the exceptions.

  • Demonstrated ownership of training and ramp; you can name analysts you took from new to independent and describe how you developed them.

  • Demonstrated ownership of process and documentation; you have written SOPs and runbooks that other people used, not just followed someone else’s.

  • Cross-border payments depth, including correspondent banking, SWIFT/MT103, local rails, reconciliation, exception handling, and settlement investigations.

  • Comfortable working from data; you set targets, track them, and can defend the numbers.

What will make you stand out

  • You have done this in a team that was being built, not one that was already running; you set the process rather than inheriting it.

  • You have run an operation where the SLA mattered to a customer or partner, and you can describe what you changed to hit it.

  • You have exposure to stablecoins, crypto rails, or digital assets, or clear evidence that you pick up new domains quickly.

  • You actively use AI tooling in your own work and have a point of view on where it can—and cannot—improve operations.

  • Experience with Rebuy, Smart Cart, or similar Shopify upsell and cart-optimization tools.
  • Direct experience working with DTC e-commerce brands.

The Reddit Consumer Engineering organization builds and scales the products that Redditors use directly to discover content, participate in communities, and connect with others. Sitting at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and core user journeys, Product Engineers in Consumer Engineering partner directly with Product Managers, Designers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and Frontend Engineers to build, experiment with, and scale features that power how hundreds of millions of users discover, join, navigate, and engage with Reddit.

This centralized role hires across several high-impact consumer teams, including:

  • Core Product & Feeds: Home Experience, Recommendations & Content Discovery, Content Contribution
  • Community & Presence: Reddit Pro, Youth Experience & Teen Safety, Creator Tools

What You’ll Do

  • Cross-Functional Product Architecture: Partner closely with Product Management, Product Design, Data Science, and Client Engineers (iOS/Android/Web) to translate business and user needs into reliable, low-latency technical solutions.
  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the full software lifecycle for major product initiatives from technical design docs and API contracts to development, testing, rollout, and observability.
  • Metrics & Experimentation-Led Engineering: Design, build, and evaluate A/B experiments. Work with tools like BigQuery, HEX, or Firebase to analyze user behavior, conversion funnels, and retention loops to make data-backed engineering decisions.
  • API & System Performance: Build and maintain scalable APIs (GraphQL, REST, gRPC) and distributed backend services optimized for client consumption and consumer UI performance.
  • Technical Rigor & Modern Tooling: Establish engineering best practices, improve developer workflows, mentor teammates, and use modern, AI-integrated tools to ship high-quality products efficiently.

  • Technical Rigor at Scale: 5+ years of hands-on backend development experience building and operating large-scale distributed serving systems in high-concurrency environments.
  • Bias for Action: Self-directed, innovative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-paced product environments where balancing velocity with system reliability is essential.
  • Collaborative Communicator: Outstanding communication skills with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment in fully remote or hybrid team environments.

jobs.description:
About HopSkipDrive

At HopSkipDrive, our mission is to create opportunity for all through mobility. We're the leader in safe, fast, and simple supplemental student transportation. Through our marketplace, we connect kids to highly-vetted caregivers on wheels. Through our software, we solve the biggest transportation challenges facing schools and school districts across the country.

Founded by three moms as a solution to their own transportation challenges, we've now facilitated more than five million rides across over over 20states. We continue to grow rapidly — earning a spot on the Inc. 5000 list numerous times and the Deloitte 500 Fast-Growing Technology list. HopSkipDrive is a Series D company and has raised $100M to date.

How we work

We use AI every day, and not as a productivity add-on. It's woven into how we work at every level. We're rethinking how work gets done, who does what, and what a small team can accomplish. If you've already built AI into how you work, you'll hit the ground running. If you haven't, you'll need to be ready to learn fast and work differently than you have before.

Who We Are

We are a driven, mission-focused team, passionate about transforming transportation through innovation and impact. Rather than just selling a service, we build lasting partnerships with school districts and government agencies, solving their toughest challenges with our vetted CareDriver marketplace and cutting-edge solutions.

As a Revenue team, our goal is clear: drive revenue growth, deliver value to our clients, and redefine what’s possible in mobility—while making a meaningful difference for those who need it most.

As Strategic Account Executives, we provide this value to net-new prospective business partners in particular by telling the HopSkipDrive story, connecting our unique value propositions to their needs, creating urgency, and closing the deal to bring the solutions to reality. We achieve this by challenging the status quo and pushing our prospects to innovate alongside us.

To excel in this role, you will be expected to take ownership of and demonstrate the following key job responsibilities:

  • Always be Closing: Effectively negotiate terms, and execute by closing new business. After the initial contract is executed, convert to a paying client, and grow that account during the initial onboarding period.
  • Always Build Pipeline: You will be supported by a worldclass SDR team but best performing AEs source around 20-30% of their own pipeline plus multithread all the time.
  • Challenge the Status Quo: Lead every conversation with an insight, not a pitch. Whether in person, by phone, or on video — Teach the prospect something they haven’t considered, Tailor the message to their specific situation and role, and Take Control of the process to create urgency and drive the deal forward.
  • Demonstrate Curiosity and Compassion: Ask targeted questions and listen to understand unspoken concerns, political dynamics, and the real decision-making structure across the buying committee. Use those insights to execute, teaching each stakeholder a new perspective on their problem, tailoring the message to their priorities, and taking control of the process to build consensus and create urgency toward a decision.
  • Multi-Threaded Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain relationships across multiple stakeholders in the buying committee simultaneously — including transportation directors, operations leads, finance, and executive leadership — mapping the full decision-making structure, identifying the economic buyer, and driving organizational alignment toward close.
  • Pipeline Qualification Discipline: Apply MEDDPICC qualification rigor to every deal. About Aegis Ventures

Aegis Ventures is a next-generation startup studio that partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to originate, launch, and scale transformative companies, with a focus on artificial intelligence. We have launched 6 innovative companies to date and are just getting started.

About the Company

Optain is a revolutionary healthcare company that uses groundbreaking software and hardware technology to rethink care. We use the eye as a window to the body to improve the way we detect and manage eye and systemic conditions. Optain is committed to expanding and improving care through the introduction of AI and machine learning technology in frontline care settings at an accessible price. This not only promotes greater access to care, but promises to reduce the strains of overburdened healthcare systems.

Originally founded in Australia in 2019, Optain seeks to commercialize the inventions of Professor Mingguang He, a preeminent clinician-scientist and scholar in the field of ophthalmology. Optain has achieved regulatory approval and commercial adoption of its product suite in global markets, including Australia, Europe, and more.

In 2025, Optain received US FDA clearance for its Resolve retinal camera. Optain also recently closed a Series A funding round led by Insight Partners with participation from seven leading U.S. health system investors, including Memorial Hermann Health System, Northwell Health, Novant Health, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, and UPMC. These systems collectively deliver care to 28 million patients across 25 states and have begun deploying Optain's platform across their networks, rapidly accelerating the company's footprint and expanding screening access nationwide.

About the Job

As the Product Operations and Support Specialist, you will be the escalation point for customers using Optain’s robotic retinal camera and supporting software. Because our product is a tightly integrated hardware-software medical device deployed in live clinical settings, you will troubleshoot issues that span device hardware, image capture software, image quality, connectivity, EHR integrations, and downstream teleophthalmology grading workflows. In the U.S., Optain pairs its FDA-cleared Resolve camera with rapid teleophthalmology grading; in international markets, Optain offers AI-enabled Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) for screening common eye diseases and cardiovascular risk.

This is a high-ownership, U.S.-based remote role on a growing product team, reporting to the VP of Product. Beyond hands-on Tier 2 support, issue investigation, and medical device complaint handling, you will enable our Customer Support team, feed real-world signal back to the Product team, and own the internal operations, tooling, and projects that make the Product and Support teams more effective.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as Tier 2 support for customers who escalate device feedback, complaints, and semi-technical product issues; reproducing, diagnosing, and resolving problems across the hardware-software boundary, distinguishing camera or hardware faults from software, image-quality, connectivity, EHR-integration, or user technique issues.
  • Capture, document, and route device feedback and complaints in line with Optain’s quality management system and applicable regulations (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR), recognizing when feedback may constitute a reportable complaint or potential adverse event and escalating appropriately to Quality and Regulatory.
  • Support the Customer Success team with semi-technical product and onboarding questions, acting as the bridge between front-line CS and Engineering support. Contribute to knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and training resources that enable CS to resolve more issues independently.
  • Own internal operations and projects for the product team, including specifying requirements for internal support tooling, improving support and complaint-handling workflows, and coordinating cross-functional projects from intake to delivery.
  • Support Quality in tracking and analyzing support and complaint trends, translate recurring problems into prioritized product improvement recommendations, and serve as a voice of the customer within the product organization.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Customer Success to ensure issues are resolved quickly while meeting the documentation rigor required of a regulated medical device.

What You'll Need

  • 3+ years in technical support, product support, application support, or product operations for software as a medical device (SaMD), or combined hardware software medical device product.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot across hardware-software boundaries, isolating whether a problem originates in a hardware device, software, image quality, connectivity, or user technique. Ability to reproduce issues occurring on equipment at a remote customer site.
  • Familiarity working within a quality management system and complaint-handling processes in a regulated environment (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR, ISO 13485, or EU MDR), including an understanding of when an issue may be a reportable complaint or adverse event.
  • Strong written communication, with a track record of building knowledge base articles, runbooks, or training that enables less-technical teammates to resolve issues independently. Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
  • Operational initiative and project ownership experience, including gathering requirements for internal tools or processes, prioritizing competing work, and driving cross-functional projects to completion with minimal oversight in a remote team setting.
  • Bonus: experience with imaging medical devices, telemedicine, EHR integrations, or clinical workflows in a primary care or point-of-care setting.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package, including a strong base salary, performance-based bonus, and the chance to earn equity upside in Optain.
  • This role is scoped to grow. As the US footprint expands, we expect the person in it to take on broader ownership of customer operations.
  • Top-tier health, vision, and dental benefits.
  • Generous monthly health and wellness reimbursement.
  • Unparalleled exposure to business scaling at the intersection of artificial intelligence and healthcare.
  • The opportunity to help solve difficult problems and collaborate with world-class experts from healthcare provider networks, academia, and industry.
  • A chance to work with a highly talented, close-knit team and world-leading mentors who can act as a support network and sounding board throughout your professional journey.

Why Optain?Make a real difference: Your work will help solve difficult problems as you collaborate with world-class experts from healthcare provider networks, academia, and industry. Join Optain in transforming healthcare with AI!

jobs.title: Client Support Analyst, EPIC Loan Systems
jobs.excerpt: We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity.
jobs.description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

About EPIC Loan Systems

EPIC Loan Systems is a specialized financial technology company providing lending software solutions to businesses in the lending industry. EPIC has been part of Aquila since 2018, providing specialized lending software that helps clients manage their operations, supported by a team committed to solving problems and building lasting relationships.

Its core product is a Loan Management System that helps lenders manage their end-to-end lending operations, from loan processing and administration to reporting and data management.

The company focuses on simplifying complex lending processes, improving operational efficiency, and building long-term relationships with its clients. As part of Aquila and the broader Constellation Software group, EPIC combines the agility of a specialized software business with the support and resources of an established global organization.

Who we need

Reporting to the Client Support Lead, we are hiring a Client Support Analyst. As part of a small, collaborative team, you will play a key role in shaping the client experience, combining technical curiosity with thoughtful, responsive support. You will look beyond the immediate issue to uncover its root cause, collaborate directly with developers, and see challenges through to resolution. Your work will help clients feel heard, build confidence in the solutions we provide, and strengthen the relationships that set our service apart.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates across the US, with working hours of 8:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

What’s in it for you

Make a meaningful difference. You will go beyond resolving tickets to become a trusted partner to clients who rely on EPIC Loan Systems to manage their lending operations. You will build relationships, understand their challenges, and help them move forward with confidence. Your follow-through and problem-solving will directly impact their experience and their ability to use the software effectively.

Turn complex challenges into better solutions. You will have the opportunity to dig deeper, ask questions, and uncover what is really happening when something does not work as expected. Working closely with clients and developers, you will see issues through to resolution and contribute insights that can prevent recurring problems and improve the experience for other clients. You will have the satisfaction of knowing your work makes a difference beyond the individual issue.

Build your expertise. You will join a small team where your contributions are visible, your ideas are welcome, and you can take meaningful ownership of your work. You will develop specialized knowledge of lending technology, strengthen your technical and client relationship skills, and gain exposure to different parts of the business. As part of Aquila and the broader Constellation Software network, you will also have access to learning opportunities and potential career paths beyond client support.

As our new Client Support Analyst, you will

  • Build trusted client relationships. You will be a reliable point of contact for clients, responding to questions and concerns primarily through email, with phone and messaging support as needed. You will take the time to understand what clients are experiencing, communicate clearly and empathetically, and keep them informed as you work toward a resolution.

  • Investigate and resolve complex issues. You will look beyond the initial request to understand the underlying problem, reproduce issues, and identify possible causes. You will use your technical curiosity, available resources, and collaboration with colleagues to find practical solutions, escalating when needed while maintaining ownership of the client experience.

  • Connect clients with the people who can help. You will work closely with the development team and other internal partners to investigate technical challenges, share relevant information, and move issues toward resolution. You will translate client concerns into clear, actionable details and explain technical findings in language clients can understand.

  • Turn individual solutions into lasting improvements. You will accurately document investigations, resolutions, and client interactions, helping the team build knowledge and identify recurring issues. You will share observations and client feedback that can improve troubleshooting, support practices, and the overall client experience.

  • Take ownership in a collaborative team. You will manage and prioritize your support requests, follow through on commitments, and proactively communicate progress and potential roadblocks. You will contribute to a small team where sharing knowledge, asking for help, and supporting one another are essential to delivering consistent client service.

  • Support a reliable client experience. You will assist with scheduled software releases and occasional after-hours support to help clients navigate changes or unexpected issues. You will bring flexibility, attention to detail, and a commitment to keeping clients informed and supported.

You bring

  • The client support experience. You have experience supporting customers or clients, ideally in a software or technology environment. You know how to listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions, and guide people through challenges while creating a positive experience.

  • The investigative mindset. You enjoy figuring out how things work and getting to the root of a problem. You can assess information, test possible explanations, and work through unfamiliar challenges systematically rather than relying on quick assumptions.

  • The technical aptitude. You are comfortable learning new software, navigating digital tools, and troubleshooting technical issues. You can document findings clearly and communicate effectively with technical colleagues. Experience supporting SaaS platforms or financial technology is an asset, but you do not need to be a developer to succeed in this role.

  • The communication skills. You can explain complex information in clear, accessible language and adapt your approach to different audiences. You bring empathy and patience to challenging conversations and keep clients informed, even when an issue takes time to resolve.

  • The ownership and organization. You can manage multiple requests, assess priorities, and maintain accurate records of your work. You follow through on commitments, recognize when to escalate, and proactively communicate updates and potential roadblocks.

  • The collaborative approach. You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment while staying connected to your team. You welcome feedback, share knowledge, and ask for help when it leads to a better outcome for the client.

  • The flexibility. You can occasionally support scheduled evening software releases and participate in after-hours or weekend on-call coverage when required. You understand the importance of being available to help when clients need additional support.

Why join?

EPIC Loan Systems and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

Compensation

At EPIC Loan Systems and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.

  • A virtual interview with the Client Support Lead and a team member to explore your approach to client relationships, technical troubleshooting, problem-solving, and managing competing priorities.

  • A final virtual interview with the General Manager to discuss your working style, collaboration, and alignment with the team’s approach to client service. You will have the opportunity to learn more about the role and ask questions.

Aquila and EPIC Loan Systems promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request.

We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

jobs.description:
POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position:Senior Mechanical Designer

Department:Utilities & Central Energy (UCE)

Reporting Relationship:Lead Designer, UCE

COMPANY BACKGROUND

KFI Engineers is a recognized industry leader in facility infrastructure design and performance. Since 1996, our culture of collaboration and unique capabilities have allowed us to make a difference in the way infrastructure and processing projects are delivered.

Headquartered in St. Paul, MN, with numerous regional offices throughout the United States, and a team of hundreds of professionals, we offer opportunities to continue your career with mentorship programs, career growth support, and continued education. With KFI, we find a way to provide creative solutions to unique projects while providing the same care we would expect if we were the client. For more information about KFI Engineers and our culture, please visit.

The Utilities and Central Energy (UCE) group specializes in large central plant work, particularly for district energy serving cities, universities, hospitals, and manufacturing campuses. Our expertise covers both energy production and distribution. We have expertise in sustainable energy production, simple and combined cycle, combined heat and power, and medium voltage power. Our clients look for us to lead large complex projects from concept to completion, including startup, check-out, and commissioning.

POSITION OVERVIEW & RESPONSIBILITIES

The Senior Mechanical Designer (level IV) plays a key role in the successful execution of projects, focusing primarily on the production of AutoCAD, Plant 3D, and Revit drawings. The Senior Mechanical Designer is responsible for producing quality construction documents and coordinating design work with other engineering disciplines. The successful candidate will also be expected to work within a team environment and collaborate with other project team members.

The Senior Mechanical Designer position is an advanced role focused on taking on significant responsibility in design tasks with an emphasis on independent work. This role involves completing design documents for assigned projects, mentoring junior designers, and contributing to project management.

Specific responsibilities will include, but not be limited to, the following:

  • Create comprehensive industrial project drawings, including General Arrangements, PIDs, 3D models, piping, and Isometrics.
  • Design complete systems for assigned projects, managing the preparation of drawing documents.
  • Coordinate work with stakeholders, providing technical support and work direction while managing client relationships.
  • Schedule and lead design meetings, drawing reviews, and act as a KFI Representative at Project Meetings.
  • Plan and execute field work, gathering accurate information and preparing thoroughly for job site visits.
  • Take ownership of tasks, bringing them to completion while seeking assistance when needed.
  • Estimate project hours, scope of work, and contribute to budget and schedule creation.
  • Provide leadership, guiding the efforts and development of other designers, including on-the-job training.
  • Lead entire projects, demonstrating project management skills from inception to completion.
  • Maintain a proactive approach to work, continuously improving processes and technical skills.
  • Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • An AAS Degree in design/drafting or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of 10+ years of design experience.
  • Expertise in 3D design, mechanical general arrangements, piping systems, and piping and instrumentation diagrams.
  • Experience in the review of mechanical equipment drawings.
  • Demonstrated excellence in sophisticated layouts, measuring, technical knowledge of systems and codes.
  • Ability to complete contract plans for small or large mechanical projects.
  • Ability to perform all design tasks not requiring engineering professional judgment independently.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to work independently on complex projects.
  • Highly motivated professional with a “can do” attitude, team-oriented approach, and strong work ethic.
  • Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, maintain accurate records, and manage information effectively.
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with others and represent the company professionally.
  • Demonstrated leadership qualities, including the capacity to guide and develop junior team members.
  • Proficiency with computer technology and business software, including Microsoft Office.
  • Travel: May include up to 10% domestic travel

Preferred

  • Proficiency with AutoCAD Plant 3D software and/or Revit.
  • 3+ years of industrial plant design experience.

Working Conditions

  • Some work locations will feature the tough terrain typical of construction sites.

CORE BEHAVIORS

Accountable

  • Demonstrates persistence in the achievement of goals.
  • Acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Takes responsibility for own actions.

Business Focus

  • Demonstrates agility, adapts well to changes.
  • Works well under pressure.
  • Meets commitments to internal/external customers.

Project Execution

  • Plans projects well, managing last-minute rushes and disruptions.
  • Balances Speed and Quality.
  • Looks for improvement in our delivery, tools and processes.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Demonstrates Respect for Others

  • Keeps others adequately informed.
  • Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views.
  • Adapts communication style and method based on audience and situation.

Team Player

  • Balances team and individual responsibilities.
  • Shares expertise with others.
  • Inspires respect and trust.

Benefits:

At KFI, our comprehensive benefit program provides our employees with the resources to support their health, wellness and financial well-being. Full-Time employees have access to:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance coverage
  • Virtual health services
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) & Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) for HDHP enrollees with KFI contributions
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • 401(k) plan
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance, life and AD&D insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Time Off to include Earned Sick and Safe Time in accordance with state laws
  • Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Company Paid Holidays
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Bereavement Leave
  • Voluntary benefits offered include life, accident, critical illness coverage

Compensation: $50.70 - $63.40 per hour. The final agreed upon compensation is based on individual qualifications, experience, work location, and education. This position is eligible for an annual bonus.

jobs.description:
Network Security Integration Engineer – Mid-Level


Program: Army Global Unified Network (AGUN)
Location: Remote | Up to 10% Travel, *Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes, if an offer letter is extended to you.

Clearance Required: Active Secret
Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship Required


Help Secure and Modernize the U.S. Army's Global Network!

Leidos is seeking an experienced Mid-Level Network Security Integration Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) program.

This is an exciting opportunity to help modernize and secure the Army's global network infrastructure, ensuring reliable and protected communications for critical military operations worldwide.

In this remote role, you'll focus on firewall integration, secure network connectivity, security policy configuration, and network modernization. You'll work with engineering, cybersecurity, and migration teams to integrate modern security technologies into the Army's enterprise network.

We're looking for a hands-on Network Security Engineer with strong firewall experience, preferably Palo Alto, who can integrate, configure, and troubleshoot enterprise security solutions.


What You'll Do

  • Engineer and integrate site-specific firewall and network security solutions across the Army's global network.
  • Perform network device discovery, validate management connectivity, and identify migration dependencies.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) and other enterprise firewall technologies.
  • Configure and maintain firewall policies, security zones, access control lists (ACLs), NAT, and network segmentation.
  • Review legacy firewall configurations and support the integration of security policies into modernized network environments.
  • Support Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and secure remote access technologies.
  • Troubleshoot firewall policy conflicts, VPN connectivity, routing, and secure network access issues.
  • Analyze network traffic, firewall logs, and security events to identify and resolve technical problems.
  • Support network security migration planning, testing, implementation, and post-migration validation.
  • Perform firewall software upgrades, patching, configuration changes, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Work with cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with DoD security requirements and STIGs.
  • Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, and network security hardening.
  • Develop site integration plans, test configurations, network diagrams, security policy documentation, and migration validation records.
  • Participate in technical reviews, readiness assessments, and security validation activities.
  • Coordinate with engineering and operations teams to ensure successful integration and operational handoff.
  • Work independently on assigned technical tasks while collaborating with senior engineers on complex issues.

What We're Looking For

  • Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field with 4–8 years of relevant experience, or approximately 8–12 years of relevant experience without a degree.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (such as Security+) and an approved Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise firewall configuration, integration, management, and troubleshooting, preferably Palo Alto Networks.
  • Strong knowledge of firewall security policies, ACLs, NAT, security zones, and network segmentation.
  • Experience supporting network security integrations, firewall migrations, or enterprise network modernization.
  • Understanding of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, IPSec, VPNs, and Layer 2/Layer 3 routing.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and secure remote access technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting firewall policy conflicts, network connectivity, and security performance issues.
  • Familiarity with Palo Alto Panorama, Cisco management platforms, or similar tools.
  • Experience with firewall patching, upgrades, configuration management, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Knowledge of DoD STIGs, network security hardening, and cybersecurity compliance.
  • Experience creating technical documentation, firewall configuration records, and network security diagrams.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with geographically dispersed engineering teams.
  • Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts when needed for migration activities.
  • Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. Army, DISA, or other DoD enterprise networks.
  • Palo Alto Networks security certification (such as PCNSE or a current equivalent), CCNA, or CCNP.
  • Experience with large-scale firewall migrations, security policy conversions, and enterprise network transformation.
  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, and GlobalProtect.
  • Experience with Cisco Secure Firewall, Juniper SRX, or other enterprise firewall platforms.
  • Experience with ZTNA solutions such as AppGate.
  • Knowledge of SD-WAN, MPLS, and enterprise network segmentation.
  • Experience with firewall rule optimization and security configuration validation.
  • Familiarity with virtualized firewalls, cloud security, and hybrid networks.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet.
  • Experience with Python scripting for network security automation.
  • Experience using Wireshark, tcpdump, or similar network troubleshooting tools.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management, RMF, and security compliance processes.
  • Experience supporting large, geographically dispersed enterprise networks.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced network security technologies while supporting a mission that directly impacts the U.S. Army's global communications.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, solve challenging security problems, and help modernize critical network infrastructure.


If you're a cleared Network Security Engineer with hands-on firewall experience who enjoys integrating secure network technologies and solving complex technical challenges, we'd like to hear from you!

Join Leidos and help secure the future of the Army's global network. Apply today!

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
