jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineer to lead the design, development, deployment, and ongoing management of software applications.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineer to lead the design, development, deployment, and ongoing management of software applications. This role requires a strong combination of technical expertise, independent problem-solving, project ownership, and the ability to leverage modern AI-assisted development tools, including Claude and Claude Code, to accelerate software delivery.
The ideal candidate is a self-directed engineer who can take high-level business requirements, translate them into actionable technical specifications, manage development tasks, and deliver reliable, scalable, and maintainable applications. This individual should be comfortable owning the full software development lifecycle, from initial requirements gathering and solution architecture through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
We are particularly interested in candidates who embrace AI-assisted software engineering practices and understand how to effectively incorporate AI-generated code into professional development workflows while maintaining high standards for quality, security, and maintainability.

What Success Looks Like

A successful candidate will be able to take ownership of a software initiative with minimal oversight, working directly with stakeholders to understand business needs and translating those needs into a well-defined technical solution. They will effectively manage their own development backlog, leverage AI-assisted coding tools to improve productivity, and consistently deliver high-quality applications that are secure, reliable, and maintainable.

Beyond writing code, this individual will demonstrate strong technical judgment, proactive communication, and accountability for the full lifecycle of the applications they develop. They will balance development speed with engineering discipline, ensuring that AI-assisted development contributes to measurable improvements in delivery efficiency without compromising software quality.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an engineer who is equally comfortable designing solutions, writing code, managing development activities, and owning applications in production. The ideal candidate combines the technical depth of a senior engineer with the independence and delivery mindset of a technical lead.
They are enthusiastic about the evolving role of AI in software engineering, have practical experience using tools such as Claude to accelerate development, and understand that effective software delivery requires more than generating code. It requires thoughtful architecture, disciplined validation, strong communication, and end-to-end ownership of the solution.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering and Solution Design

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather, clarify, and document functional and nonfunctional requirements.
  • Translate business objectives into technical specifications, application designs, and actionable development tasks.
  • Identify technical dependencies, potential risks, and opportunities to simplify or improve proposed solutions.
  • Design scalable, secure, and maintainable application architectures aligned with business requirements.
  • Provide technical recommendations and communicate architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Software Development and AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain applications, APIs, integrations, and supporting services.
  • Leverage Claude, Claude Code, and other AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, documentation, and test generation.
  • Apply effective prompt engineering and context management techniques to guide AI-assisted development.
  • Review, validate, and refine AI-generated code to ensure functional correctness, security, performance, and adherence to engineering standards.
  • Develop reusable software components and establish consistent development patterns.
  • Implement automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing to support reliable application delivery.
  • Maintain clean, well-structured, and documented code using established software engineering principles.

Development Planning and Task Management

  • Independently manage development activities from initial requirements through successful delivery.
  • Break complex initiatives into manageable tasks with clearly defined deliverables, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
  • Estimate development effort, establish realistic timelines, and communicate progress against milestones.
  • Use project management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar platforms to organize and track development work.
  • Proactively identify blockers, manage competing priorities, and communicate risks or changes to project timelines.
  • Coordinate technical activities with other engineers, stakeholders, and external partners as needed.

Application Deployment and Management

  • Own the deployment, configuration, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance of software applications.
  • Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines to support consistent and reliable software releases.
  • Implement appropriate logging, monitoring, exception handling, and alerting capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable resolutions.

This capability is critical to help argenx scale patient support across indications and therapeutic areas to reach 50,000 patients by 2030. You will establish, evolve and maintain a multi-year digital capability roadmap and prioritized product backlog, in close partnership with Patient Experience, Patient Services, Patient Marketing, Patient Advocacy and other business owners to identify opportunities and guide iterative delivery with Digital Technology (DT) and Insights & Analytics. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Patient Experience digital capability strategy, roadmap and development

  • Clarify responsibilities and decision rights with Patient Experience, Patient Marketing/Engagement, Patient Services, Market Access, DT, and other partners; maintain clear decision rights and accountabilities between business ownership, digital product management, and technical delivery.

jobs.description:
Evvnt is an event marketing and ticketing platform. Organisers list events once and we syndicate them to hundreds of partner sites by location and category, run targeted email promotion, and sell tickets (including reserved seating) with Stripe-backed checkout. Our public event directory lists hundreds of thousands of events, and partners embed our event discovery plugins on their own sites.

We are hiring a mid-level developer to own day-to-day support and improvement of the platform. Roughly half the role is keeping the product healthy: triaging bugs, fixing them properly, and handling the questions our support team can't answer. The other half is shipping features alongside the rest of the team

You'll report to the CTO and work closely with product and support.

What you'll do

  • Own the support queue for engineering: triage escalated tickets, reproduce issues, fix root causes and close the loop with support and the customer.
  • Ship features across the Rails backend and Bootstrap frontend, from ticketing and checkout to organiser-facing admin screens.
  • Build and extend integrations with partners including Stripe (payments), Sendgrid(emails), seats.io (seating plans) and our partner-facing JS plugin.
  • Write tests for what you ship and improve coverage around the areas you touch.
  • Review pull requests, including AI-assisted PRs, and give clear, constructive feedback.
  • Help keep the platform fast and reliable: investigate slow queries, background job failures and production alerts.
  • Contribute to our infrastructure work.
  • Document what you learn so the next person (or agent) doesn't have to rediscover it.

Our stack

  • Backend: Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL (RDS)
  • Frontend: Rails views, Tailwind, JavaScript; an embeddable JS discovery plugin
  • Payments: Stripe
  • Seating: seats.io
  • Infrastructure AWS: ECS, RDS, ALB; CloudFormation and Terraform
  • CI/CD: GitHub, Jenkins
  • Tooling: AI coding agents used across the team for drafting PRs and investigation

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of professional software development, with at least 2 years building and maintaining Ruby on Rails applications in production.
  • Solid SQL and PostgreSQL skills: you can read a query plan, add the right index and spot an N+1.
  • Comfortable across the stack: server-rendered views, JavaScript, HTML/CSS and a CSS framework such as Bootstrap.
  • Experience supporting a live product: debugging from logs and error reports, reproducing customer issues and shipping fixes without breaking adjacent features.
  • Testing as a habit: RSpec for unit and request specs, Playwright (or similar) for end-to-end, and an instinct for which tests are worth writing.
  • Git and pull-request workflows, with clear commit messages and reviews.
  • Good written communication: you can explain a bug, a fix or a trade-off to a non-engineer.
  • Pragmatic judgement about when to patch, when to refactor and when to ask.

Nice to have

  • Stripe or another payment provider.
  • Reserved-seating or ticketing systems; seats.io specifically is a bonus.
  • AWS and infrastructure-as-code, ideally Terraform.
  • Background job systems (Sidekiq or similar) and performance work at scale.
  • Building embeddable JavaScript widgets or working on SEO for large content sites.
  • Using AI coding assistants effectively, and reviewing their output critically.
  • Experience in a small team where you've worn several hats.

How we work

We're a small engineering team, so you'll see work through from ticket to production rather than owning one narrow slice. Work is tracked in Shortcut; most features ship as small PRs behind review, with a per-PR test environment to check against before merge.

We use AI coding agents, including for drafting pull requests, and we expect you to use them too. The job is to direct and review that work well, not to type faster: you own what merges, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft.

Salary: $80,000 – $120,000 / year

jobs.excerpt: Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity EngineerAbout L4B SoftwareL4B Software specializes in embedded software engineering, platform development and product cybersecurity.
jobs.description:
Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer

About L4B Software

L4B Software specializes in embedded software engineering, platform development and product cybersecurity. We work with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, board support packages (BSPs) and real-time embedded systems to develop reliable, secure and maintainable software platforms.

Our engineering work supports industries including medical devices, consumer electronics and other connected embedded products where security must be integrated throughout the product lifecycle.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer with strong hands-on experience securing embedded devices and connected products, particularly in consumer electronics or medical-device environments.

This is a hands-on engineering position, not a general IT cybersecurity, SOC, network security or compliance-only role.

You will work directly with embedded software, platform and product-engineering teams to design, implement, test and maintain security mechanisms across device hardware, bootloaders, operating systems, firmware and software-update infrastructure.

We are particularly interested in engineers who have contributed to security architectures and controls in real products, from development and integration through production release and ongoing maintenance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Embedded Product Security Architecture

  • Design and implement security architectures for Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP and other embedded platforms.
  • Perform device-level threat modeling, attack-surface analysis and security risk assessments.
  • Identify threats involving physical device access, debug interfaces, firmware extraction, communication interfaces and software vulnerabilities.
  • Translate security requirements into practical technical controls and engineering tasks.
  • Collaborate with hardware, BSP, platform and application engineers to implement security by design.

2. Secure Boot, Device Identity and Cryptography

  • Implement and validate Secure Boot, Verified Boot and chain-of-trust mechanisms.
  • Work with hardware-backed security technologies such as TPM, HSM, secure elements, ARM TrustZone and OP-TEE, as applicable.
  • Design secure device identity, key provisioning, key storage and key lifecycle mechanisms.
  • Implement cryptographic signing, integrity verification and secure firmware authentication.
  • Support secure manufacturing provisioning and device lifecycle security.

3. Embedded Linux and Android Platform Hardening

  • Implement security controls within Embedded Linux and, where applicable, Android/AOSP platforms.
  • Harden bootloaders, Linux kernels, operating-system configurations and device services.
  • Work with Linux security mechanisms such as SELinux, AppArmor, dm-verity, dm-crypt and filesystem protection.
  • Reduce attack surfaces by securing services, ports, permissions, interfaces and debug capabilities.
  • Collaborate with Yocto/BSP engineers to integrate security controls into production firmware images.

4. Secure Firmware Updates and Product Lifecycle Security

  • Design and implement secure firmware and OTA update mechanisms.
  • Ensure firmware authenticity, integrity, rollback protection and secure recovery.
  • Support secure update architectures for connected and field-deployed products.
  • Investigate product vulnerabilities and contribute to remediation across supported software versions.
  • Help establish security maintenance practices for products throughout their operational lifecycle.

5. Vulnerability Management and Security Verification

  • Perform vulnerability analysis across embedded firmware, operating systems, libraries and third-party components.
  • Work with CVE databases, software composition analysis and SBOM generation.
  • Assess vulnerability exploitability and product-specific security impact.
  • Support static analysis, dynamic analysis, firmware analysis and penetration-testing activities.
  • Develop or integrate security verification into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Document security findings, remediation actions and verification evidence.

6. Product Security and Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, BSP, hardware, DevSecOps, QA and product-engineering teams.
  • Participate in security design reviews and technical risk assessments.
  • Support security requirements, verification and traceability for regulated or security-sensitive products.
  • Contribute to product-security documentation and technical security decisions.
  • Independently investigate and resolve complex embedded security issues.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Strong professional experience in embedded software engineering, with substantial hands-on responsibility for embedded product cybersecurity.
  • Professional experience securing consumer electronics, medical devices or comparable connected embedded products.
  • Strong understanding of embedded hardware, firmware, bootloaders, operating systems and device security boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience implementing security controls in Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP or comparable embedded platforms.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in several of the following:
    • Secure Boot, Verified Boot or hardware root of trust.
    • Secure key storage, provisioning and cryptographic integration.
    • Embedded Linux security hardening.
    • Secure firmware updates and rollback protection.
    • Device-level threat modeling and attack-surface reduction.
    • Embedded vulnerability analysis and remediation.
  • Strong Linux debugging and embedded systems troubleshooting skills.
  • Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting with Python or Bash.
  • Ability to independently own technical security tasks from design through implementation and verification.
  • Experience working with cross-functional product-development teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with consumer electronics, connected devices, smart home products, multimedia devices, wearables or other commercially deployed embedded products.
  • Experience developing or securing medical-device software, connected medical equipment or regulated healthcare products.
  • Practical experience with ARM TrustZone, OP-TEE, TPM, secure elements or hardware security modules.
  • Experience with Yocto/OpenEmbedded, U-Boot, Linux kernel configuration and BSP security integration.
  • Android Verified Boot (AVB), Android security architecture or SELinux policy development.
  • Secure OTA frameworks and firmware-signing infrastructure.
  • Experience with SBOM tooling, CVE assessment and software composition analysis.
  • Familiarity with applicable product-security standards and guidance, such as IEC 62443, ETSI EN 303 645, IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971 or relevant EU Cyber Resilience Act requirements.
  • Experience supporting security verification, technical documentation and product-security audits.
  • Experience working on products requiring long-term security maintenance and vulnerability response.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in engineers who can demonstrate:

  • Security mechanisms they have personally designed, implemented, integrated or validated.
  • Experience working with actual embedded products rather than security concepts alone.
  • Understanding of how hardware, firmware, operating systems and connectivity affect device security.
  • Ability to investigate vulnerabilities and implement practical remediation.
  • Ownership of technical decisions and security deliverables.
  • Clear communication with embedded engineering and product teams.

Important: This position requires practical embedded product-security engineering experience. General IT security, SOC operations, infrastructure security, penetration testing without embedded-product engineering, or compliance-only experience will not independently meet the role requirements.

Why Join L4B Software?

  • Work on embedded platform and product-security engineering challenges.
  • Contribute to secure software platforms used in complex connected products.
  • Collaborate with international engineering teams.
  • Take ownership of meaningful security design and implementation responsibilities.
  • Work in an environment where technical depth, independent problem-solving and engineering quality matter.

Application

Please share your resume highlighting the embedded products and platforms you have worked on, the security mechanisms you personally implemented, and your experience with production or commercially deployed devices.

L4B Software is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. Candidates will be assessed on demonstrated technical capabilities and alignment with the requirements of the role.

Who We Are

Vermillio believes humanity should thrive in the era of AI. That's why we're building essential guardrails for the generative internet — starting with TraceID, our AI protection and licensing technology.

Vermillio is the leader in AI guardrails for protection and licensing. Vermillio brings together years of combined AI expertise, with its co-founders each building in AI for more than 15 years. The company is well funded and is already working with world-class IP from partners such as Sony and Talent Agency WME.

Our technology creates a secure ethical environment for all builders, makers and creators. Our attribution technology ensures proper credit and compensation reach rightful owners, confirming that AI developers have consent and access to high quality ingredients. TraceID puts everyone in control of what they own, what they build with, and what they create. With our platform TraceID, talent and IP holders can take advantage of the benefits of Generative AI in a safe and secure environment while understanding where and how their valuable data is being used.

More about Vermillio

Our TraceID platform monitors the internet for unauthorized use of protected IP (music, voices, likenesses, audiobooks and more), classifies what it finds, and turns it into licensing and enforcement intelligence for clients ranging from major labels and publishers to individual creators.

The Analyst team sits at the center of that work. They turn raw, messy, high-volume data into accurate results clients can act on.

Role summary

The Lead AI Protection Analyst owns how Vermillio finds, generates, and classifies data in TraceID, and leads the team that does it. You set the standards for data generation, content identification, and QA, and you make sure every result is classified correctly before it reaches a client. You partner closely with Customer Success and the Content Protection Manager, and you may support the delivery of results to clients.

What you'll do

Team leadership

  • Manage, hire, train, and develop the Analyst team; set priorities and balance workload across client onboarding and ongoing monitoring
  • Coach analysts on database reference logic or Boolean prompt building, data review, and classification standards
  • Work hands-on in TraceID as needed, from onboarding to data review, and step in on the hardest cases

Data strategy and system design

  • Own how we generate and source data: which sources, platforms, and signals we monitor for each client
  • Define how TraceID pulls data, working with Product and Engineering on content identification methods , coverage gaps, and new sources
  • Lead prompt and rule definition and content identification frameworks that scale across clients

Quality and accuracy

  • Own the QA process end to end and work with cross-functional teams to resolve issues
  • Define and track accuracy metrics (precision, recall, false-positive rates) and drive continuous improvement
  • Document processes, standards, and playbooks so quality is repeatable as the team grows

Cross-functional partnership

  • Work with Customer Success and the Content Protection Manager to ensure all client needs are being met
  • Turn client feedback into better prompts, rules, and workflows
  • Support delivery of results to clients, including walking them through findings, trends, and methodology

What you bring

  • Expert Boolean model prompting development skills, including designing prompting frameworks and classification rules at scale
  • Deep experience with SaaS data or monitoring platforms and how they collect and process data

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Cardiology Pathway General Manager

Enterprise Solutions | GE HealthCare | International markets

About the role

As Cardiology Pathway General Manager (GM) for Enterprise Solutions, you will own commercial results for GE HealthCare’s cardiology care pathway business across international markets. This is a hands-on, quota-carrying commercial leadership role: you will find, shape and close large multi-year cardiology deals, and you will deliver orders, revenue and margin against the operating plan. You will lead a team of initially two Cardiology Care Pathway Leaders.

Winning these deals depends on GE HealthCare acting as one team. You will mobilize colleagues across modalities, services, digital, finance and legal to turn an agreed value proposition into an approved, priced and contractable offer, and then into a signed deal. You will bring clinical credibility in cardiology and a strong network of cardiology leaders and hospital executives.

Priority markets include the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Spain, Indonesia and the ASEAN region.

What you will do

Commercial ownership and deal execution

  • Own the commercial number for the cardiology pathway business in the region, with clear targets for orders, revenue, win rate and margin.
  • Personally own about 10 target strategic accounts, and lead each opportunity from identification and qualification through proposal, negotiation and close.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals that bring together equipment, digital and software, services, managed equipment services and consulting, and engage clinical, finance, procurement and executive buyers.
  • Lead tender and proposal strategy for large cardiology programs, including win themes, pricing, commercial terms and competitive positioning.
  • Negotiate commercial terms with customers, including multi-year, outcome-based and risk-share models where they fit the deal.
  • Act as the deal lead and reference point for regional account and solutions teams on cardiology deal strategy and differentiation.

Internal networking and deal orchestration

  • Build and use a strong internal network across GE HealthCare—modality and SBU segment leads, services, digital, product marketing, finance, legal, risk and deal review—to get offers built, approved and delivered on time.
  • Turn the cardiology value proposition into concrete, contractable offers: secure internal alignment on scope, pricing, risk and resources, and steer deals through internal approval and governance.
  • Assemble and lead cross-functional deal teams for each strategic pursuit, with clear roles, timelines and accountability.
  • Work closely with the global cardiology team, which owns upstream strategy, roadmaps and new product introductions, so regional deal needs shape what is built and launched.
  • Escalate and resolve internal blockers quickly, and secure senior executive sponsorship for priority deals.
  • Ensure a clean handover from sale to delivery so customers realize the outcomes committed in the contract.

Commercial rigor and pipeline management

  • Build and drive the cardiology pathway pipeline, with measurable growth in pipeline value, conversion, win rate, share and new leads.
  • Run a disciplined commercial cadence: account plans, opportunity reviews, deal qualification and accurate forecasting for the current and future quarters.
  • Define market segmentation and account strategy for priority national and regional accounts, covering installed base growth as well as greenfield and brownfield projects.
  • Track and act on leading and lagging indicators, including growth drivers and detractors, pipeline health and account performance.
  • Support regional commercial teams in delivering the quarterly and annual product, solution and service P&L operating plan, including orders, revenue, cost and margin targets.

Customers and external network

  • Bring and grow a network of cardiology key opinion leaders (KOLs), hospital CXOs, heads of cardiology and procurement leaders in the priority markets.
  • Lead high-level clinical and value discussions with CXOs and department heads, alongside regional commercial teams, to open and advance opportunities.
  • Build long-term collaborations with customers and structure new business models that expand access to cardiac care and support better outcomes.
  • Stay close to national cardiovascular programs, reimbursement and funding initiatives in the priority markets, and turn them into commercial opportunities.
  • Use GE HealthCare’s presence at key cardiology conferences to generate leads and strengthen customer relationships.

Value proposition input

  • Bring customer and deal insight to the global cardiology and product marketing teams so the value proposition, business cases and sales tools reflect what wins in the market.
  • Map cardiology workflows and patient journeys with customers to build deal-specific business cases.

Leadership, coaching and enablement

  • Lead, develop and coach a team of initially two Cardiology Care Pathway Leaders, based in the United Kingdom and France, and set clear targets and accountability for their results.
  • Coach regional account and solutions teams on cardiology deal strategy, value selling and the clinical nuances of cardiology care practices.
  • Develop talent, give regular, timely and constructive development feedback, and build collaboration across regions and functions.

What you bring

Required

  • An MBA, MS, PhD or MD, or equivalent professional experience.
  • At least 8 years in quota-carrying commercial, sales or strategic account roles in healthcare or medtech, with a cardiology focus, including at least 4 years in senior sales management or general management.
  • A proven track record of personally closing large, multi-year strategic or enterprise deals in cardiology, with measurable results against targets.
  • Clinical experience in a hospital setting, ideally 7 to 10 years in cardiology, giving you credibility with cardiologists and cardiology department leaders.
  • Strong understanding of the cardiology landscape, including cardiac imaging, interventional cardiology, electrophysiology and diagnostic cardiology.
  • Demonstrated ability to orchestrate complex internal organizations—getting cross-functional teams, approvals and resources aligned behind a deal—and to drive change in a highly matrixed environment.
  • Strong commercial discipline: pipeline management, forecasting, deal qualification, pricing and negotiation.
  • An established network of cardiology KOLs, hospital executives and decision makers in one or more of the priority markets.
  • Excellent leadership, sales coaching, talent development and influencing skills, with advanced negotiation, problem-solving and executive presentation skills.
  • A strong commitment to compliance and integrity in all commercial dealings.
  • Fluent English.
  • Willingness to travel across the region and internationally as needed.

Preferred

  • Experience selling enterprise solutions such as managed equipment services, multi-vendor services, enterprise imaging and cardiology IT, or consulting and command center offerings.
  • Experience with tenders, public procurement frameworks and alternative financing or risk-share models.
  • An existing internal network within GE HealthCare.
  • Experience in cardiology solution or product marketing.
  • Additional languages relevant to the priority markets.

Our behaviors

We expect all colleagues to live and breathe our behaviors: act with humility and build trust, lead with transparency, deliver with focus and drive ownership—always with unyielding integrity.

Total rewards

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally. We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the center of an ecosystem working toward precision health - digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world.


Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.


  • GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Enterprise Account Executive – AI-Powered Enterprise Software – North America
North America | Remote | Enterprise SaaS | New Business Development

Help Transform How the World's Most Complex Capital Projects Are Designed and Delivered

At Slate Technologies, we're transforming the way organizations design, build, and manage large-scale capital projects through artificial intelligence.
Our AI-powered platform helps leading organizations accelerate design, anticipate project risks, improve execution, and make smarter decisions across the project lifecycle.
From hyperscale data centers and energy infrastructure to advanced manufacturing and major construction programs, Slate is addressing some of the most complex and consequential challenges facing capital-intensive industries.
We're building on significant enterprise customer momentum, backed by deep-tech investors, and expanding our North American sales organization.
We're looking for exceptional enterprise sales professionals who don't just manage opportunities—they create them.

The Opportunity

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will own new business development within a defined strategic industry vertical, targeting some of North America's largest and most sophisticated organizations.
You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, developing executive relationships, building compelling business cases, and closing complex, high-value enterprise software agreements.
This is a true hunter role, ideal for someone who thrives on opening doors, navigating large organizations, creating demand, and winning transformational deals.
You will have the opportunity to sell a differentiated AI platform into industries undergoing significant investment and technological transformation.

What You'll Do

  • Own new-logo revenue growth. Build and execute a strategic territory plan to consistently achieve or exceed annual bookings targets.
  • Create your own opportunities. Proactively develop a substantial pipeline through targeted prospecting, executive outreach, referrals, industry relationships, and strategic account development.
  • Engage senior executives. Establish credibility with C-suite leaders, business unit executives, engineering leadership, and technology decision-makers.
  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles. Navigate multistakeholder buying committees, technical evaluations, procurement, legal negotiations, and enterprise contracting.
  • Sell measurable business value. Translate Slate’s AI capabilities into compelling financial and operational outcomes, including improved productivity, accelerated delivery, reduced risk, and lower project costs.
  • Develop strategic account plans. Identify business priorities, active capital investment programs, decision-makers, buying triggers, and opportunities for enterprise-wide adoption.
  • Orchestrate internal resources. Collaborate with Slate’s executive leadership, product, technical, and customer success teams to develop and close major opportunities.
  • Maintain disciplined sales execution. Manage pipeline, opportunity qualification, deal strategy, and accurate forecasting using Salesforce.
  • Contribute to our growth strategy. Bring market intelligence, competitive insights, and customer feedback that help shape Slate’s positioning and go-to-market execution.
  • Contribute to in-person client sales and events, like conferences, where required to build pipeline and drive conversion. Estimated travel of 3-4 trips per quarter.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: You've learned Slate's platform and the core customer problems, can run discovery fluently with each buyer type, and have built a qualified pipeline in your target accounts.
  • First 6 months: You're running active enterprise opportunities with executive sponsorship
  • First 12 months: You've closed new enterprise logos, are forecasting accurately, and have contributed repeatable pieces to the sales playbook including messaging, qualification, or pilot structure.

What Makes You Successful

Required qualifications

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying B2B software sales experience, including significant experience selling complex enterprise SaaS solutions.
  • Demonstrated history of consistently meeting or exceeding quota, with a strong emphasis on personally sourced new-logo business.
  • Proven success closing complex, high-value enterprise agreements, ideally involving six-figure or larger annual contract values.
  • Experience selling to large enterprises with multiple stakeholders, complex procurement requirements, and extended sales cycles.
  • Ability to develop relationships with senior executives and build consensus across business, technical, and financial decision-makers.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to quantify ROI, construct compelling business cases, and negotiate commercial agreements.
  • Demonstrated ability to build territory strategy, generate pipeline independently, and manage opportunities through closure.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, discovery, and negotiation skills.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, intellectual curiosity, resilience, and the ability to succeed in a fast-moving growth-stage company.

Highly desirable experience

  • Experience selling enterprise software into one or more of the following industries: data centers and digital infrastructure; energy technology and power systems; utilities, power generation, and energy infrastructure; industrial construction, advanced manufacturing, or engineering and construction.
  • Experience selling AI, analytics, engineering software, digital twins, design automation, project intelligence, or enterprise workflow platforms.
  • Familiarity with complex capital project delivery and the operational challenges facing owners, developers, EPCs, and contractors.
  • Familiarity with the buying or procurement process of Slate’s target stakeholders in the AEC space, including the difference between project and enterprise technology purchasing as well as rules of capitalization
  • Experience with value-based or consultative selling methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Command of the Message.
  • Established executive relationships within relevant target industries.

Who Thrives at Slate

  • Are builders, not caretakers. You enjoy creating new markets, opening strategic accounts, and developing opportunities from the ground up.
  • Think strategically and execute relentlessly. You can develop an enterprise account strategy and personally drive the activities required to win.
  • Sell outcomes, not features. You understand how to connect technology investments to measurable business results.
  • Are comfortable with complexity. You thrive when navigating large organizations, challenging problems, and sophisticated buying processes.
  • Are comfortable with ambiguity and evolving priorities. You thrive in understanding how the business is growing and changing, and can adjust your approach to the market accordingly
  • Are intellectually curious. You enjoy learning new technologies and understanding how customers operate.
  • Want to make an impact. You are motivated by the opportunity to influence the growth of a company and participate in its long-term success.
  • Understands and works well with a team, ranging from technical leads to executives, that will collectively support the client engagement and conversion process

Why Slate Technologies?

  • A compelling market opportunity. AI is transforming capital-intensive industries, creating substantial demand for solutions that improve how major projects are designed and delivered.
  • Meaningful enterprise traction. Slate is building relationships with leading organizations tackling some of the world’s most ambitious infrastructure and construction challenges.
  • A differentiated platform. Sell across design automation, project intelligence, progress monitoring, and AI-powered operational insights rather than a narrow point solution.
  • Executive access and influence. Work closely with Slate’s leadership team and play a meaningful role in shaping our go-to-market strategy.
  • The opportunity to build something significant. Join a growth-stage technology company where individual contributions can directly influence business success.
  • Competitive rewards. Attractive base compensation, performance-based commissions, equity participation, and comprehensive benefits.

Ready to Build the Future?

If you're a proven enterprise software hunter who thrives on winning complex deals, developing executive relationships, and helping customers achieve transformational business outcomes, we'd welcome the opportunity to speak with you.
Join Slate Technologies and help redefine how the world's most important capital projects are delivered.

If this sounds like you, you should apply right away so we can discuss how you can be a part of this exciting, fast-paced organization!

Slate Technologies, Inc is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. About Coalfire

Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world.
But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do.
We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.

Position Summary

The Senior Solutions Architect leads technical and business conversations on complex client opportunities, partnering with business development, sales, and delivery teams to define practical, value-based solutions. The role works across Compliance and Assurance solutions and engages the broader cybersecurity portfolio when it improves client outcomes. The Senior Solutions Architect runs pursuits from qualification through close with limited oversight and acts as a mentor to more junior architects.

What You'll Do

    Client advisory

  • Serves as a high-level trusted advisor to C-suite executives and key decision-makers.
  • Navigates complex organizational politics, stakeholder disagreements, and high-visibility client escalations.
  • Networks across C-suite executives and external partners. Uses strategic persuasion to align conflicting business units, resolves enterprise client escalations, and mentors lower-level architects across the practice.
  • Leads discovery, needs assessments, workshops, and solution validation sessions for complex opportunities, usually without a more senior colleague present.
  • Builds credible relationships with client managers, directors, and technical leaders; understands their priorities, constraints, and decision process.
  • Translates compliance obligations and business objectives into solution options, with clear assumptions, tradeoffs, and decisions the client needs to make.
  • Recognizes when an opportunity or relationship is at risk and escalates to sales leadership with a proposed path, not just the problem.

    • Solution design, scoping, and commercial execution

  • Partners closely with Sales and Finance to design custom commercial structures, complex pricing models, and risk-managed SOWs.
  • Protects commercial integrity and margins against scope creep.
  • Designs client-specific solutions that span compliance, cloud, security, and operating-model considerations, adapting existing patterns to unusual requirements.
  • Owns the technical content of proposals, SOWs, RFI/RFP responses, and pricing logic, including the assumptions behind them.
  • Develops architecture diagrams, roadmaps, demonstrations, and proofs of concept that make complex decisions understandable to mixed audiences.
  • Explains solution rationale, scope boundaries, and value during client negotiations; knows when to bring in leadership for commercial concessions.
  • Spots cross-sell and expansion opportunities and raises them with the account team.

    • Scope, delivery, and risk governance

  • Solves highly complex, ambiguous enterprise challenges requiring custom multi-framework integrations.
  • Navigates intricate technical dependencies across disparate client systems, vendors, and internal business units.
  • Brings wide-ranging experience across complex, multi-framework environments (e.g., FedRAMP, CMMC, advanced cloud architectures). Connects technical strategies to broader corporate objectives and leads the creation of new scoping methods, solution plays, and delivery models.
  • Defines and documents scope, prerequisites, dependencies, and change-control requirements for assigned pursuits.
  • Aligns solution design with delivery capacity and sequencing by working directly with delivery leads.
  • Distinguishes committed scope from optional services and future-state ideas, and holds that line with clients and internal teams.
  • Identifies risks and open decisions early and drives them to resolution.

    • Partner and ecosystem collaboration

  • Works with technology partners and subcontractors when they affect a solution, and understands how their licensing and capabilities influence scope and price.
  • Keeps accountability for Company scope and commitments clear when partner components are included.
  • Operates with high autonomy on high-stakes enterprise pursuits. Establishes new procedures for highly ambiguous deals and ensures commercial and delivery integrity across cross-functional teams.

    • Thought leadership and team contribution

  • Contributes technical content, collateral, and webinars; presents at client or industry events.
  • Tracks regulatory and market changes in assigned focus areas and shares them with the team.
  • Mentors lower level Solution Architects through pursuit reviews, coaching, and feedback on proposals and presentations.
  • Provides input on new offerings based on recurring client needs.
  • Operates with high strategic autonomy and minimal executive oversight
  • Leads high-stakes, multi-domain enterprise pursuits.
  • Sets internal precedents for handling complex technical friction and non-standard deal structures.
  • Contribute to additional projects and responsibilities as needed that support team priorities and organizational goals.
  • Travel is expected for client workshops, executive briefings, industry events, and strategic account support; anticipated travel is approximately 25–35%, subject to business needs.

What You'll Bring

  • Generally 5–8 years of relevant experience in pre-sales, consulting, or delivery for compliance, audit, security, or cloud solutions.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Demonstrated hands-on depth with at least two major frameworks (for example, ISO 27001, SOC, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, CMMC, GDPR).
  • Experience leading pursuits and contributing to closed deals is expected. Experience supporting strategic accounts is a plus but not required.

Bonus Points

    Subject-matter expertise in data privacy, U.S. and global regulations, and common compliance frameworks is preferred. Relevant certifications may include:

  • CISSP
  • CRISC
  • CISA/CISM
  • CGEIT
    • Experience selling enterprise cybersecurity solutions, including security operations platforms (Google SecOps) and cloud security technologies (Wiz).
Why You’ll Want to Join Us
At Coalfire, you’ll find the support you need to thrive personally and professionally. In many cases, we provide a flexible work model that empowers you to choose when and where you’ll work most effectively – whether you’re at home or an office.
Regardless of location, you’ll experience a company that prioritizes connection and wellbeing and be part of a team where people care about each other and our communities. jobs.title: Human Centered Design Manager
jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewVoted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Manager to bridge the gap between user needs and technical execution. You will lead qualitative research, map user journeys, build interactive prototypes, and run usability tests to ensure our products are intuitive, accessible, and impactful for the physicians, clinical staff, billers, front-desk teams, and patients who rely on them every day. In a clinical setting, a confusing screen costs a provider time, adds to burnout, and can affect patient safety, so this role carries real weight. You will thrive here if you love sitting with users in their actual workflows, can turn messy observations into clear direction, and can defend design decisions with evidence.

Key Responsibilities

User Research

  • Conduct contextual inquiries, interviews, field observations, and surveys with physicians, clinical staff, billers, and patients to uncover explicit and latent needs.
  • Partner with account managers and support teams to surface usability pain points from client feedback and support tickets.

Synthesis & Strategy

  • Translate research into personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and system workflows across clinical, operational, and billing processes.
  • Present insights to product and executive leadership to shape roadmap priorities.

Ideation & Prototyping

  • Facilitate cross-functional design workshops and build low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Design AI-powered features (AI charting, AI agents) that keep clinicians in control and make AI output easy to review and correct.

Usability Testing

  • Plan, moderate, and analyze formative and summative usability tests to iterate on designs before and during development.
  • Evaluate safety-critical workflows such as medication management and e-prescribing, and support ONC Safety-Enhanced Design testing.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with product managers, business analysts, and engineers in Agile/Scrum teams to maintain design integrity from concept through release.
  • Uphold accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508) and HIPAA-safe research practices across all products.

Leadership

  • Build and scale WRS Health's HCD practice, including research operations, templates, and standards.
  • Mentor designers and researchers, and coach teammates on human-centered methods.

Qualifications

Required

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Factors Engineering, Interaction Design, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3 to 6+ years of professional experience in HCD, UX design, or user research, including enterprise or regulated-industry experience.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in prototyping software (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD), qualitative research methodologies, usability testing frameworks, and Agile/Scrum delivery flows.
  • Accessibility: Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG standards and how to apply them in practice.
  • Core Competencies: Strong empathy, verbal storytelling, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to defend design decisions with data.
  • A portfolio or case studies demonstrating end-to-end research, synthesis, prototyping, and measurable impact.

Preferred

  • Experience designing for EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, telehealth, or other health IT products.
  • Familiarity with clinical workflows and terminology across ambulatory specialties.
  • Knowledge of ONC Safety-Enhanced Design (user-centered design and summative testing) requirements, NISTIR 7804, or ISO 9241-210.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted or automation features, including human-in-the-loop review patterns.
  • Prior experience leading or mentoring designers/researchers, or building a design function from the ground up.
  • Experience with remote research and unmoderated testing tools and product analytics platforms.
  • Clinical background or prior work in a medical practice setting.

A Day in the Life

Your days move between the field, the whiteboard, and the prototype. You might start by joining the product team's stand-up to flag a research insight affecting an upcoming sprint, then sit in (virtually or on-site) with a specialty practice to watch how the front desk, medical assistants, and physicians actually work, noting the workarounds they've built and where the screens slow them down. Later, you could be synthesizing those observations into an updated journey map, facilitating a workshop with product managers, engineers, and billing specialists to sketch solutions, or moderating a usability test of a new AI charting feature to see how a clinician reviews and trusts AI-drafted notes. Before the day ends, you refine prototypes in Figma based on what you learned, check designs against accessibility standards, share prioritized recommendations with product leadership, and make time to coach the designers and researchers on your team.

Success Metrics

  • Measurable usability gains: Improved task success rates, time-on-task, error rates, and System Usability Scale (SUS) scores for redesigned workflows, including fewer clicks and less documentation time for key clinical tasks.
  • Research-driven roadmap: Consistent monthly contact with users across specialties, with a clear, visible share of roadmap items originating from or validated by HCD research.
  • Fewer usability issues post-release: Decline in usability-related support tickets, rework, and post-launch design defects.
  • Accessibility and certification compliance: New and updated features meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards at release, and ONC Safety-Enhanced Design documentation is completed on time.
  • Adoption and satisfaction: Higher feature adoption (including AI features) and improved client satisfaction or NPS for redesigned areas.

Job Details

  • Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
At Woolpert, you’ll do work that matters.

As a leading global architecture, engineering, and geospatial firm, we help clients solve complex challenges that shape communities, strengthen critical infrastructure, advance technology, and improve the world around us. Here, you’ll collaborate across disciplines, tackle meaningful projects, and build a career defined by growth, opportunity, and impact.

Position Overview

Woolpert is hiring a Senior Fire Protection Engineer to join our dynamic Fire Protection & Life Safety team. This position reports to the Engineering Team Leader and is responsible for leading engineering project; overseeing project scope and schedule, performing design and engineering of fire suppression systems, fire alarm systems, and/or life safety and code analysis for various complex facilities such as commercial high rise, mission critical data centers and high-reliability infrastructure, mentoring staff, applying proficiency in designing, analyzing, and reviewing fire suppression systems to ensure safety, sustainability, and compliance with industry standards.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead the design and development of fire suppression, fire alarm systems, and/or life safety and code analysis from concept through construction documentation and supporting construction administration
  • Perform technical review and QA/QC reviews to ensure the delivery of code-compliant, and high-quality engineering deliverables
  • Develop and modify models, plans, details, and drawings of fire protection and fire alarm systems according to established standards and modeling
  • Perform hydraulic calculations
  • Coordinate designs with architectural, mechanical, electrical, and structural teams
  • Use Revit and other related design tools
  • Review codes and standards
  • Support permitting and construction phases
  • Collaborate with project managers and clients to ensure compliant, efficient, and resilient fire protection solutions.
  • Participate in site visits, field verifications, and quality assurance reviews to support successful project delivery.
  • Support career development and technical skill advancement of team members
  • Conduct training sessions for internal employees when necessary

Personal & Professional Growth

At Woolpert we place a high value on personal and professional growth, offering various opportunities for development within the engineering team:

  • Team members have access to continuous learning programs, including workshops, seminars, certifications, and participation in professional membership organizations. This allows our engineers to stay abreast of the latest industry trends and technologies, broaden their expertise, and network with industry peers.
  • Mentorship programs where leaders and senior engineers guide and support junior staff, providing invaluable insights and fostering a culture of knowledge sharing.
  • Career advancement through personalized career path planning and regular performance evaluations, ensuring that each team member's progress is recognized and rewarded.
  • Opportunities to take on new challenges, lead projects, and expand skill sets, further enhancing personal and professional capabilities.

What You Will Bring:

  • Must have a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, or related field and 10 or more years related experience, including fire protection systems design and product design for complex buildings such as mission-critical data center environments.
  • Registered Professional Engineer (PE) in Fire Protection Discipline.
  • Expertise in the design and application of fire protection and fire alarm systems for complex facilities
  • Familiarity with applicable codes and standards (e.g., NFPA, IBC, local fire codes) and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Substantial experience in Revit used for creating detailed fire protection drawings and models.
  • Understanding of engineering principles relevant to fire suppression, fire detection, alarm, and control systems.
  • Experience with fire alarm, mass notification, fire suppression, fire pump, hydraulic calculation, special suppression, smoke control/exhaust, and fire-resistance rated construction.
  • Experience with smoke control rational analysis, CONTAM or CFD modeling, or other modeling software.
  • Experience designing fire protection systems for mission-critical facilities such as data centers, hospitals, or industrial plants is highly beneficial.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical specifications, coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, and communicate design intent clearly in written and verbal form.
  • Excellent presentation, interpersonal, and organizational skills
  • Able to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries from clients, regulatory agencies, and members of the business community.
  • Mentally and physically capable of performing all essential duties required of the position.
  • Willing to travel to project sites or offices, as needed.

Benefits You Will Love

Certified as a Great Place to Work, Woolpert is one of the fastest-growing architecture, engineering, and geospatial companies in the world. With over 75 offices and countless projects around the globe, you’ll work on meaningful assignments that improve quality of life around the world. In addition to offering competitive pay, we provide employees with a robust set of unique benefits, including:

  • Freedom to Work program: Set your own schedule and location (as appropriate).
  • Principal program: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.
  • Flexible paid time off/vacation: Take time off when it makes sense for you and your team.
  • Career development: Explore a wide range of learning and growth opportunities within and across industries.
  • Health, life, vision, and dental insurance: Cover all your medical bases.
  • Paid sick time, retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, pet insurance, identity protection, technology stipend, employee assistance program, and more!

Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Pay Range
$139,200—$174,000 USD

Find out more about what Woolpert has to offer here:

Woolpert is an equal-opportunity employer. Woolpert is committed to the full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, compensate, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. You may view more about EEO on our website: Equal-Employment-Opportunity-The-Law.pdf and EEO is the Law Poster Supplement.

jobs.excerpt: You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel.
jobs.description:
You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel.

Job Summary

The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst plays a key role in advancing enterprise analytics and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role partners closely with Operations, Revenue Cycle, Finance, Data Services, Data Governance, Clinical, and other business departments to translate complex business requirements into scalable, actionable analytics solutions.

The Senior BI Analyst is responsible for developing and optimizing data models, interactive dashboards, and self-service analytics solutions using Snowflake, Sigma Computing, and advanced SQL. The role requires strong technical expertise in data analysis, data transformation, KPI development, and BI data modeling to ensure data is accurate, consistent, and structured effectively for enterprise reporting and analysis.

In addition to delivering advanced analytics solutions, this role supports standardized KPI definitions, data quality initiatives, reporting automation, and emerging AI-enabled analytics capabilities. The Senior BI Analyst combines strong technical and analytical skills with healthcare business knowledge, particularly across Operations, Revenue Cycle, and Clinical workflows, to deliver meaningful insights, improve reporting efficiency, and support strategic business decisions.

Qualifications

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

Licenses/Certifications Required:

  • None

Work Experience Required:

  • 4–6+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, analytics, or a related field
  • Advanced SQL and working knowledge of Python
  • Experience developing enterprise dashboards and analytical solutions.
  • Experience working with Snowflake or another modern cloud data warehouse.
  • Strong experience designing and working with analytical data models.
  • Experience translating business requirements into scalable BI solutions.
  • Experience partnering directly with business stakeholders and leadership.
  • undefined

  • Preferred Qualifications, Education, Licenses, Certifications, Experience, etc.:
  • Master’s degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
  • Snowflake, Sigma, advanced analytics, or AI-related certifications
  • Experience with Sigma Computing.
  • Experience supporting healthcare Operations and/or Revenue Cycle analytics.
  • Experience developing semantic layers, reusable data models, and governed metrics.
  • Experience with AI-enabled analytics, generative AI, or Snowflake Cortex/Cortex Agents.

  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • This role involves interaction and collaboration with other departments and requires excellent judgment and interpersonal skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL for data analysis, transformation, validation, and troubleshooting and strong understanding of Snowflake and cloud data warehouse concepts.
  • Strong knowledge of BI data modeling, including facts, dimensions, grain, joins, relationships, and aggregation.
  • Experience developing interactive dashboards and analytical models in Sigma or similar modern BI tools.
  • Strong analytical skills including root-cause analysis, trend analysis, forecasting, segmentation, and other advanced analytical methods
  • Understanding of AI-enabled analytics, natural-language querying, and analytical agents.
  • Strong healthcare business acumen, particularly within Operations and Revenue Cycle.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to independently lead complex BI initiatives and provide technical guidance to other analysts.

  • Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support development of semantic layers, AI-enabled analytics, and Snowflake Cortex/Cortex Agent use cases.
  • Partner with Operations, Revenue Cycle, Finance, Clinical, Data Services, Data Governance, and other departments to translate complex business requirements into scalable business intelligence and analytics solutions.
  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise dashboards, executive scorecards, and self-service reporting solutions using Sigma Computing , AI automation and other BI platforms.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain advanced SQL queries and analytical data models in Snowflake to support enterprise reporting, operational analytics, and complex business requirements.
  • Lead the design and development of reusable analytical data models, datasets, and semantic layers to support consistent KPI definitions, scalable reporting, and advanced analytics.
  • Conduct complex ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to identify operational inefficiencies, financial trends, revenue opportunities, and opportunities for performance improvement.
  • Collaborate with Data Services and Data Governance teams to ensure data accuracy, quality, integrity, and appropriate access controls across enterprise analytics solutions.
  • Identify, design, and implement opportunities to automate recurring reports, data validation processes, and analytical workflows to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Support the development and implementation of AI-enabled analytics, including semantic layers, natural-language querying, and Snowflake Cortex/Cortex Agent use cases.
  • Present complex analytical findings, actionable insights, and recommendations to business leaders and technical stakeholders to support strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to BI Analysts, promote best practices in SQL, data modeling, dashboard development, and analytical problem-solving.
  • Stay current on emerging business intelligence technologies, cloud data platforms, automation, and AI analytics capabilities to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation.

  • GoHealth Core Values

GoHealth’s Core Values, listed below, are essential functions of this position:

  • Collaboration: Takes ownership for collectively establishing productive partnerships and relationships and seek to gain joint understanding of priorities and objectives so that the greater good of the organization and those we serve is always at the forefront.
  • Innovation: Consistently uses good judgment, applying creativity to overcome obstacles and increasing effectiveness and efficiency through process and other forms of innovation.
  • Diversity & Inclusion: Fosters diversity and inclusion, to be able to better understand team members, our customers and partners. Engages the strengths and talents of each GoHealth team member, creating an environment of involvement, respect and connection where the richness of ideas, backgrounds and perspectives are harnessed.
  • Courage & Integrity: Models and practices the highest ethical and professional standards; demonstrates pride and personal interest in our patients, partners and fellow team members, deeply engaging in the business. Makes decisions, with a focus on doing the right thing; treats team members, our customers, partners and vendors with dignity, consideration, open-mindedness and respect.
  • Accountability: Always shows initiative, demonstrates a bias to action and gets things done. Actively accepts responsibility for diverse roles, obligations and actions that positively influence patient and customer outcomes, our partnerships and the healthcare needs of our communities.

Additional Requirements

  • Office Environment: Tasks may be conducted within a climate-controlled office setting.
  • Physical Activity: The role may require the ability to lift, carry, push, or pull materials, supplies, and equipment (up to 15 lbs.) Duties typically involve a combination of sitting, standing, and walking, with frequent changes in position.
  • Travel: Travel may be required, including travel between Company locations and out-of-town destinations as needed, up to 5%.
  • Safety Equipment: May require the use of safety equipment for infection prevention.

Base Salary Range: $83.8K annually - $115K annually

jobs.title: Risk Analyst I, Underwriting
jobs.excerpt: Who we are:Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced underwriting professional to join our Risk Management team. As an experienced underwriter, you will be responsible for reviewing and assessing the financial risk of new and existing customers, while making decisions based on policy guidelines. You should have experience and subject matter expertise in financial services, end-to-end underwriting lifecycle, portfolio management, bank statement and financial decisioning, and risk assessment.

You’ll evaluate applications, perform analysis that mitigate financial risk, and make timely and accurate decisions on application outcomes. The successful candidate will work as a member of our Risk Organization and collaborate with members from our sales, data science, product management, and other stakeholders to deliver best in class customer experience.

What You'll Do:

  • Collect, review and analyze applicants' relevant financial, demographic, and historic information and records. This includes, but is not limited to, analysis of business financial statements such as balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements, bank statements, and credit reports
  • Directly communicate with clients & sales about application status
  • Clearly articulate why and when additional documents are needed in order to determine a client's creditworthiness
  • Make determination whether to approve, decline or seek an exception for an application based on policy guidelines
  • Make quality decisions in a timely and efficient manner within expected SLA
  • Perform portfolio management, evaluating and identifying suspicious or questionable items
  • Recommend policy and process improvement to mitigate potential failure points throughout the underwriting journey
  • Bank statement analysis, financial spreading and risk ratio analysis culminating with underwriting memo

What We're Looking For:

  • 2-3+ years of underwriting experience in financial services, high-growth payments, or fintech company
  • Strong critical reasoning, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently and thrive in a collaborative team environment
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Familiar with fundamentals of financial risk assessment
  • Familiar with the U.S. compliance, lending & regulatory environment (KYC, Reg B, Reg Z, UDAAP, FCBA, Truth in Lending Act)
  • Experience with quantitative and qualitative analysis
  • Strong organization, and time management skills
  • Proven experience with bank based & financial underwriting
  • Highly motivated, organized, reliable, and has demonstrated competency in mathematics and financial spreading

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

jobs.excerpt: Job briefJoin Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.
jobs.description:
Job brief

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

As a Remote Destination Wedding Travel Planner, you'll help couples turn their we do into an unforgettable travel experience. By combining travel planning expertise with a warm, consultative sales approach, you'll guide couples and their guests from the first wedding vision to confirmed bookings — whether it's a beachfront ceremony, an intimate European celebration, a luxury resort wedding, or a group getaway with family and friends.

What You'll Do

  • Design customized destination-wedding travel plans, including flights, resort stays, room blocks, transfers, cruises, excursions, and honeymoon extensions.
  • Connect with couples to understand their wedding vision, guest needs, budget, preferred destination, and non-negotiables—then present tailored options and confidently guide them through booking.
  • Coordinate travel details for wedding groups, helping ensure guests have clear booking options, payment timelines, and support before departure.
  • Respond to questions and changes with professionalism and care, including payments, room upgrades, guest additions, date changes, transfer needs, and special requests.
  • Elevate each celebration with meaningful details: romantic excursions, welcome experiences, local activities, honeymoon ideas, and unforgettable wow moments for the couple and their guests.

We are changing FINANCE to finance CHANGE!

At Climate First Bank, we’re redefining what banking can be. As a Florida Benefit Corporation and FDIC-insured commercial bank, we offer a full suite of personal and business services—including solar, residential, commercial, ESOP Banking, Structured Finance and SBA loans—all designed to power a better future. We’re proud to be a Certified B Corporation, a member of 1% for the Planet, and part of the Global Alliance for Banking on Values (GABV), reflecting our deep commitment to sustainability, transparency, and ethical banking.

With branches in St. Petersburg, Winter Park, Mount Dora, Downtown Orlando and a growing digital presence, we’re proving that banking can be a force for good. We don’t just support environmental and social causes—we’re built on them.

Under our Holding Company, Climate First Bancorp, we are also powered by OneEthos. OneEthos operates at the intersection of fintech and traditional banking to expand access to inclusive, values-driven financial services. Regulated by the Federal Reserve Bank, it equips Community Banks, Credit Unions, CDFIs, and Green Banks with ethical lending tools—especially in climate finance and solar lending.

Join the Movement

We’re seeking driven, mission-aligned individuals ready to make an impact. If you’re passionate about sustainability, thrive in a fast-paced, results driven environment, and want to be part of something bigger, you will feel right at home.

Our team is one of goal-setters, go-getters, problem solvers, thought leaders, and changemakers. We celebrate wins, tackle challenges head-on, and push boundaries. Fueled by purpose, we thrive where perseverance and passion turn ambitious goals into reality.

Thrive at Climate First Bank

At Climate First Bank, we’re investing in your future. We offer a comprehensive, people-first benefits package that supports your health, finances, and work-life balance. Please note that benefit eligibility varies by employment status and that benefits for part-time employees may differ from those listed below.
