Now Hiring: Business Strategy and Analytics Intern

We're looking for a Business Strategy and Analytics Intern who is curious about how a bank operates, passionate about using data and technology to solve business problems, and eager to turn insights into action.

This highly cross-functional internship provides exposure to multiple areas across Climate First Bank. You will work with different business units to understand their objectives, processes, technology, data and performance. You will then apply a data-driven approach to identify opportunities, develop reports and dashboards, recommend improvements and, where practical, help implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, better decision-making and an improved client and employee experience.

This is not an internship focused on observing from the sidelines. We want someone who is ready to understand how and why the business works, dig into the data, ask thoughtful questions and help turn opportunities into measurable results.

Our goal is for this internship to serve as a pathway to a long-term career with Climate First Bank. After graduation, successful interns may have the opportunity to join one of the Bank's business units as a full-time employee, based on performance, organizational needs and available positions.

What You'll Contribute

Learn the Business

  • Work across multiple business units to develop a broad understanding of how Climate First Bank operates.
  • Learn each area's objectives, workflows, systems, technology, performance measures and key challenges.
  • Meet with business leaders and team members to understand how work gets done and where opportunities may exist.
  • Document business processes and identify dependencies, pain points, manual activities and bottlenecks.

Turn Data into Insights

  • Gather, organize and analyze business and operational data from multiple areas of the Bank.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, scorecards and analytical tools that make performance easier to understand and manage.
  • Help establish and monitor relevant key performance indicators and identify trends, opportunities and exceptions.
  • Translate data into practical insights that support business decisions rather than simply reporting numbers.

Identify Opportunities and Recommend Solutions

  • Use quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify opportunities to improve growth, productivity, efficiency, technology utilization, risk management and the client experience.
  • Evaluate existing processes and recommend ways to simplify, automate or improve them.
  • Research technology, AI, automation and analytical tools that may help solve business problems responsibly.
  • Develop clear, data-supported recommendations and present findings to business leaders and stakeholders.

Turn Ideas into Action

  • Work with business and technology teams to help implement selected recommendations.
  • Support pilots, process changes, dashboard implementations, automation initiatives and strategic projects.
  • Help define success measures and evaluate whether implemented initiatives deliver the intended results.
  • Document lessons learned and identify opportunities to scale successful solutions across the Bank.

Experience and Education

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Finance, Business Administration, Operations, Information Technology, Risk and Compliance, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Economics or a related field.
  • Strong interest in pursuing a career in banking, financial services, fintech, business strategy, analytics or operations.
  • Comfort working with data and spreadsheets, with an interest in developing skills in Microsoft Excel, Power BI and other analytics or business intelligence platforms.
  • Prior banking experience is not required. Intellectual curiosity, analytical thinking, initiative and a genuine desire to learn how a bank operates are essential.

Analytical Mindset

You're naturally curious and rarely stop at what happened. You want to understand why it happened, what the data tells us and what we should do next. You're comfortable working through ambiguity, breaking complex problems into manageable pieces and using data to support conclusions.

Technology-Forward Thinking

You're quick to learn new tools and excited about business intelligence, data visualization, AI, automation and digital tools. You want to understand how they can be applied responsibly to make a regulated financial institution more efficient and effective.

Business Curiosity

You want exposure to more than one part of the organization. Whether working with lending, deposits, operations, technology, finance, risk, compliance, marketing or another function, you approach each area with curiosity and a desire to understand both the details and the bigger picture.

Bias Toward Action

You don't want your work to end with a spreadsheet or presentation. You want your analysis to lead somewhere. You enjoy communicating recommendations, helping implement good ideas and measuring whether changes produced results.

Commitment to Being a Team Player

You're dependable, communicate clearly, welcome feedback and enjoy working with people who have different backgrounds and expertise. You understand that the best solutions often combine business knowledge, data, technology and collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

  • Develop a practical understanding of how multiple areas of a community bank operate.
  • Build or enhance dashboards, reports or analytical tools that business teams can continue using.
  • Identify measurable opportunities for growth, efficiency or process improvement.
  • Present data-driven recommendations to Bank leaders.

Diaceutics PLC is a diagnostic-driven therapy commercialisation company. For 20 years we have built the intelligence and engagement solutions that help biopharma see where eligible patients are emerging, engage the HCPs and labs shaping treatment decisions, and move faster from diagnostic activity to therapy adoption. The therapies we support touch 1 in 10 American lives - 30 to 40 million patients a year - across 700+ diagnostic-driven therapies, backed by a network of 600+ US labs and clients including AbbVie, AstraZeneca, GSK, Novartis, Pfizer and Roche.

Our portfolio brings together Intelligence Solutions (Signal, Insight Services, and Practice Gaps launching soon) and Engagement Solutions (Physician Engage, Expert Exchange, Lab Engage, Scientific Engagement, Precision Medicine Educators), connected through Relay - a partnership model built for precision medicine - and powered by the DXRX platform and Reveal engine.

We are headquartered in Jersey City, NJ (US) and Belfast, UK, and we are moving into our next chapter under a Precision for All ambition: a future where every eligible patient is identified, diagnosed and receives the right therapy at the right time.

Role Summary

The Client Services Consultant provides project delivery across multiple client projects, translating data into insights, and expertise into successful client outcomes. Your activities will directly contribute to work that supports meaningful commercial and patient impact.

With the opportunity to work across a variety of product types including data intelligence and engagement solutions, and client asset development stages, you will build upon your understanding of the healthcare and diagnostics landscape while developing your delivery, analytical and client service capabilities.

What you'll be doing

• Own, execute and prioritize client-service tasks across accounts, including data analysis, insight generation, documentation and report generation.

• Communicate with clients to provide updates, gather feedback, and clarify project delivery requirements.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams including project leads, internal specialists and analytics teams to support the delivery of each project. Proactively anticipate and communicate risks and bring solution-oriented recommendations to projects teams and clients.

• Track and update progress, issues and resolutions in delivery management and CRM systems.

• Maintain timelines and ensure that deliverables meet scope and budget requirements, relentlessly pursuing high-quality standards.

• Support onboarding and client management activities by preparing materials and responding to queries.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools and ways of working, bringing ideas that help the team operate more effectively.

• Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

• Contribute to knowledge sharing by capturing learnings, sharing good practice and helping colleagues benefit from your experience.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and team training sessions.

What we're looking for

You are a detail-oriented and adaptable delivery professional who can confidently support multiple projects, navigate different client contexts, and work across a range of data-driven intelligence and engagement solutions. You enjoy solving problems, staying organized and helping work move forward in a fast-paced growth environment. You are comfortable working with cross-functional teams and contributing to the generation of high-quality client deliverables.

Successful candidates will currently operate, or have operated, in roles that involve the execution of data driven tasks across various accounts on time and to high standards. You combine attention to detail with the ability to stay organized, prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across competing activities.

You will thrive in this role if you are curious, motivated by learning and enjoy turning plans into action and ideas into tangible outcomes. You are keen to expand your understanding of Diaceutics' impact across clients, products and patient outcomes.

Skills and competencies:

• Proven track record:  You have strong experience using data and insights to support client project delivery requirements. It would be advantageous if you held a client facing role, such as healthcare consulting role or business analyst.

• Commercial acumen: You demonstrate the ability to connect delivery performance to client satisfaction and commercial outcomes. Knowledge of healthcare or diagnostics industry is essential.

• Knowledge and expertise: You have relevant industry knowledge and strong track record of translating healthcare data into meaningful client insights via data analysis, insight generation and report generation. Experience working with US real-world data, including claims, lab testing, EHR or pharmacy data is highly desirable, ideally with 5+ years of relevant experience.

• Computer and Software knowledge:  You will have proficiency with Microsoft Office and delivery management tools and have familiarity with CRM, data management and reporting processes.   Experience using project and knowledge management platforms (e.g., Jira, Confluence, or similar) is required. Experience using dashboard platforms (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI or similar) is preferred. Exposure to programming languages (e.g. SQL, R, Python, XML, JavaScript) is preferred.

• Delivering with others: You are a strong cross-functional collaborator, with the ability to work with others to deliver on client projects. You are comfortable suggesting and leading improvements to processes.

• Communication: You demonstrate excellent communication skills, across multiple media including written and verbal. You can communicate effectively with a variety of audiences, including clients, building trust and understanding client requirements to enable successful project delivery.

• Agility: You demonstrate a proactive and positive approach to problem solving, displaying resilience and adaptability when navigating challenges.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in analytics, informatics, epidemiology, statistics, computer science, or a scientific field (PhD, MSc or MBA preferred).

Success Indicators

Growth & Value Creation:

• Quality of deliverables and client feedback

• Efficiency of task execution across multiple accounts

• Identification of process improvement opportunities

Delivery & Product Effectiveness:

• Adherence to timelines, scope and budgets

• Ensure accuracy of project deliverable documentation and reporting, delivering in line with client expectations

• Collaboration with internal specialists and project leads to support project outcome development and delivery to client

Collaboration & Capability:

• Demonstrated growth in clinical, commercial, and technical understanding across Diaceutics’ range of product offerings

• Adoption of delivery, quality, and governance standards

Life at Diaceutics

Culture is a powerful driver of Diaceutics’ success and growth. Our culture is an outcome of our ‘One Diaceutics’ Behaviors. These behaviors set out a promise and an expectation of what it means to work at – and with – Diaceutics.

We exist because we Care Deeply about our patients and customers. To Be Bold, we pioneer, we innovate, and we think big. We take responsibility, and we are driven and determined to Make an Impact. We prioritize collective success and when we win, we Succeed Together. We are excited by change and driven by progress.WeDon’t Stand Still.

We are a multi-cultural, diverse team spanning 16 countries around the world. All of our employees work remotely or in a hybrid model, collaborating together as a global community.

We hire smart, fun people who care about our mission and about each other. Some interesting points about us:

  • Competitive salary & attractive bonus scheme

  • Training & development opportunities

  • Remote / Virtual Working

  • Flexible Working, including the Flex Day Initiative – an optional program where extra hours during the week earn you the 1st and 3rd Fridays off each month

  • Share Incentive Plan

  • Increase of Vacation Days with tenure

  • 401(k) Contribution – invest in your future

  • Healthcare (including Vision & Dental) & Additional Benefits (Employee Assistance Programme)

  • Life Insurance

  • Long & Short-Term Disability Coverage – financial security when you need it

  • Enhanced Maternity & Sick Pay Provisions

  • Robust 'My Performance & Growth' cycle

  • Generous Staff Referral Scheme

  • Dedication to a positive working culture with regular health and wellbeing activities and an annual company get-together

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.

jobs.title: Consultant en conduite du changement – ServiceNow RH
jobs.excerpt: Description et livrables de la prestationContexte et objectif Dans le cadre de la transformation de sa gestion des demandes RH, une entreprise remplace son outil existant par ServiceNow.
jobs.description:
Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte et objectif

Dans le cadre de la transformation de sa gestion des demandes RH, une entreprise remplace son outil existant par ServiceNow.
La mission consiste à préparer les utilisateurs à cette transition, faciliter leur appropriation des nouveaux parcours et ancrer durablement les nouvelles pratiques. Elle vise notamment à limiter les erreurs d’orientation et les sollicitations hors outil, puis à mesurer l’adoption après le lancement.

Périmètre :

L’accompagnement concerne deux populations :

  • Collaborateurs : création et suivi des demandes et incidents RH.
  • Gestionnaires RH : réception, qualification, traitement, réorientation et clôture des tickets.

La mission couvre la préparation du changement, la communication, la formation, l’accompagnement au lancement et le suivi de l’adoption. La définition des règles métier, des processus et la configuration de ServiceNow restent sous la responsabilité des équipes projet.

Missions principales :

1. Cadrage et stratégie de conduite du changement

  • Analyser le contexte, les impacts et les dépendances du projet.
  • Identifier les écarts entre l’outil existant et les futurs parcours ServiceNow.
  • Cartographier les parties prenantes, les populations concernées et les risques d’adoption.
  • Définir la stratégie de conduite du changement, la feuille de route, la gouvernance et les indicateurs de suivi.
  • Mobiliser les sponsors, les relais RH et les ambassadeurs.

2. Communication

  • Construire et déployer le plan de communication avant, pendant et après le lancement.
  • Définir les messages clés adaptés aux différentes populations.
  • Produire les supports : e-mails, contenus intranet, présentations, FAQ, visuels et kits relais.
  • Recueillir les retours des utilisateurs et adapter les communications.

3. Formation et accompagnement

  • Identifier les besoins de formation par population et par rôle.
  • Concevoir les démonstrations, formations, tutoriels, guides pas à pas et fiches réflexe.
  • Animer les formations des gestionnaires RH et accompagner la prise en main par les collaborateurs.
  • Préparer les relais et les équipes de support.

4. Lancement et support renforcé

  • Préparer le lancement en coordination avec les équipes projet et support.
  • Organiser et animer le dispositif d’accompagnement renforcé après la mise en service.
  • Suivre les difficultés rencontrées et coordonner les actions correctives avec les équipes responsables.
  • Préparer le passage au fonctionnement courant.

5. Pilotage et suivi de l’adoption

  • Piloter les actions, jalons, risques et dépendances du volet conduite du changement.
  • Suivre les indicateurs de communication, de formation et d’utilisation de ServiceNow.
  • Analyser la qualité d’orientation des demandes, les sollicitations hors outil et les retours utilisateurs.
  • Produire les tableaux de bord, bilans et recommandations après le lancement.

Livrables attendus :

  • Diagnostic et cartographie des parties prenantes, des impacts et des risques.
  • Stratégie de conduite du changement et feuille de route.
  • Plans et supports de communication et de formation.
  • Guides pas à pas, FAQ, fiches réflexe et kits relais.
  • Plan d’accompagnement au lancement et dispositif de support renforcé.
  • Tableau de bord d’adoption et reportings.
  • Bilan et recommandations après le lancement.

Expertise souhaitée

Profil recherché :

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en conduite du changement sur des projets ServiceNow et savez associer cadrage stratégique, production de supports et accompagnement opérationnel.

Compétences indispensables :

  • Maîtrise des analyses d’impacts et de la construction de dispositifs de conduite du changement.
  • Expérience concrète de ServiceNow et bonne compréhension du fonctionnement des demandes et du ticketing.
  • Compétences en communication, conception pédagogique et animation de formations ou d’ateliers.
  • Capacité à coordonner des interlocuteurs RH, IT, produit, support et communication.
  • Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, autonomie, rigueur et esprit de synthèse.
  • Sens de l’écoute et orientation utilisateurs.

Compétences appréciées :

  • Expérience de ServiceNow en environnement RH, idéalement sur HR Service Delivery.
  • Connaissance des processus de gestion administrative RH ou d’un environnement SIRH.
  • Expérience du suivi de l’adoption et de l’accompagnement après mise en service.

Mobilité

Non renseigné

Working closely with Product, Commercial, Syndication, and Editorial, you'll help build and maintain the infrastructure that powers our sites and products, while continuously improving their performance, reliability, and capabilities.

Brands

Cloudflare and APIs

  • Build and maintain Cloudflare Workers using D1, KV, R2, and Durable Objects.

  • Maintain CI/CD workflows through GitHub Actions.

Ads, syndication, and analytics

  • Integrate and maintain advertising partners.
  • Build and maintain partner feeds.
  • Implement and track Snowplow events and Core Web Vitals.

Job Summary
The Warranty Manager leads warranty activities for completed renewable energy projects throughout their applicable warranty periods. This role serves as the primary client contact for post-turnover warranty matters and is responsible for evaluating and resolving claims, coordinating corrective actions, managing warranty costs, and ensuring repairs are completed safely, documented appropriately, and formally closed with the client. The position works closely with Operations leadership, project teams, equipment manufacturers, subcontractors, facility owners, and O&M providers to protect Flintco’s contractual and financial interests while maintaining strong client relationships. The position coordinates warranty activities across internal project and Operations teams, subcontractors, equipment manufacturers, field personnel, facility owners, and O&M providers. It provides direction and coordination related to claim evaluation, corrective action planning, repair execution, and closeout. This is a remote position with preference towards candidates located closer to Central/Southern Illinois. Travel up to 75%.

    • Verify that subcontractors and field personnel performing warranty work have appropriate qualifications, training, and resources; conduct site visits as needed to evaluate issues, support corrective actions, and verify completed repairs.

Victron Energy is looking for a Sales Manager who builds relationships that last. You’ll grow our business in Poland and Ukraine, working closely with distributors, installers, system integrators, and OEM partners in Off-Grid & Backup Power, Marine, Vehicle, and Industrial applications. Your job is to help them design better systems, sell with confidence, and become long-term Victron partners.

In this region, reliable energy is not an abstract topic. In Ukraine, it keeps homes, hospitals, businesses, and communication networks running. In Poland, the shift towards self-consumption and storage, a strong boatbuilding industry, and a growing vehicle conversion market all create demand for systems that simply work. That’s where we come in, and where you come in.

You’ll work from home (based in Poland) and report to the Regional Sales Director Europe. You’ll travel regularly within Poland, to Ukraine when security conditions allow, to trade shows across Europe, and to our headquarters in Almere, the Netherlands.

Who you are

  • Hands-on experience with Victron products and systems (design, installation, VRM, VictronConnect). This is essential and Victron Professional training is a plus.

  • Proven B2B sales experience working with distributors and installers in the energy, marine, or vehicle sector.

  • Someone people like to call when there’s a problem, and who calls them before there is one.

  • Electrical, electronic, or engineering background, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Comfortable giving technical presentations to an audience of installers as well as to a distributor’s management.

  • Fluent in Polish and/or Ukrainian, with good English (our working language).

  • Build and deepen trusted, long-term relationships with distributors, installers, integrators, and OEMs. Your network is your foundation.

  • Identify and develop new opportunities, from backup power and critical infrastructure to boatbuilders and vehicle converters.

Grow Victron Energy’s presence in Poland and Ukraine. Build strong partnerships, apply your technical expertise, and enjoy the freedom to shape your market and make a real impact.

jobs.excerpt: SummaryThe Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to support and develop the platform serving the world’s favorite encyclopedia, Wikipedia, to millions of people around the globe.
jobs.description:
Summary

The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to support and develop the platform serving the world’s favorite encyclopedia, Wikipedia, to millions of people around the globe. Wikimedia’s Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team is principally responsible for ensuring our global top-10 website and its underlying infrastructure is healthy and developing further in support of Wikimedia’s mission: to help everyone share in the sum of all knowledge.

The SRE team at Wikimedia is a globally distributed and diverse team of engineers with a drive to explore, experiment, and embrace new technologies. We work in the open by publishing all of our documentation, code, and configuration as open source, and all our production systems are powered by open source software. We invite you to go through our documentation and code -- no login required.

If you find what we do interesting, if you are up to the challenge of improving the reliability and delivery of one of the Internet’s top websites, and you enjoy the idea of working in a remote-first role, we may just be the right place for you.

We are currently looking for Site Reliability Engineers for multiple positions.

You are responsible for:

  • Performing day-to-day operational/DevOps tasks on Wikimedia’s public facing infrastructure (deployment, maintenance, configuration, troubleshooting), through critical thinking and expertise, with support of AI tooling
  • Implementing and utilizing configuration management and deployment tools (Puppet, Kubernetes)
  • Leading continuous improvement, by automating the installation, configuration and maintenance of services on our platform
  • Working closely with product teams helping them bring scalable functionality to our users by assisting in the architectural design of new services and making them operate at scale
  • Participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation shared across the broader SRE team. This includes taking part in incident response, diagnosis and follow-up on system outages or alerts across Wikimedia’s production infrastructure.
  • Collaborating with a global, cross-functional team in an asynchronous communication environment
  • Mentoring peers in your areas of technical and operational strength
  • Ability and willingness to travel 1-2 times a year for in-person events and team meetings
  • Most importantly, share our values and work in accordance with them

Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years experience in an SRE/Operations/DevOps role as part of a team
  • Experience with shell and any scripting languages used in an SRE context (Python, Go, Bash, Ruby; we primarily use Python) and configuration management tools (Puppet, Ansible; we use Puppet)
  • Experience with distributed caching systems: including their underlying algorithms and how to optimize their performance
  • A thorough, protocol-level understanding of TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, and DNS
  • Experience with package management on Linux systems (we use Debian)
  • Strong Linux system-level troubleshooting skills
  • History of automating tasks and processes, identifying process gaps, and finding automation opportunities
  • Strong English language skills (verbal and written) and ability to work independently, as an effective part of a globally distributed team working across multiple time zones
  • Experience leading and participating in incident response and post-incident review rituals, with the goal of conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive measures

YOUR POSITION WITH TNC

The Senior Data Engineer focuses on the development of analytics-oriented data models and data ingestion pipelines related to four potential data domains: Fundraising, Conservation Effectiveness, Finance, and Human Resources.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The Senior Data Engineer plans, manages, and performs data engineering tasks within a focused set of data domains to provide quality data to those who need it for decision-making. They analyze and document end user and technology-user business requirements for data projects with wide range of complexity at varying levels of impact on organization-wide initiatives. They design and develop new, complex technology systems and solutions according to system requirements following TNC methodology and development best practices. The Senior Data Engineer acts as a lead technologist on technology application maintenance projects related to application upgrades, conversion and modifications. They perform tasks assigned as required to complete project including design, development, running specific programs, generating reports and analyzing results. They provide support for production problems as assigned. They also act as a final quality assurance analyst to conduct peer reviews and validate programmer analyst work done for moderately complex matters.


RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Gather requirements for new data attributes in collaboration with Analytics, Data Governance, and end users.
  • Create data pipelines to ingest data from Workday, CRM, and the conservation Hub into a shared data lake for future analysis.
  • Utilize fact/dimension design principles to design, build, and maintain datamarts across a set of four potential core data domains: Fundraising, Conservation Effectiveness, Finance, and Human Resources.
  • Work with Data Governance to ensure data in the above domains are properly registered in master data management systems and data catalogs, where applicable.
  • Ensure access to sensitive data is restricted and masking is applied where needed.
  • Produce data structure documentation for both technical and business audiences.
  • Provide support for production problems as assigned.
  • Act as Project or Technical Lead as assigned. Develop accurate project plans with realistic estimations and provide technical expertise to team members and users to help resolve complex project-related problems.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, or a related field and three years of experience in programming and systems design OR an equivalent combination of education and/or experience.
  • Three or more years of experience in data engineering OR an equivalent combination of education and/or experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in SQL, including experience with advanced topics such as window functions, subqueries, and traversing multiple layers of many-to-many joins.
  • Three or more years of experience in Python using data-focused packages (PySpark, Pandas, or similar).
  • Three or more years of fact/dimension modeling experience.
  • Three or more years of experience in a data role involving extensive interaction with non-technical business partners.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstratable experience reconciling financial data from multiple systems (such as credit card receipts against a general ledger) highly desired.
  • Experience using Databricks for data ingestion and curation.
  • Experience with Workday financial and/or Workday HR data.
  • Experience with the Profisee Master Data Management tool.
  • Experience with Microsoft Purview data catalog.
  • Multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experience appreciated.

This description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities required for this job.

Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.


Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreFlosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Fluency, we come together under two shared passions that drive our culture: the scaling of digital ad operations, and fostering a workplace environment rooted in open communication, inclusivity, and a growth-oriented mindset. These passions not only set us apart in the industry, but also fuel our collective drive to reshape the industry and reinvent ourselves along the way. We're not just revolutionizing the digital advertising horizon, we're shaping an organization where every member feels a sense of pride and is inspired to do their best work.

Fluency is the agentic OS for advertising, with $3B in ad spend currently under management. Our platform eliminates the manual execution that traps high-performing teams in low-value work, enabling advertising organizations to thrive in the era of AI. Because Engineering now builds and ships with agents, new channels and capabilities reach the market faster than any manual go-to-market (GTM) process can handle.

As Senior Director, Product Marketing, you will tell that story at the scale it deserves and build the repeatable operating model that lets product marketing scale with the business. You will establish our processes, standards, and cross-functional rhythms—leading our transition to agentic GTM alongside Product leadership while driving both net-new acquisition and customer expansion.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Marketing Operating Model & Launch Execution

  • Own Fluency’s launch playbook across product lines, working closely with Product leadership: the processes, frameworks, and cross-functional workflows that connect product development to market readiness to revenue outcomes. This includes the full delivery pipeline and all go-to-market phases. Drive the integrated launch calendar, define what a successful launch means at Fluency’s stage, and be accountable for the commercial outcomes when we bring something new to market.
  • Own the process discipline that closes the gap between what is built and what customer-facing teams understand to be available, stable, and sellable, with the handoffs and readiness criteria that ensure Sales, CS, and Support are fully equipped before anything reaches the market.
  • Measure and optimize launch impact through influenced pipeline, win rates, time from engineering-complete to GA, and new feature adoption.

Agentic GTM Transformation

  • Partner with Product leadership to design and run Fluency’s agentic GTM process—automating and keeping launches, enablement, documentation, and customer communications current as engineering ships faster.
  • Set the standard for production-grade AI usage across the product marketing organization (e.g., automated launch kits, enablement generation, competitive monitoring, and lifecycle content).

Packaging, Positioning & Master Platform Narrative

  • Co-own core platform and agent packaging with Product, including strategic input on naming and pricing.
  • Own the master platform narrative: translate high-level GTM direction into a platform-level story that holds up in every deal and every stage appearance, and ensure messaging coherence across product lines and outbound surfaces. Build the team and process that produce high-quality positioning consistently, stay ahead of the competitive landscape, and keep the sales team equipped to win head-to-head..
  • Shape Fluency’s GTM segmentation strategy across product lines: how we view the market, where the highest-value opportunities live, and how the portfolio should be positioned against them. Provide structured market input to Product leadership and advise the leadership team on how the portfolio meets the market.
  • Own Fluency’s master pitch deck and strategic account deck portfolio, and set the quality standard for pitch decks and collateral across the PMM team.

Land & Expand Motion & Revenue Enablement

  • Build the product marketing side of our land and expand motion with Product, Sales, CS, and the VP of Growth: segmentation of the installed base, expansion plays and offers, in-product and lifecycle messaging, and the path from first use to multi-product adoption.
  • Own the strategic direction of Sales and CS enablement, ensuring collateral and training directly move win rates, deal velocity, and net revenue retention.
  • Own channel integration launches as a repeatable GTM pattern, maximizing co-marketing and reimbursement-eligible programs with Amazon, Meta, TikTok, Google, and other platform partners.

External Evangelism & Customer Proof

  • Own Fluency’s external voice with analysts, press, and industry audiences.. Be a visible face in the market: speaking at industry conferences, cultivating press coverage, and showing up in the conversations our buyers are already having..
  • Build a Customer Advisory Board (CAB) and own the advocacy programs that turn customer results into a compounding evidence system, so that customer proof makes every deal easier to close than the last..

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Build and lead the product marketing team as Fluency scales. Attract talent that raises the collective bar, mentor Senior and Staff PMMs, and be accountable for the team’s performance.
  • Provide the vision, structure, and systems the team grows within: clear standards for output quality, operating processes that keep PMM workflows in sync, and the market and ecosystem context that helps Senior PMMs take on bigger scope over time.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment as the connective tissue between Product, Business Development, and Marketing at senior level, partnering with Product Management, Creative, Brand, Sales, CS, Demand Generation, and the VP of Growth.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally within ad tech, marketing automation, or complex data operations.
  • Proven track record building and scaling high-performing PMM teams—hiring, mentoring, and maintaining a high bar for execution quality.
  • Demonstrated success driving both net-new acquisition and customer expansion motions (land-and-expand or product-led growth).
  • Hands-on experience building and running agentic or AI-assisted GTM workflows in production (beyond casual tool experimentation).
  • Deep familiarity with the digital advertising ecosystem—how agencies operate, how campaigns run across search, social, and programmatic, and how platform partners structure co-marketing.
  • Established external market presence: conference speaking, analyst relations, press coverage, or executive platform partnerships.
  • Proficiency in a modern revtech stack and data-driven performance marketing analysis.
  • A track record of building not just positioning but the operating processes that make great positioning repeatable across a team.
  • A builder’s instinct: you step into ambiguity and leave behind operating models, frameworks, and processes the team can scale with.
  • A track record of developing PMMs: setting the vision, structure, and systems that help senior team members grow

Fluency pays all employees based on U.S. nationwide averages for each role, designed to ensure pay equity. This is a full-time, remote position that requires legal authorization to work in the U.S. Starting pay range is determined by job-related skills, experience, and knowledge. The role is also eligible for a discretionary bonus, equity options, and a comprehensive benefits package including:

jobs.title: QA Manager, EPIC Loan Systems
jobs.excerpt: We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity.
jobs.description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

About EPIC Loan Systems

EPIC Loan Systems is a specialized financial technology company providing lending software solutions to businesses in the lending industry. EPIC has been part of Aquila since 2018, providing specialized lending software that helps clients manage their operations, supported by a team committed to solving problems and building lasting relationships.

Its core product is a Loan Management System that helps lenders manage their end-to-end lending operations, from loan processing and administration to reporting and data management.

The company focuses on simplifying complex lending processes, improving operational efficiency, and building long-term relationships with its clients. As part of Aquila and the broader Constellation Software group, EPIC combines the agility of a specialized software business with the support and resources of an established global organization.

Who we need

Reporting to the Director of Engineering, we are hiring a QA Manager to transform our approach to software quality. In this newly created role, you will lead the shift from predominantly manual testing to sustainable automation, practical AI applications, and stronger quality practices throughout development and release. Combining technical expertise with leadership, you will work alongside an established QA team to strengthen its capabilities, improve test coverage, and build a more consistent and scalable approach to delivering reliable lending software.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada, with working hours of 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time.

What’s in it for you

Ownership and influence. You will have the freedom to challenge existing approaches, evaluate new tools, and introduce practical applications of automation and AI. Working directly with engineering leadership in a lean organization, you will influence decisions, put your recommendations into practice, and see the results without navigating layers of approvals.

Lead and grow. You will have the opportunity to shape the future of QA, establish stronger standards, and develop the capabilities of an established team. You will influence how testing evolves while remaining directly involved in technical challenges and solutions. As the function matures, you will be well positioned to help guide its continued development.

Make an impact. At EPIC Loan Systems, your contributions will be visible, and your work will directly support the reliability of software our clients depend on to manage their lending operations. You will have the opportunity to make your mark within a smaller, collaborative business, with the backing of Aquila and Constellation Software and access to a broader network of software companies for continued learning and career growth.

As our new QA Manager, you will

  • Drive quality. You will contribute directly to functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end testing, identifying risks and investigating defects before they affect clients. You will collaborate with Engineering and Product to strengthen test coverage, support QA and UAT deployments, and validate release readiness, improving confidence in the software we deliver.
  • Advance automation. You will lead the transition from predominantly manual testing to a more automated approach, evaluating tools, developing sustainable test frameworks, and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. You will explore practical applications of AI to improve test creation, coverage, and troubleshooting, helping the team work more effectively.
  • Lead and mentor a collaborative team. You will provide technical direction to an established, geographically distributed QA team, sharing knowledge, strengthening testing capabilities, and supporting automation adoption. You will encourage collaboration, consistent practices, and shared accountability for quality while contributing directly to technical problem-solving.
  • Improve how we work. You will establish consistent testing standards, strengthen defect management and release validation, and identify opportunities to improve QA processes. You will work across teams to identify issues earlier, reduce repetitive tasks, and make quality integral to software delivery.

You bring

  • The leadership experience. You have successfully led or provided technical direction to QA professionals, mentored colleagues, and improved team testing practices. You are comfortable setting priorities, sharing expertise, and supporting others while contributing directly to testing and technical problem-solving.
  • The testing expertise. You have a strong foundation in functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end testing of complex software applications. You can develop effective test strategies, assess risks, investigate defects, and validate releases while balancing quality requirements with delivery priorities.
  • The automation skills. You have experience developing, implementing, and maintaining automated testing frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress. You understand how to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and can make informed decisions about where automation adds value and where manual testing remains important.
  • The technical skills. You have experience testing APIs, writing SQL queries to validate data, working with Azure DevOps, BitBucket, and using application logs to investigate issues. You can collaborate with developers to understand technical problems, identify root causes, and improve test coverage. Familiarity with AWS, performance testing, or lending and financial technology software would be an asset.
  • The drive to improve. You are motivated to strengthen testing practices and find practical ways to improve quality, consistency, and efficiency. You are curious about emerging technologies, including AI-assisted testing, and can evaluate their potential to deliver meaningful improvements. You take initiative and focus on building solutions the team can sustain.
  • The collaborative approach. You communicate clearly, share knowledge, and build productive relationships across Engineering, Product, and other teams. You can provide direction and support to colleagues working across different locations and time zones, helping everyone stay aligned on quality standards and shared priorities.
  • The flexibility. You can occasionally travel, up to 10% of the time. You understand the importance of being available to help when clients need additional support.

Why join?

EPIC Loan Systems and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

Compensation

At EPIC Loan Systems and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is $130,000–$150,000.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • An interview with the Director of Engineering to explore your experience in quality assurance, test automation, technical leadership, and approaches to improving testing practices.
  • A final interview with the General Manager to discuss your approach to collaboration, leadership, and contributing to the long-term success of EPIC Loan Systems.

Aquila and EPIC Loan Systems promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request.

We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

jobs.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:


Dexcom's Strategic Finance team helps shape the company's long-term growth agenda by connecting strategy, market dynamics, and financial performance into a clear view of where the business is headed. The team partners across Finance, Commercial, Product, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Corporate Development, and regional leadership to translate complex business questions into actionable financial insights and support enterprise-level decision-making.


As New Business Development Manager, Strategic Finance, you will play a central role in Dexcom's Long-Range Planning (LRP) process, helping coordinate the development, consolidation, and communication of the company's multi-year outlook. You will work closely with country and regional leaders to understand the drivers behind their forecasts and help ensure local assumptions align with external sources and are appropriately reflected in a consistent global plan.


You will also help create tighter alignment between the LRP and Dexcom's Worldwide Market Model, connecting market sizing, market access, CGM adoption, competitive dynamics, product launches, market share, pricing, utilization, and other strategic drivers to the financial forecast.


Where you come in:


  • You will help manage and continuously improve Dexcom's annual LRP process, partnering across regional and country leadership, Finance, Commercial, Market Access, Product, Strategy, and other functions to develop a cohesive global multi-year outlook.
  • You will serve as a key Strategic Finance partner to country and regional leaders throughout the forecasting process, helping structure assumptions, challenge inputs, identify gaps, and translate local market dynamics into financially sound forecasts.
  • You will drive closer alignment between the Worldwide Market Model and the LRP, ensuring market-level assumptions such as TAM, SAM, CGM penetration, Dexcom share, market access, pricing, utilization, retention, product launches, competitive dynamics, and geographic expansion appropriately connect to the financial outlook.
  • You will partner with Finance and Commercial teams to connect near-term forecasts, annual planning, and the LRP, helping establish consistent assumptions, definitions, timelines, and handoffs across planning processes.
  • You will evaluate and pressure-test key forecast assumptions and business drivers through historical trends, scenario analysis, sensitivities, internal operating data, external market information, and comparisons with prior planning cycles.
  • You will help translate market access, reimbursement, regulatory, competitive, and product developments into financial implications, working with subject-matter experts to understand how the timing and probability of key milestones affect country-level forecasts.
  • You will consolidate regional and functional inputs into clear enterprise-level insights, identifying key growth drivers, risks, opportunities, and changes versus prior plans and translating them into executive-ready materials and recommendations.
  • You will improve the scalability, governance, and quality of the planning process, including standardized templates, assumption documentation, validation controls, version management, dashboards, and clear ownership of inputs.
  • You will support broader Strategic Finance priorities throughout the year, including scenario planning, market and portfolio analysis, strategic initiatives, business cases, management reporting, and other financial analyses that support senior leadership decision-making.

What makes you successful:


  • You bring strong finance experience and a solid foundation in financial planning and analysis, ideally including long-range planning, forecasting, strategic finance, commercial finance, corporate finance, or a closely related discipline.
  • You have strong financial modeling skills and understand how operating assumptions translate into revenue, margin, financial forecasts, scenarios, and long-term business outcomes while leveraging AI tools for efficiency.
  • You are highly proficient in Excel and comfortable working with large, complex datasets, building models that are accurate, transparent, scalable, and easy to audit.
  • You understand the relationship between market dynamics and financial performance, including market size, penetration, market share, pricing, volume, product mix, geographic expansion, and other commercial drivers.
  • You are an effective cross-functional partner who can work directly with country leaders, regional teams, Finance, Commercial, Market Access, Product, and other stakeholders to challenge assumptions constructively and drive alignment.
  • You can move comfortably between detailed analysis and executive-level communication, translating complex assumptions and financial analyses into concise insights, risks, opportunities, and recommendations.
  • You have strong project-management and organizational skills and can coordinate a complex planning process involving multiple geographies, stakeholders, inputs, deadlines, and review cycles.
  • Experience in healthcare, medical devices, diabetes, or another regulated industry is preferred. Familiarity with regulatory, reimbursement, and market-access processes is a plus, particularly the ability to understand how approvals, reimbursement milestones, product launches, and market access changes can influence revenue timing and adoption.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Copilot, financial planning systems, or other business-intelligence tools is a plus.

What you'll get:


  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:


  • 5-15%

  • Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 8-12 years of related experience.
  • At this level a graduate degree may be desirable with 4 years of related experience.

Remote Workplace:Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Software Engineer to build technology solutions that help public health programs operate more effectively. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working directly with users, understanding complex operational problems, and turning them into reliable software that delivers measurable value.


As an embedded member of a cross-functional team, you will partner with program staff, technical assistance providers, product teams, engineers, and client stakeholders. You will help uncover needs, shape solutions, build and test them with users, and take successful capabilities into production. The role combines full-stack software engineering, workflow automation, data integration, and applied AI in an environment where requirements evolve as teams learn.


You will be successful if you are equally comfortable writing production code, talking with users, working through ambiguity, and making pragmatic technical decisions.


Responsibilities

Discover and define: Work directly with program teams, client stakeholders, and end users to understand operational challenges, identify opportunities for technology, and translate loosely defined problems into practical technical solutions.

Prototype and build: Design and build across the full stack, including user experiences, application services, APIs, relational data models, integrations, workflows, dashboards, and reporting. Move quickly from problem definition to working prototypes and iterate with real user feedback.

Apply AI where it adds value: Build AI-assisted capabilities such as summarization, structured extraction, classification, and workflow support. Preserve appropriate human review and account for reliability, privacy, data governance, and responsible use.

Deploy and improve: Move successful capabilities into reliable production environments with maintainability, security, error handling, traceability, testing, and operational support in mind. Observe usage, diagnose issues, and improve solutions based on feedback.

Scale what works: Turn lessons from program-specific implementations into reusable platform capabilities, technical patterns, and components. Surface gaps between platform capabilities and real-world needs and feed those insights back to product and engineering teams.

Communicate clearly: Explain technical options, feasibility, tradeoffs, and constraints to technical and non-technical audiences. Support demonstrations, walkthroughs, and hands-on sessions with users and stakeholders.


Qualifications

Required

  • 3 years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful full-stack development experience.

Additional Qualifications

  • Strong programming skills and experience building modern web applications with JavaScript/TypeScript or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with relational databases, APIs, external services, and production software delivery.
  • Ability to work directly with users and stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver iteratively when requirements are incomplete or changing.
  • Experience with version control, code review, testing, and collaborative software development practices.

Preferred

  • Client-facing, embedded, consulting, or Forward Deployed Engineering experience.
  • Experience integrating LLM capabilities into applications, including summarization, structured extraction, classification, evaluation, or AI-enabled workflows.
  • Experience building multi-step workflows, stateful applications, or human-in-the-loop processes.
  • Experience with case management, workflow, grant management, or program management systems.
  • Cloud-native development, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, or production operations experience.
  • Experience with government technology environments, sensitive data, data governance, privacy, or responsible AI.
  • Interest or experience in health, public health, rural health, or public-sector program delivery.
  • Professional use of AI-assisted software engineering tools.

How You’ll Work and What Success Looks Like

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, users, and real-world operations. You will not simply receive a backlog of fully defined requirements. You will work with stakeholders to understand what they are trying to accomplish, determine the right technical approach, and move from idea to working software. Some problems will require traditional engineering; others may benefit from workflow automation, data integration, or AI.


In your first six months, success means developing a strong understanding of the program and its users, building trusted working relationships, and delivering production capabilities that address meaningful operational needs. Over your first year, you will help turn lessons from individual implementations into reusable capabilities and engineering patterns that make future delivery faster and more consistent.


Technology environment: JavaScript/TypeScript-based front-end development, server-side application development, relational databases, RESTful APIs, cloud services, workflow and state management, LLM-enabled application patterns, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies matter more than matching every tool in the stack.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.

Business Development Representative

  • Full time
  • Location: Remote, with regular travel to meet prospects and attend trade shows and industry events

This isn't a dial-and-log-it BDR role. We sell to large contractors, and the people you’ll talk to are CFOs, controllers and operations leaders who expect you to understand their business. You’ll work a short list of high-value accounts, research deeply, run the first qualifying conversation yourself, and hand our AEs opportunities that are qualified, multi-threaded and ready to close.

About Assignar

Assignar is a mission-led construction tech company. Sean McCreanor (co-founder and CEO) started Assignar in 2014 after running his own contracting business and finding there weren't any good tools for it. Today we work with hundreds of customers, from multi-million-dollar contractors to specialist crews.

We've found product-market fit. Assignar is the all-in-one margin control platform for contractors. leading digital construction operations for contractors: real-time visibility across jobsites, smart scheduling of workers to projects, equipment tracking, and data that shapes the next bid. We connect the field and finance so contractors protect margin on every job and get paid accurately and faster.

What does "own the top of the funnel" actually mean?

You'll sit inside the Marketing team and be the first real conversation most contractors have with Assignar. You'll decide who's worth pursuing, find the right people inside them, run the first discovery conversation, keep it warm and set up the AE to win.

You'll report to Madeline Crowley (VP of Marketing) and work closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineers and Marketing. What you hear from prospects every day will shape how we go to market.

What you'll own

  • Go after the right accounts. Research and prioritise target accounts with your AE and Marketing, and qualify inbound leads hard against our ICP. Move on quickly from accounts that don’t fit. Spend your time where it counts.
  • Start conversations that go somewhere. Run multi-channel outreach (phone, email, LinkedIn and video) personalised to each recipient. Multi-thread every account to reach finance and operations leaders, not just one contact.
  • Keep warm prospects warm. Nurture prospects between meetings with follow-up that's useful, not pushy.
  • Turn engagement into pipeline. Follow up personally with prospects who attend our webinars, events and campaigns.
  • Set the AE up to win. Hand off opportunities with the buying group mapped, the economic buyer identified, the problem sized and a dated next step.
  • Show up in person. Attend trade shows and industry events like CCF and association days, and meet contractors where they are.
  • Run discovery yourself. Lead video qualification calls with an industry-specific deck. Confirm fit, identify the economic buyer and size the problem before the opportunity moves to an AE.
  • Close the loop with feedback. Share what's landing and what isn't.
  • Keep Salesforce clean. Using agents, log every call, email and meeting, and keep lead and contact records current so anyone on the team can pick up an account and know exactly where it’s at.
  • Own your number. You’re measured on qualified pipeline and revenue from right-fit accounts, not meetings booked.

Who you are

  • An experienced BDR. 2+ years in B2B sales development, ideally selling into mid-market or enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders. SaaS preferred, and construction or trades experience is a bonus.
  • Pipeline-driven. You have a track record of hitting or beating your number on qualified pipeline or revenue, not just activity.
  • At home in the modern sales stack. Salesforce, Salesloft and Clay feel familiar, and you use AI tools to research and personalise faster.
  • A sharp writer and communicator. The best BDRs at Assignar write emails that customers actually reply to, because they’re written for the recipient, not the sender. They’re just as strong on the phone and on video.
  • Curious about construction. You don't need to have worked in the industry, but you want to understand how contractors run their business.
  • Organised and self-directed. You manage your own pipeline, move fast and like being part of a supportive team.
  • Resourceful. You don’t wait for leads. You build your own target lists from industry associations, customer lookalikes and public project data.
  • Comfortable talking to finance. You can hold a credible conversation with a CFO or controller about margin, cash flow and job costing.
  • Ambitious. You want to grow into an AE role, and you’ll keep building your skills, especially with AI, to get there.

The tools you'll work with

Salesforce · Salesloft · Clay · AI tools and agents · Apollo · JustCall

Why Join

  • You'll be part of a company with real product-market fit and a clear market to go after.
  • You'll work directly with go-to-market team members and participate in turning your daily work into revenue.
  • You'll get out to events and meet the people who use our product.
  • You'll be in a small team where your ideas about what's working get heard and used.

How we hire

We keep it quick and practical. We care about how you think, how you write and how you talk to people.

  • Apply via Breezy. Tell us a bit about yourself and what you've been working on.
  • Phone screen with Sophie, Head of People & Culture (30 min). Get to know each other and ask us anything.
  • Interview with Madeline, VP of Marketing (45 to 60 min). Your experience, how you prospect and how you work with a sales team.
  • Reference checks. We’ll speak with two or three people you’ve worked with, ideally a former manager, to hear how you prospect, how you handle a number and what you’re like on a team.

What we stand for: Our Values

  • Do what's right
  • Customers are our why
  • Grow with purpose
  • One team

We value inclusion and welcome applicants from every background. If any part of this process needs to look different for you, let us know and we'll adjust.

No recruiters please · We respond to every application within 5 business days
