Dodatkowe punkty zyskasz, jeśli:

  • jesteś gotowy zostać mentorem dla innych developerów
  • jesteś chętny do dzielenia się wiedzą oraz dobrymi praktykami
  • odnajdujesz się w metodologii Scrum & Agile
  • znasz i stosujesz podejścia TDD i DDD

Co powinno Ci się spodobać:

  • tworzymy własne paczki Laravelowe
  • zapoczątkowaliśmy oraz dalej współtworzymy Poznań Laravel Meetup
  • pracujemy tylko na najnowszych wersjach oprogramowania (Laravel 7 (zaraz 8) i PHP 7.4)
  • stawiamy na to aby programiści (i nie tylko) mieli work-life balance - dlatego unikamy nadgodzin jak ognia
  • mamy pełną transparentność finansową oraz projektową firmy
  • mamy bardzo dobrze ułożoną pracę zdalną
  • korzystamy z każdego systemu operacyjnego i narzędzi usprawniających pracę (ale nie kontrolujących ruchu Twojej myszki!) - Asana, GitHub, Float, Everhour
  • przybliżony podział czasu pracy (zależy od projektu: 80% tworzenie nowych funkcjonalności, 20% utrzymanie i serwis)
  • partnerskie podejście - zależy nam na tym, by każdy czuł się częścią zespołu od samego początku, otrzymywał wartościowy feedback i feedforward oraz karteczki wdzięczności - docenienia są u nas na porządku dziennym!
  • masz wpływ na architekturę (jeżeli chcesz - zachęcamy wszystkich, nawet juniorów, do dyskusji i udziału w planowaniu)
  • inwestujemy w rozwój: dev-talks raz na tyg, sesje 1:1, dostęp do naszej biblioteki oraz kursów, możliwość zostania prelegentem, livecodingi dev2dev
  • możliwość wprowadzania ulepszeń - bardzo cenimy nowe pomysły
  • pracujemy Agilowo, w niewielkich zespołach

Konkretnie, na co możesz jeszcze liczyć:

  • wynagrodzenie między 6k a 9k netto + VAT [B2B]
  • pracę w pełnym wymiarze godzin w naszym biurze w Poznaniu albo zdalnie z każdego miejsca w Polsce lub za granicą
  • 26 dni urlopu w roku + 4 dni firmowo wolne od pracy (2 maja, piątek po Bożym Ciele, 24 grudnia, 31 grudnia), bo tak rozumiemy work-life balance
  • elastyczny czas pracy - zaczynamy między 7:00 a 10:00
  • współfinansowanie zajęć ze świetnym lektorem od języka angielskiego
  • możliwość przystąpienia do Multisportu

Co cenimy we współpracy niezależnie od roli?

  • komunikacja - potrafisz prosto przekazać swoje myśli,
  • samodzielność i odpowiedzialność - szukamy osób, które świadomie umieją podejmować decyzję i się tego nie boją, czują się swobodnie w środowisku, gdzie jedyną osobą kontrolującą Twoją pracę jesteś Ty sam,
  • brak micro-managementu = zaufanie - od samego początku dostajesz zadania, za które jesteś odpowiedzialny i każdy Ci ufa, że uda Ci się to dowieźć,
  • szybka adaptacja - staramy się aby nasze zespoły miały jeden projekt do rozwijania, czasem jest to kilka projektów na przemian, szukamy osób, które odnajdują się w takim środowisku,
  • mentoring - super, jeśli masz doświadczenie w mentoringu innych członków zespołu lub jesteś na tę kwestię otwarty.

Kilka słów od Developera - co i jak robimy...

Najważniejsze są podstawy i wspólny język (standard) w programowaniu. Potem już zostaje rozwijać się każdego dnia i uczyć nowych rzeczy, mając przy tym z tego frajdę. To właśnie robię na co dzień.

Bardzo cenimy sobie flexibility - pracę mogę zacząć z domu albo pójść do biura - po uprzednim zgłoszeniu mogę nawet pracować z pociągu. Pełna dowolność - liczy się zrobiona praca oraz komunikacja. Jeśli lubisz ekosystem Laravela i to w jaki sposób łączy się z Vue, to poczujesz się jak ryba w wodzie. W firmie panuje ogólnoprzyjęty zakaz korzystania z jQuery w nowych projektach. Jako że jesteśmy małym teamem, to masz realny wpływ na to w jaki sposób działamy. Stawiamy na najnowsze rozwiązania - przegrywanie plików przez FTP na produkcję? U nas nie przejdzie.

Możesz być pewien, że zawsze dostaniesz merytoryczny feedback. Co tydzień spotykamy się w gronie programistów i rozmawiamy o problemach, rozwiązaniach i pomysłach. Każdy ma u nas swój głos, który jest słyszany. Każdy może mieć wpływ na to jak pracujemy i na rozwój swój i innych. Zawsze możesz się spotkać z PTL, z CTO i porozmawiać na każdy temat.

Najważniejsza jest u nas komunikacja i wzajemne zrozumienie, oraz rozumienie biznesu. Jeśli tylko chcesz się rozwijać, uczyć i chcesz brać odpowiedzialność za swoją pracę to pasujesz do naszego zespołu.

jobs.excerpt: From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity.
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

As a Business Value Engineer at Fivetran, you’ll own value realization across the customer lifecycle, making sure the outcomes we promise are the outcomes customers realize, measure, and renew on. You’ll partner with Customer Solutions, Customer Services, and Sales to drive expansion, strengthen customer loyalty, prevent churn, and prove the impact of Fivetran. You’ll regularly present to customers and executives as a trusted advisor, and you’ll build the tooling that automates value reporting at scale.

This is a high-visibility role at one of the fastest-growing, AI-powered data companies, combining technical depth, analytical rigor, and business-value expertise.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with Customer Solutions, Customer Services, and Sales on value realization plans that drive expansion and prevent churn.
  • Present value progress and outcomes to customers, including Champions and executives, and align on success criteria.
  • Bridge the sales cycle and the customer lifecycle by turning pre-sale business cases and success criteria into measurable outcomes, KPIs, and adoption milestones.
  • Help customers realize intended value by understanding gaps between expected and actual results and driving corrective action.
  • Build tools and automation that generate customer value reports at scale from usage data.
  • Lead business value reviews and renewal and expansion business cases for Champions, Economic Buyers, and executives, including AI-driven outcomes.
  • Analyze usage and consumption patterns to surface expansion opportunities, flag at-risk accounts early, and tie spend to quantified value.
  • Build value-based GTM motions, including expansion plays and churn-prevention playbooks.
  • Enable and support Customer Solutions, Customer Services, and Sales teams, and share frameworks and tools across the practice.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, work independently, and bring ambition to building programs from the ground up.
  • Are a confident, empathetic communicator who can translate technical capabilities, including AI, into business impact.
  • Bring a consulting mindset: structured, curious, analytical, and a strong storyteller.
  • Are committed to customer success.

Bonus Skills​

  • Business Value experience at a high-growth, AI-forward data company, ideally building a team from the ground up.
  • A track record of influencing Business executives and driving measurable outcomes through renewals and expansions.
  • Experience quantifying the value of data and AI initiatives.
  • Experience building automated value, adoption, or health reporting for customers.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years in value engineering, consulting, solutions or sales engineering, post-sales or technical support, or business value roles.
  • Comfortable presenting to customers, including executive audiences and Economic Buyers.
  • Required: experience with usage-based or consumption-based pricing, including business cases, tracking value against consumption, and supporting expansion and retention.
  • Technical background as a consultant or data practitioner, with hands-on SQL and data pipeline, modeling, BI, and AI experience.
  • Expert knowledge of value-based selling and value realization, including presenting business cases to Economic Buyers and executives.
  • Experience prioritizing use cases and acting as a change agent through a value delivery model.
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams, stay responsive, take on challenging problems, and act decisively amid ambiguity.

This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.

OTE (On Target Earning)
$197,516.45—$274,329.23 USD

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

jobs.title: Solution Architect (US)
jobs.excerpt: The Machine is the agentic operating system for marketing, built by Code and Theory.
jobs.description:
The Machine is the agentic operating system for marketing, built by Code and Theory. It plugs into the tools marketing teams use and turns disconnected workflows into a single intelligent system, connecting brand strategy, creative production, and media performance. The Machine helps power agencies across Stagwell's network and world-leading brands.

As a Solution Architect, you own how The Machine lands inside a customer’s environment, from the first technical conversation through production. You assess the client’s cloud, data, and security landscape, design the integration architecture, and stay close enough to the build to make sure it works. You are the technical voice customers trust and the person who turns their requirements into a deployment our implementation engineers can execute. You’ll spend as much time in working sessions with client DevOps, security, and marketing technology teams as you do in code.

Our engineers are AI native and engage in and advance the state of the art in the practice of software development flow with AI.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead technical discovery and scoping with enterprise clients, assessing their cloud, data stack, and security perimeter, and turning findings into a clear architecture and deployment plan
  • Design client environments and integrations across GCP, AWS, or Azure, including infrastructure as code, container orchestration, IAM, and data pipelines that connect client systems to The Machine, with raw data staying inside the client’s perimeter
  • Stay hands-on through delivery, write code, validate configurations, and work with implementation engineers to debug and unblock critical phases
  • Own customer relationships through delivery, including the hard conversations about scope, timelines, and tradeoffs
  • Feed what you learn back into the platform roadmap, and turn each engagement into reusable patterns, runbooks, and playbooks

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 7+ years of engineering experience, including 2+ years in architecture, solutions, or customer-facing technical delivery for a software or platform product
  • Production experience on at least two of GCP, AWS, or Azure, with strong Terraform, Kubernetes, and enterprise API integration skills (OAuth 2.0, gateways, rate limiting)
  • Solid security fundamentals, including credential management, container hardening, and data residency
  • Strong communication skills and a track record of leading technical conversations with enterprise engineering and IT teams
  • Fluency with AI-enabled development tools and agent-driven workflows, with the judgment to review and harden AI-assisted output; hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs into production systems is a plus

NICE TO HAVE

  • Marketing technology experience (DAM, CDP, CRM) and familiarity with tools like Figma, Slack, Adobe, and performance dashboards
  • Agency, consultancy, or product company background serving multiple enterprise clients at once
  • Cloud architecture certification (AWS, GCP, or Azure) or pre-sales/RFP experience

ABOUT US

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic.

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We’re always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

The compensation range for this role is $160,000 – $220,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A day in the life:

This position mainly focuses on the execution of design deliverables with a goal to grow your digital marketing mindset while working alongside a team of fellow designers, editors and strategists.

  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Work closely with a team of designers, editors, and ACDs in the execution of all design deliverables for your pod and owned accounts
  • Collaborate with our Creative & Marketing teams to craft creative & engaging designs/content across various marketing channels
  • Areas of focus include: Social Media, Paid Advertising, Email, Content Marketing, Infographics and Branding
  • Maintain an organized workflow and keep to deadlines across multiple projects
  • Receive and incorporate feedback from from stakeholders throughout the review process
  • Apply learnings from Power metrics & other creative content that's out in the world
  • Keep a pulse on design trends + implementing them into client’s content strategy in a timely manner

  • Attention to detail on all work, timelines, and communication with fellow team members

jobs.title: Copy of Senior Manager, Royalty Administration & Onboarding
jobs.excerpt: Established in 2015, Create Music Group is a leading music and entertainment company.
jobs.description:
Established in 2015, Create Music Group is a leading music and entertainment company. The company operates as a record label, distribution company, and entertainment network which generates over 15 billion music streams each month on DSP’s. Named #2 on the Inc 5000 Fastest Growth Companies in America in 2020, the company has grown exponentially by leveraging its owned IP with its media and technology platform. The company works with superstar artists, major and independent record labels, and global media brands. It operates a number of companies including Label Engine, one of the largest independent music distribution platforms in the world, with over 75,000 artists and 5,000 label clients; and Flighthouse, a digital entertainment brand focused on Gen Z, which has more than 300 million followers across social media. Create Music Group is based in Hollywood, CA and has 400 employees worldwide.

Job Summary

At Create Music Group, acquiring a catalog is only the beginning. The next step is turning each acquisition into a fully operational royalty business — accurately configured, scalable, and built to serve artists, partners, and rightsholders for the long term.

The Senior Manager, Royalty Administration & Onboarding plays a critical role in making that happen. This leader oversees the royalty onboarding strategy for newly acquired catalogs, translating complex deal terms into clear, effective royalty structures and workflows across Create’s systems. From interpreting acquisition agreements to designing the future-state setup, this role ensures every catalog is positioned for accurate and efficient royalty administration from day one.

As a key partner to our M&A, Finance, Legal, and Royalties teams, the Senior Manager is involved early in the acquisition lifecycle—including during diligence—to identify royalty requirements, surface potential gaps, and help shape a seamless transition into Create’s platform. The role works closely with the Director of Royalties and leads a growing team responsible for bringing each onboarding strategy to life.

This is an opportunity to sit at the intersection of music rights, acquisitions, operations, and technology at a company that continues to expand its global catalog and platform. We’re looking for a leader who understands the details of royalty administration but can also see the bigger picture: how to build scalable processes, navigate complex deals, and create an exceptional foundation for every catalog that joins Create Music Group.

Responsibilities

  • Own contract-to-system royalty interpretation company-wide: rates, splits, territories, escalators, cross-collateralization, recoupment, and defensible workarounds where a platform cannot implement a term literally.
  • Own the Royalties Readiness Gate for incoming acquisitions. Issue the go/no-go recommendation on every acquisition before it enters statement processing, with peer review from the Senior Manager, Royalty Accounting & Operations.
  • Own the handoff packet standard for incoming acquisitions. Every acquisition handoff states plainly what is final, what is assumed, and what remains open. No acquisition transfers to operations without one.
  • Lead contractual royalty obligation analysis for acquisitions, including a written risk/reward recommendation on onboarding methodology — migrate the label into our systems, or leave it on its existing platform.
  • Represent Royalties in M&A diligence from LOI. Own the royalty section of the diligence memo and the list of closing conditions Royalties depends on.
  • Own the team's project portfolio: expense validation tooling, bulk and automated ingestion of expenses, sales, and contracts, the M&A onboarding checklist, and automated metadata, contract, and payor template generation derived from statement analysis.
  • Own role-based access and configuration governance across all royalty systems. Define who may create clients, update splits, and alter contract terms — and enforce it.
  • Establish and enforce upstream intake requirements from other departments for expense, advance, and account-creation requests, so approved requests specify the opportunity, amount, and recipient before work is initiated.
  • Run prior-acquisition review: find and correct configuration and mapping errors from past integrations before they compound
  • Set, publish, and hold the KPIs for both integration and ongoing operations: time-to-royalty-ready per acquisition, post-close error rate, and Label Administration team throughput, quality, and escalation resolution at this role's level rather than the Director's.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop the Label Administration and Integration teams, including two people managers
  • Other related duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in music business, accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; in lieu of a degree, 5+ years of applicable royalty administration and royalty operations experience in the music industry will be considered.
  • 4+ years of relevant royalty administration or royalty operations experience
  • 2+ years of people management experience, ideally including managing other managers, or clearly ready to step into that
  • A demonstrated track record of catalog integration or onboarding — you have migrated an acquired catalog onto a platform, not just administered one already in place
  • Hands-on experience translating contract terms — rates, splits, territories, escalators, cross-collateralization, recoupment — into system configuration. Experience handling advanced multi-layer royalty recoupment models and cross collateralization highly desirable.
  • Experience configuring an enterprise royalty or rights-management platform (Label Engine, Curve, Vistex Music Maestro and/or Record Maestro, Counterpoint, or SR1) at a configuration level, not just day-to-day operation
  • Able to read an acquisition agreement, schedule, or exhibit and identify what it requires of a royalty system before configuration begins
  • Judgment to design a defensible workaround when a platform cannot implement a contract term literally, and to document why
  • Experience owning access and configuration governance: defining who may create clients, update splits, or alter contract terms, and holding that line across departments
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including writing a recommendation that a diligence or finance audience can act on
  • Organized and accurate across concurrent acquisitions at different stages and day to day administration of onboarded catalogs and direct signings

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with advanced royalty recoupment models and cross-collateralization
  • Experience representing a function in M&A diligence
  • Working knowledge of SQL against a cloud data warehouse: able to run and adapt a query to validate a configuration or a migration
  • Experience with template or tooling automation — metadata, contract, or payor template generation, or bulk ingestion of expenses, sales, and contracts
  • Familiarity with DDEX or DSR reporting standards
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Sigma, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI
  • Background at a major label, large independent, or distributor

Pay Scale

  • $90,000 - $120,000 USD per year
  • The final compensation within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

Fair Chance Policy

In accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with criminal histories. We evaluate candidates based on their qualifications and the nature of the offense in relation to the job for which they are applying.

Type: Full-time; exempt
Salary: $60,000 - $65,000 commensurate with experience and qualifications
Location: Remote (U.S. based)
Reports to: Vice President, Workforce Strategy & Innovation
Anticipated start: January 2027
Benefits: Health, dental, vision insurance, retirement contribution, personal time off, flexible work schedule, home office stipend

About IREC

IREC is an independent nonprofit that builds the foundation for rapid adoption of clean energy and energy efficiency to benefit people, the economy, and our planet. Our vision is a 100% clean energy future that is reliable, resilient, and equitable.

IREC develops and advances the regulatory reforms, technical standards, and workforce and community-based solutions needed to enable the streamlined integration of clean energy. IREC provides independent leadership and trusted clean energy expertise through three interrelated strategies:

  • Workforce Development - IREC leads initiatives to build a diverse and qualified clean energy workforce while ensuring that clean energy workers have access to family-sustaining careers.
  • Local Initiatives - IREC supports communities to develop policies and promote best practices that accelerate the equitable deployment of clean energy.
  • State Regulatory Engagement - IREC represents the public interest in state regulatory proceedings and develops and disseminates best practices to ensure that distributed energy resources (DERs) can be equitably and efficiently integrated on the electric grid.

IREC Foundational Values

  • We value diversity of backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and thoughts and believe they result in better outcomes and greater organizational impact.
  • We value the uniqueness and dignity of each individual and their right to be their true and complete self.
  • We believe in the potential of the clean energy transition to advance equity in our nation.

About the Position

The Interstate Renewable Energy Council (IREC) is seeking an organized, people-focused program associate to join its Workforce team. Working with the Vice President, Workforce Strategy & Innovation, workforce colleagues, and partners, you will help job seekers find their way into clean energy careers and help move projects from workplan to delivery.

A core part of this role is serving as the first point of contact for all Workforce inquiries. You will help job seekers explore clean energy careers, understand training and Registered Apprenticeship options, and connect with training providers, employers, and workforce programs. You will also triage technical assistance requests from training providers, employers, and other partners, answering what you can and routing the rest to the right staff lead. In addition, you will coordinate group technical assistance, office hours, and webinars; keep information on Green Workforce Connect, IREC's workforce platform, current and accurate; and maintain the records the team relies on to meet its commitments.

The role also contributes to outreach, writing, and resource development. You will help recruit employers, training providers, and job seekers into IREC's programs; draft communications for partners and job seekers; and research and write practical resources such as fact sheets, guides, and career exploration content.

The associate works across IREC's Workforce portfolio as priorities shift, rather than on a single program. This role suits someone with experience supporting job seekers or coordinating programs who writes clearly, manages details well, and builds trust quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the first point of contact for all Workforce inquiries, including job seeker questions and technical assistance requests from training providers, employers, apprenticeship programs, workforce organizations, and other partners. Triage each request, respond directly where you can, route complex requests to the right staff lead, and track each one through to resolution.
  • Help build and maintain the team's intake and referral process, including response standards, a referral map, and follow-up tracking.
  • Learn about job seekers' interests, skills, and goals; explain clean energy/energy efficiency career pathways, training, certification, and Registered Apprenticeship options; and connect people with training providers, apprenticeship programs, employers, and other local resources.
  • Lead or support guided career exploration sessions and one-on-one and small-group follow-up for job seekers, including participants in IREC's online career exploration courses.
  • Support outreach and recruitment that brings employers, training providers, apprenticeship programs, and job seekers into IREC's workforce programs and Green Workforce Connect, communicating program benefits clearly to each audience.
  • Build and maintain relationships with employers, training providers, apprenticeship programs, workforce agencies, and community-based organizations, including outreach to communities underrepresented in clean energy careers.
  • Draft program communications for employers, training providers, workforce partners, and job seekers, including email campaigns, blog posts, event announcements, and other outreach materials.
  • Research, write, and update practical resources, such as fact sheets, guides, career exploration content, and tools that help counselors, navigators, and workforce professionals support job seekers.
  • Help design and deliver presentations and webinar content for partners, workforce professionals, and job seekers.
  • Coordinate group technical assistance sessions, office hours, webinars, workshops, and partner meetings. Confirm audiences and topics with project leads, manage invitations and registration, prepare agendas and materials, coordinate speakers and logistics, and provide meeting support.
  • Support session facilitation by welcoming participants, monitoring questions, documenting themes and action items, collecting feedback, and coordinating referrals and follow-up.
  • Research, vet, and update training-provider, employer, and apprenticeship listings and state and regional resource pages on Green Workforce Connect.
  • Maintain accurate records of inquiries, technical assistance requests, referrals, partner engagement, participation, and outcomes, and prepare summaries and inputs for grant reports.
  • Track time accurately by project and support timely program reporting in compliance with federal and private grant requirements.
  • Maintain workplans, schedules, tasks, milestones, and follow-up actions in Asana, and flag delays or delivery risks to project leads. Use Google Workspace for shared documents, calendars, and records, and ActiveCampaign for approved outreach, event invitations, reminders, and follow-up.
  • Represent IREC at conferences and partner events as assigned, identify ways to improve shared processes, templates, and tools, and support other Workforce activities as needed.

Knowledge, Skills, Experience, and Qualities for This Role

Required:

  • Experience coordinating workforce development, education, employment, career services, community engagement, clean energy/energy efficiency, or other mission-driven programs.
  • Experience working directly with people, such as job seekers, students, program participants, or community members, to help them identify goals and connect with resources, whether in a paid, volunteer, or community role.
  • Experience handling inquiries or requests in a program intake, customer service, help desk, or similar role, including judging when to answer directly and when to route a question to someone else.
  • Experience with outreach, recruitment, or engagement for programs, services, or events.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, including the ability to manage tasks, deadlines, and follow-up across multiple priorities.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, accurate, and compelling written materials for diverse public and professional audiences. Ability to speak with groups and work effectively with job seekers, employers, training providers, colleagues, and community partners.
  • Comfort using digital tools to collaborate, organize information, and communicate with participants and partners. IREC uses Google Workspace, Asana, and ActiveCampaign; familiarity with these tools is helpful, and training can be provided.
  • Research, data collection, and recordkeeping skills, with care for accuracy and detail.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a geographically distributed team, adapt as priorities change, and deliver high-quality work on deadlines.
  • Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and equitable access to clean energy careers.

Preferred:

  • Two or more years of experience in workforce development, career navigation or counseling, technical assistance, project coordination, or a related area.
  • A degree in workforce development, education, public policy, communications, environmental studies, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered in place of a degree.
  • Knowledge of clean energy careers, Registered Apprenticeship, training systems, or barriers that affect access to employment and education.
  • Experience developing resources or communications, such as fact sheets, guides, toolkits, newsletters, email campaigns, or web content.
  • Experience coordinating group learning or technical assistance, managing partner relationships, or supporting grant-funded work.

Work Environment

IREC team members collaborate primarily in a virtual environment, leveraging remote meetings, project management, and other collaboration tools to stay connected and on task. This position is remote within the United States. Occasional travel for conferences, partner meetings, or program activities may be required.

Application Process

To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter and answer the following questions (questions will be listed directly on the application). Your answers serve as your writing sample, and we are looking for clear, plain-language writing. All application materials must be submitted in English.

  1. Applicants must be based in and authorized to work in the United States. Please confirm you are based in the United States and do not require sponsorship. (yes/no)
  2. A job seeker emails IREC: they are interested in clean energy work but have no experience in the field and are not sure where to start. Write a short reply suggesting a few next steps in plain, encouraging language. You do not need to name specific programs. (200 words or less)
  3. Write a short email inviting training providers to a free, one-hour webinar about listing their programs on a national clean energy career platform. Include a subject line. (200 words or less)
  4. Describe a time you coordinated an event, program, or project involving several people or partners. What did you do to keep it on track, and what would you do differently? Experience from paid, volunteer, school, or community work all counts. (200 words or less)

IREC understands that certain demographic groups may be less inclined to apply for jobs unless they meet all job requirements. Therefore, we actively encourage applications from individuals who may not fulfill every criterion but believe they are well-suited for the role.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The application window is expected to close on November 30, 2026.

We strongly encourage and seek applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. You will be accountable for what GoCharting's web terminal, mobile apps and website ship, when they ship and how reliably they work. The role is full-time and remote from Europe, reports to the Chief Executive Officer, and leads a team across India and Europe, with working hours that overlap the Chennai team. This is an immediate need. It is a leadership role: you direct the team and review its work rather than carry a feature queue. Client engineering needs one accountable owner for delivery, standards and staffing, and you are that owner. At 3 to 6 months, releases should ship on the dates committed and pass a release gate that you own, and you should have the senior engineers and the QA lead in place.

What you'll do

  • Own delivery — commit dates for the terminal, mobile apps and website with the Head of Product, and answer for hitting them
  • Set and enforce engineering standards — branching, code review, CI/CD and the release gate, applied the same way to every engineer; the QA lead reports to you
  • Build the team — hire, develop and structure engineering managers, a staff engineer, terminal and mobile engineers and the QA lead
  • Raise technical quality — make the architecture decisions for the web terminal and mobile apps, and review the hardest designs yourself
  • Manage managers — set goals, review performance and coach the engineering managers who report to you
  • Report on delivery and quality — publish a regular view of delivery dates, defects and release health to the executive team

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 12+ years in software engineering on production web or mobile products
  • Has led an engineering organization of 10 or more engineers
  • Has managed engineering managers, not only individual contributors
  • Has owned release and quality standards for a production product: branching, code review, CI/CD and a release gate
  • Has led engineering for a trading, brokerage, fintech or market-data product (any one counts)
  • Based in Europe, in a UK or EU time zone, with at least 4 hours of working-day overlap with 09:00–18:00 IST

Nice-to-haves:

  • Real-time or data-dense web applications, such as charting or WebSocket-driven UIs (adds the ability to judge terminal architecture)
  • Mobile app delivery to the App Store and Google Play (adds oversight of mobile releases)
  • Leading teams split across India and Europe or the US (adds ease with our time zones)
  • Setting up QA automation and release gating from scratch (adds speed on the release gate)
  • A charting SDK or developer-facing library (adds depth on the charting platform)

sofatutor ist eine digitale Lernplattform, die über eine Million Schüler*innen, deren Eltern und Lehrkräfte beim Lernen und Lehren unterstützt – mit anschaulichen Videos, interaktiven Übungen, Lernspielen und hilfreichen Arbeitsmaterialien.   • Erstkontaktaufnahme mit Schulen: Proaktive Kontaktaufnahme mit potenziellen Neukunden (Schulen) primär via Telefon und E-Mail, um diese für einen Info-Termin mit einem Sales Manager zu gewinnen

Requirements

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du hast ein präsentes Auftreten am Telefon und findest immer den richtigen Gesprächseinstieg. Mit vielen unterschiedlichen Menschen zu sprechen macht dir Freude.

  • 🕒 Flexibles Arbeiten: Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und unserem remote-first Arbeitsmodell (inkl. Möglichkeit zur Arbeit aus dem EU-Ausland für 180 Tage im Jahr) gestaltest du deinen Alltag so, wie er zu dir passt.

The Sr. Ops Analyst, Revenue Operations is a hands-on member of the Revenue Operations team responsible for supporting the day-to-day execution of the sales organization. The analyst will work closely with Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and other cross-functional partners to maintain sales processes, analyze performance, improve data quality, and support key revenue operations activities. The successful candidate will be comfortable working in Salesforce and Excel, have a strong understanding of sales processes, and be able to turn data into clear recommendations and actions.

This is an execution-oriented role for someone who enjoys solving business problems, working with sales teams, and improving how a sales organization operates.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support the weekly and monthly sales operating rhythm, including forecast preparation, pipeline reviews, performance reporting, and sales leadership meetings.
  • Maintain accurate sales pipeline and opportunity data in Salesforce, identifying data issues and working with sellers and sales leaders to resolve them.
  • Prepare recurring reports and analysis covering pipeline coverage, bookings, forecast performance, quota attainment, conversion rates, sales activity, and other key sales metrics.
  • Assist Sales leadership with forecasting by analyzing pipeline movement, opportunity progression, historical performance, and current sales activity.
  • Support territory and account assignment processes, including changes to account ownership, organizational realignments, and in-year territory updates.

  • Support the administration and continuous improvement of Salesforce processes, including opportunity stages, required fields, data standards, and reporting requirements.

  • Support sales leadership with ad hoc analysis and reporting to answer business questions and inform decisions.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects involving Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and other teams to improve the overall revenue process.

  • Provide responsive operational support to sales leaders and teams while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Qualifications

  • Strong Excel skills, including the ability to work with large datasets, perform analysis, and create recurring reporting.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or another business intelligence platform is preferred.
  • Understanding of core sales processes, including pipeline management, forecasting, opportunity management, territory planning, and quota attainment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, investigate discrepancies, and communicate practical recommendations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy when working with sales data and reporting.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage recurring deliverables while responding to ad hoc requests.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work comfortably with both sales teams and cross-functional business partners.
Ideal Attributes
  • Hands-on and execution-oriented, with a strong understanding of how Operations supports sellers and sales leaders.
  • Curious and analytical, with a natural tendency to investigate issues rather than simply report them.
  • Highly organized and dependable, with strong follow-through on recurring processes and deadlines.
  • Comfortable working with incomplete information and asking the right questions to determine the appropriate course of action.
  • Collaborative and service-oriented, with the ability to build productive relationships across Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Operations.
  • Detail-oriented while maintaining an understanding of the broader sales and revenue objectives.
  • Continuous-improvement mindset, with an interest in finding practical ways to make sales processes more efficient and effective.

jobs.excerpt: Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home.
jobs.description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

jobs.description:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

Energy Exemplar is seeking a Director of Power Markets and Planning to lead our Data and Insights product line and Managed Services team. This role combines power market expertise, energy modeling, resource planning, product strategy, and customer engagement to support product development, customer success, and commercial growth.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in North American wholesale electricity and natural gas markets, with an understanding of energy trading, market forecasting, capacity expansion, and resource planning. Working closely with the PLEXOS and Pulse AI product teams, this role will support the development of market datasets, improve modeling and forecasting capabilities, and deliver solutions that address customer needs.

This position will collaborate across Product, Data, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success to connect technical capabilities with market needs and business objectives.

  • Lead the Data and Insights product line and Managed Services team, aligning priorities with customer needs and business objectives.
  • Oversee the development, maintenance, and improvement of energy market datasets, models, and forecasting capabilities.
  • Partner with PLEXOS and Pulse AI product teams to enhance market simulation, resource planning, and analytical solutions.
  • Apply knowledge of North American wholesale electricity and natural gas markets, including ISO/RTO structures, LMP pricing, congestion, generation dispatch, and market fundamentals.
  • Support modeling and planning applications, including production cost simulation, capacity expansion, resource adequacy, portfolio optimization, and energy price forecasting.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to evaluate modeling assumptions, data inputs, forecasting methodologies, and analytical outputs.
  • Engage directly with utilities, energy traders, developers, and market participants to understand planning requirements, answer technical product questions, and recommend solutions.
  • Translate customer feedback, planning requirements, and market developments into product improvements and roadmap priorities.
  • Lead and develop the Managed Services team, supporting consistent delivery, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
  • Partner with Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success to support customer acquisition, product adoption, account expansion, and commercial opportunities.
  • Monitor product and service performance, including adoption, customer retention, delivery quality, and revenue contribution.
  • Collaborate across technical and commercial teams to support product innovation and continuous improvement.

Candidate Requirements & Qualifications

RegEd also recognizes the exceptional skills, discipline and dedication of those who serve - and those who stand beside them. Whether you’re a veteran, active-duty service member transitioning to civilian life, or a military spouse, your unique experience brings incredible value to our team. Military members, veterans, and military spouses are strongly encouraged to apply.

Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with all the qualifications, we encourage you to apply anyway. Experience comes in many forms, and you may be the perfect candidate for this or other roles.

Five Reasons to Work with Us:

  1. Work with a leader in financial services industry
  1. Supportive & flexibleremoteorhybridenvironment
  1. Diverse & friendly culture
  1. Fast paced growing company
  1. A company that cares with community service efforts

What You Will Be Doing:

The AI Architect drives the adoption of agentic AI across RegEd and rebuilds our technical architecture to support it. Much of your time will be spent embedded with engineering and business teams, building working solutions withthemand teaching them to build their own.

You will build LLM applications, retrieval-augmented (RAG) document search, copilots, and agents on AWS and Azure. You will also design the target architectures those solutions run on and lead the migration to it. We will judge the role by how many teams are using AI in production and how much of the legacy platform has been rebuilt.

We want an experienced engineer and architect who enjoys teaching. You should be comfortable giving a live demo to a room of developers and equally comfortable leading a platform redesign. Senior engineers should trust your technical judgment. Business users should leave a session with you knowing what the system can do and where it falls short.

Responsibilities:

AI thought leadership and drive adoption

  • Run demos, workshops, hackathons, and office hours on agentic AI for engineering and business teams.
  • Work inside individual teams to find good use cases and build the first version with them.
  • Maintain reference implementations, sample code, and starter templates that teams can copy.
  • Write internal documentation andtutorials, andsend regular updates on what is working.
  • Recruit and support AI champions in each team.
  • Track adoption and report it to leadership.

Rebuild technical architectures

  • Review RegEd's current platforms and data flows and identify what is holding back AI adoption.
  • Design the target architecture, including agent orchestration, retrieval, tool and API layers, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration.
  • Write architecture blueprints and phased migration plans, then lead the rebuild with the engineering teams.
  • Rework legacy workflows and integrations so agents can use them safely, across Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft 365, Dynamics, and AWS Bedrock.
  • Keep the architecture secure and cost-effective across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.

Build and deploy production AI

  • Take prototypes of LLM applications, agents, RAG pipelines, and document processing into production.
  • Design multi-step agent workflows usingtoolcalling, prompt engineering, and context management.
  • Build evaluation datasets and automated tests to check agent accuracy and safety before release, and monitor systems once they arelive.

Set standards for compliance and security

  • Define the patterns and guardrails teamsfollowwhen building with AI.
  • Build human review, audit trails, and explainability into any solution that touches a regulated workflow.
  • Set identity, entitlement, anddata-accesscontrols for AI agents in line with SOX and RegEd security standards.

Advise leadership

  • Bring feedback from developers and business users to Technology leadership to inform the AI roadmap and budget.
  • Evaluate new models, agent frameworks, and developer tools, and recommend which to adopt.
  • Speak at industry events and meetups about applied AI in regulated industries.

Skills:

AI and agent engineering

  • Hands-on experience building LLM applications, agent workflows, and multi-agent systems with frameworks such asLangGraph, Semantic Kernel, orAutoGen.
  • Working knowledge of prompt engineering, context management, embeddings, vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search), and RAG.
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI coding assistants, and agent-based developer tools.
  • Experience building evaluation datasets and tests for AI systems.

Software delivery

  • Strong Python or Rust and backend/API development; working knowledge of TypeScript or C# / Java.
  • Production experience with AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, API Gateway, S3) and Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Functions).
  • Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containers, monitoring, and rollback for AI systems.

Architecture and modernization

  • Experience writing architecture blueprints and phased migration plans for large production systems.
  • A track record of modernizing legacy platforms without disrupting the business.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, API design, event-driven architecture, and data architecture.

Teaching and communication

  • Experience teaching through live demos, workshops, talks, and written tutorials.
  • Able to explain how a model behaves, where it fails, and what the risks are to people without a technical background.
  • Conference talks, blog posts, or open-source work are a plus.

Security and compliance

  • Understanding ofsecure AI deployment, data privacy, and identity and access management (Entra ID, Okta, or similar).
  • Experience in financial services, insurance, or compliance technology is strongly preferred.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of production software engineering, including 3+ years in an architecture role and 2+yearsarchitecting and deploying LLM or agentic AI applications.
  • A record of shipping AI solutions to production that people use every day.
  • Experience as a developer advocate, developer evangelist, or forward deployed engineer is preferred.
  • Expertise with Python and modern AI/ML libraries (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face,LangChain/LangGraph).

The Process:

Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary of Position


Cardiometabolic Solutions are a foundational pillar of Teladoc Health’s future growth and differentiation. The Head of Cardiometabolic Solutions is the senior general-management leader accountable for defining, building, and driving the market success of Teladoc Health’s cardiometabolic portfolio, spanning diabetes, hypertension, obesity and weight management, GLP-1-enabled care, and emerging metabolic-health solutions.


This leader will bring deep clinical and market expertise together with strong product, pharmacy, and commercial acumen to anticipate where cardiometabolic care is going and translate those insights into differentiated solutions. The role will maintain a sophisticated understanding of evolving standards of care, the GLP-1 and anti-obesity medication landscape, pharmacy and PBM dynamics, healthcare economics, competitive innovation, and the changing needs of employers, health plans, and members.


Operating with a GM mindset and end-to-end accountability, this leader will partner closely with Product, Clinical, Pharmacy, Commercial, Operations, Technology, and other solution leaders to shape the portfolio and capability roadmap, guide investment and build/partner decisions, and ensure Teladoc delivers solutions that are clinically credible, differentiated, scalable, operationally executable, and economically sustainable.


Ultimately, this is a market-facing growth leadership role accountable for turning clinical and market insight into solutions that customers want to buy, members want to use, and Teladoc can successfully scale. The Head of Cardiometabolic Solutions will help define go-to-market strategy, strengthen competitive positioning, support strategic customer and partner engagements, and ensure the portfolio delivers measurable clinical outcomes, compelling customer value, and sustainable B2B growth

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, performance, and evolution of Teladoc Health’s Cardiometabolic Solutions portfolio, with end-to-end accountability for clinical value, market competitiveness, commercial success, scalability, and sustainable economics.
  • Define the cardiometabolic portfolio and capability roadmap, translating clinical evidence, market trends, customer needs, competitive intelligence, and emerging innovation into clear priorities for Product, Clinical, Technology, and Operations.
  • Maintain expert-level knowledge of cardiometabolic care and the rapidly evolving GLP-1 and anti-obesity medication landscape, including standards of care, prescribing and medication-management models, member engagement, persistence and discontinuation, and emerging therapeutics.
  • Shape Teladoc Health’s pharmacy and medication-access strategy for cardiometabolic care, including PBM relationships, benefit design, formulary and utilization-management approaches, pharmaceutical manufacturer relationships, direct-to-employer models, cash-pay options, and other emerging access and funding models.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and translate the strategies, capabilities, and innovations of leading cardiometabolic, digital-health, pharmacy, and healthcare companies into actionable implications for Teladoc Health’s strategy and product roadmap.
  • Partner closely with Product and Clinical leadership to build differentiated, evidence-based solutions, establishing clear market requirements and informing product priorities, care models, member experiences, and build-buy-partner decisions.
  • Lead solutions from concept through commercialization, scale, and continuous optimization, balancing clinical quality, innovation, speed to market, member experience, operational readiness, risk, and economics.
  • Drive go-to-market strategy and commercial readiness in partnership with Commercial and Marketing, including customer segmentation, positioning, packaging, pricing, distribution, sales enablement, and compelling clinical and economic value propositions for employers and health plans.
  • Ensure solutions demonstrate measurable clinical and economic value, including the ability to support outcomes-based arrangements, performance guarantees, ROI commitments, and other innovative contracting models.
  • Partner with the other Multidisciplinary Care Solutions leaders to create a more integrated care experience, connecting cardiometabolic solutions with Mental Health, Primary Care, Specialty Care, and other Teladoc capabilities where clinically and commercially valuable.
  • Establish and manage the critical business, clinical, commercial, and operational KPIs for the portfolio, identifying risks and opportunities early and holding teams accountable for performance and results.
  • Serve as a visible internal and external leader for Cardiometabolic Solutions, aligning senior stakeholders across Teladoc Health and representing the business with strategic customers, consultants, partners, industry stakeholders, and senior executives
  • undefined

Supervisory Responsibilities

Yes

Qualifications Expected for Position

  • Significant leadership experience in cardiometabolic health, chronic condition management, obesity and weight management, digital health, population health, or related healthcare businesses, with a track record of driving meaningful growth and innovation.
  • Deep clinical understanding of cardiometabolic health, including obesity, diabetes, hypertension, and related metabolic conditions, with demonstrated ability to translate clinical evidence and evolving standards of care into scalable healthcare solutions.
  • Exceptional fluency in GLP-1s and other anti-obesity medications, including the evolving treatment landscape, clinical models, patient journeys, medication management, access considerations, and implications for employers and health plans.
  • Strong understanding of the pharmacy ecosystem and economics, including PBMs, pharmacy benefit design, pharmaceutical manufacturers, formulary and utilization management, GLP-1 access and affordability, and emerging alternative funding and distribution models.
  • Demonstrated success shaping product and portfolio strategy, translating market, customer, competitive, and clinical insights into differentiated products and capabilities and successfully taking solutions from concept through launch and scale.
  • Strong B2B commercialization and go-to-market experience, with a sophisticated understanding of employer and health-plan buyers, consultants and brokers, distribution channels, pricing, positioning, sales enablement, and customer value propositions.
  • Strong competitive and external-market orientation, with the ability to anticipate market shifts, distinguish durable trends from short-term developments, and translate insights into decisive strategic action.
  • Proven GM-level leadership capability, including experience owning complex cross-functional outcomes, making investment and portfolio trade-offs, managing business economics, and operating with clear accountability for results. Direct P&L responsibility is highly valued but should not outweigh exceptional cardiometabolic domain expertise.
  • Executive presence and exceptional influence skills, with the credibility to lead across Product, Clinical, Commercial, Pharmacy, Technology, Operations, and Finance and to engage effectively with senior executives, clinicians, customers, and external partners.
  • Data-driven, outcomes-oriented leadership style, with demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity, make disciplined decisions with incomplete information, build high-performing teams, and translate strategy into measurable clinical, commercial, and financial results.

jobs.title: Expert en gestion des flux Agile et coach Kanban (CDI ou freelance)
jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilitésL'organisation développe et maintient plusieurs applications métier critiques.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

L'organisation développe et maintient plusieurs applications métier critiques. La majorité des équipes de développement travaillent actuellement selon Scrum et prennent en charge le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités, la maintenance applicative, la gestion des incidents ainsi que les évolutions liées aux changements législatifs.

Dans ce contexte, le département ICT souhaite mieux maîtriser ses flux de travail, renforcer la prévisibilité des livraisons, réduire les dépendances et les temps d'attente, et soutenir une amélioration continue fondée sur des données objectives.

Objet de la mission

En tant qu'Expert.e Kanban et Flow Coach, vous accompagnez plusieurs équipes Scrum, leurs Scrum Masters et leurs Product Owners afin d'améliorer la gestion des flux de travail et la capacité de livraison.

Votre approche est pragmatique et tient compte des réalités opérationnelles des équipes. Vous intervenez comme coach, facilitateur et expert Kanban, sans responsabilité hiérarchique.

Résultats attendus

1. Amélioration de la visibilité des flux

  • Cartographier les flux de travail existants et les différents types de demandes.
  • Rendre visibles les files d'attente, les blocages, les dépendances et les interruptions.
  • Définir ou faire évoluer les pratiques de visualisation du travail.
  • Accompagner l'introduction progressive des principes Kanban dans un environnement Scrum existant.

2. Amélioration de la prévisibilité

  • Mettre en place et exploiter des indicateurs de flux pertinents, tels que le Lead Time, le Throughput, le Work In Progress et le Blocked Work.
  • Aider les équipes à interpréter les données et à déterminer les axes d'amélioration.
  • Utiliser les données historiques pour soutenir les prévisions de livraison.
  • Mesurer et communiquer l'impact des actions d'amélioration.

3. Accompagnement des équipes et des Scrum Masters

  • Coacher les Scrum Masters dans l'intégration des pratiques Kanban et Lean.
  • Accompagner les équipes dans l'amélioration continue de leur système de travail.
  • Favoriser l'autonomie, l'auto-organisation et la prise de décision fondée sur les faits.
  • Aider les équipes à gérer efficacement les différents types de travaux, notamment les projets, la maintenance, les incidents et les demandes urgentes.

4. Amélioration de la collaboration entre équipes

  • Identifier et visualiser les dépendances entre équipes.
  • Faciliter la coordination autour des priorités, des risques et des livraisons.
  • Mettre en place des pratiques de management visuel qui favorisent la prise de décision collective.

5. Facilitation et transfert de connaissances

  • Concevoir et animer des ateliers d'amélioration, de rétrospective, de cartographie des flux et de résolution de problèmes.
  • Former et coacher les Scrum Masters, les Product Owners et les membres des équipes.
  • Contribuer au développement des compétences en interne afin de rendre progressivement l'organisation autonome.

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans les domaines suivants :

  • Accompagnement d'équipes Agile en tant que Scrum Master, Flow Coach ou dans une fonction équivalente, avec au moins 10 ans d'expérience.
  • Mise en œuvre pratique de Kanban dans des environnements de développement logiciel, avec au moins 5 ans d'expérience.
  • Amélioration de processus fondée sur l'analyse de données et d'indicateurs de flux, avec au moins 5 ans d'expérience.
  • Facilitation d'ateliers et coaching d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, avec au moins 10 ans d'expérience.
  • Collaboration avec des Product Owners, des managers et des parties prenantes métier, avec au moins 10 ans d'expérience.

Compétences requises

  • Excellente maîtrise des pratiques Agile, de Scrum, de Kanban, du Lean et de SAFe.
  • Maîtrise des métriques de flux, notamment le Lead Time, le Cycle Time, le Throughput, le WIP, l'Aging Work et les Blockers.
  • Capacité à analyser un système de travail et à proposer des améliorations concrètes.
  • Solides compétences en facilitation, coaching, mentoring et communication.
  • Expérience des outils collaboratifs tels que Jira et Confluence.
  • Expérience en formation, en facilitation visuelle et en facilitation d'Obeya.
  • Connaissance pratique de l'AI.

Atouts supplémentaires

Un bachelier à orientation informatique ou un diplôme équivalent, ainsi qu'une certification Kanban Management Professional (KMP) ou équivalente, une certification Scrum (PSM II ou équivalente), une certification Agile Team Coach ou une certification SAFe constituent des atouts. Une expérience d'Obeya, de Story Mapping, d'Impact Mapping, des Liberating Structures et des simulations de flux est également appréciée. Une expérience comme formateur ou conférencier constitue un avantage supplémentaire.

Langues

  • Néerlandais
  • Anglais
  • Français

Question à traiter dans la candidature

En complément du CV, répondez à la question suivante. L'absence ou l'insuffisance de réponse est éliminatoire :

Quelle valeur ou quel concept Agile est essentiel dans une organisation ? Pourquoi et comment le mettre concrètement en œuvre ? Donnez un exemple fondé sur votre propre expérience.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

jobs.excerpt: About Cardiff Cardiff lends to small businesses.  Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between.
jobs.description:
About Cardiff

Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help.

Location: San Diego, CA or Remote (U.S.)

Employment Type: Full-time

Department: Product and Design

Reports to: CMO

Why This Role Matters

Our customers are small business owners who need capital quickly and clearly. Every screen, form, and message they see shapes whether they trust us enough to apply, finish, and come back. As Head of Design, you'll set the standard for how Cardiff looks, feels, and works across our product, our brand, and every customer touchpoint, and you'll build the team and design system that keep that standard high as we grow.

What You'll Own

  • Set the design vision and strategy for Cardiff's customer-facing products, internal tools, and brand, in partnership with Engineering, Marketing, and leadership
  • Lead end-to-end product design for the borrower journey, from first visit and application through underwriting, funding, and repeat borrowing
  • Design internal tools for our underwriting, funding, sales, and servicing teams so they can move faster with fewer errors
  • Build and maintain a scalable design system in Figma, with documented components, patterns, and accessibility standards that engineering can ship from directly
  • Own brand and visual identity across web, paid media, email, direct mail, and sales materials, partnering closely with Marketing on campaign creative
  • Ground design decisions in evidence through customer research, usability testing, funnel analytics, and split testing, with clear metrics tied to conversion and customer experience
  • Ensure designs meet accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and the disclosure and compliance requirements of a regulated lending business
  • Hire, lead, and develop the design team, running a predictable cadence of critique, delivery, and accountability
  • Use AI tools throughout the design process, from research synthesis to prototyping, and help the team do the same

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 years leading designers and owning design outcomes for a digital product at a growth-stage company. Experience in fintech, lending, or financial services is a strong plus.
  • Product Design Craft: A portfolio that shows strong interaction design, visual design, and information architecture on complex, multi-step flows such as applications, onboarding, or dashboards.
  • Design Systems: Hands-on experience building and scaling a design system, and working closely with engineers to implement it in code.
  • Tools: Expert-level Figma skills, fluency with prototyping and AI-assisted design tools, and a working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and how front-end code gets built.
  • Research and Data: Comfort running user research and usability tests, and reading product analytics to find friction and measure the impact of design changes.
  • Leadership Style: Hands-on, execution-focused leader with strong cross-functional communication skills; able to give clear feedback, make decisions with incomplete information, and explain design choices to non-designers. Must have experience managing at least 4 direct reports.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry Perspective: Experience designing for small business owners, B2B customers, or regulated, high-trust products such as lending, payments, or banking.
  • Conversion Design: A track record of improving funnel conversion, application completion, or activation through measured design changes.
  • Brand Leadership: Experience leading a brand refresh or building a visual identity system that works across product and marketing channels.
  • Content Design: Skill at writing and shaping clear product copy, especially for financial terms, disclosures, and error states.
  • Organizational Scale: Experience building a design function at an early or growth-stage company, including hiring, career leveling, and managing freelance and agency partners.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If You

  • Want a strategy or advisory seat rather than hands-on ownership of the work that ships
  • Have been out of the tools long enough that you'd need someone else to build the file or the prototype
  • Prefer structured corporate environments with clear lanes and layers between you and the business
  • Solve problems offline and come back with polished results, instead of sharing work early and communicating while you work
  • Use AI tools to assist your old workflow, rather than having rebuilt your workflow around them

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary range: $195,000+
  • Performance bonus of up to 20% of base, tied to delivery and business outcomes
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) plan
  • Flexible PTO and observed holidays
  • Remote-first, with support for your home-office setup
  • Direct access to leadership and to the problems that matter

Cardiff, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
