jobs.description:
Lead AI Engineer — Bridge-it AI Team

Location: Remote

Experience: 4–8 years in industry

Team: AI Platform (Copilot)

About Bridge-it

Bridge-it is an early-stage EdTech company building a career-readiness platform for K-12 students, counselors, and districts. Students explore careers, colleges, and non-college pathways; build multi-year plans; and get guidance from an AI Copilot that is grounded in their own plans, school data, and a curated knowledge base. Counselors use the same platform to supervise, nudge, and intervene at scale.

The AI Copilot is the heart of the product — a production LangGraph-based agentic system serving real students, where being right matters more than being fluent. We hold ourselves to strict grounding, safety, and tenant-isolation standards, and we measure everything.

About the role

You will join a small AI team that owns the Copilot end to end: the agentic orchestration graph, retrieval and grounding, safety guardrails, response contracts with the frontend, and the evaluation platform that keeps it honest. We are mid-flight on an ambitious redesign — collapsing multiple experimental graph variants into a single workflow-first architecture with typed claim verification, constitutional rules, and per-turn decision records — and you would step directly into that work.

This is a senior role with a visible leadership runway. Beyond writing excellent code, we expect you to analyze ambiguous product requirements, turn them into well-scoped technical specs and tickets, distribute work across the team, and communicate trade-offs clearly to product and leadership. For the right person, this role grows into a techno-management position.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and operate agentic LLM workflows in LangGraph — routing, planning, parallel retrieval, tool execution, verification, and streaming — serving live student and counselor traffic over WebSockets.
  • Own RAG quality: multi-source retrieval across vector stores (Milvus, pgvector), a knowledge graph (Neo4j), and structured platform data; chunking strategy; reranking; and grounded generation with typed claims and evidence citation.
  • Enforce safety and trust: input/output guardrails, constitutional rules, faithfulness verification, abstain/escalate behavior, and strict multi-tenant data isolation.
  • Build and extend our evaluation platform: online LLM-as-judge evaluators, offline regression suites on curated datasets (LangSmith), latency baselines, and A/B experimentation (PostHog feature flags).
  • Drive latency and cost optimization: model selection across providers (OpenAI, Gemini, open-weight models via OpenRouter), prompt and context engineering, selective retrieval, caching, and streaming intermediate responses.
  • Instrument and debug production behavior with LangSmith tracing, OpenTelemetry, New Relic, and Sentry; treat live-QA findings as first-class inputs to design.
  • Partner with backend (Django/Postgres), frontend (Next.js), and product teams on response envelopes, interaction contracts, and rollout plans.
  • Lead by doing: break epics into staged implementation plans with acceptance criteria, sequence work across engineers, review code, and mentor teammates.

What we're looking for (required)

  • 4–8 years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2–5 years building LLM-powered products in production (not just prototypes or notebooks) and 2 years of leading a team.
  • Strong Python engineering fundamentals — typing, testing, async, service design.
  • Strong grasp of agentic architecture patterns — supervisor/executor splits, planner–retriever–verifier pipelines, tool/capability registries, routing and fallback tiers — and sound judgment about when a workflow should be deterministic versus agentic.
  • Hands-on experience with agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph strongly preferred; LangChain, or comparable state-machine/agent frameworks acceptable) including multi-step graphs, tool calling, and streaming.
  • Context engineering / harness engineering: deliberate construction of what the model sees each turn — context budgets, retrieval selection, system-prompt and tool-schema design, structured state passed between nodes — and the harness discipline (contracts, guards, fallbacks) that makes model behavior predictable.
  • Experience designing and optimizing agent memory: short-term conversation state (windowing, summarization/compaction, token-budget management) and long-term memory (user profiles, episodic stores, rollups) with sensible retrieval and staleness policies.
  • Deep practical knowledge of RAG systems: embedding models, vector databases (Milvus/Zilliz, pgvector, or similar), hybrid retrieval, rerankers (e.g., Cohere), chunking and knowledge-base design.
  • Proven experience building and operating LLM evaluation systems: online evaluators (LLM-as-judge) on live traffic, offline golden datasets and regression suites, faithfulness/hallucination and groundedness metrics, A/B experiment design — and the discipline to gate releases on eval results.
  • Hands-on AI observability: end-to-end trace instrumentation of agent runs (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, or similar), per-node latency/token/cost tracking, trajectory analysis, drift and quality-regression monitoring, and turning production traces into eval datasets and fixes.
  • Experience shipping structured outputs (JSON contracts, schema-validated responses) as the interface between models and product surfaces.
  • Comfort with cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred: Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, GCS, BigQuery).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills: you can explain a retrieval-quality trade-off to a product manager, write a spec another engineer can execute, and disagree constructively.
  • Demonstrated ability in requirement analysis and task decomposition — turning fuzzy asks into staged, dependency-ordered work — and willingness to step up into team-lead responsibilities.

Desirable

  • Experience at an early-stage startup — comfort with ambiguity, wearing multiple hats, and shipping under constraints.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): working knowledge of the spec and hands-on experience building or integrating MCP servers/clients to expose tools and data to agents.
  • Knowledge graphs (Neo4j/Cypher) in retrieval or recommendation contexts.
  • Durable workflow engines (Temporal) and event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub).
  • Multi-tenant SaaS security models (row-level tenancy, FERPA/COPPA-adjacent compliance awareness).
  • EdTech or other regulated/high-trust consumer domains.

Nice to have

  • AI infrastructure: model serving, GPU inference, gateway/router layers, and cost/latency-aware routing across providers.
  • SLMs and self-hosted LLMs: deploying and operating small language models or open-weight LLMs (vLLM, TGI, Ollama, or similar), quantization, fine-tuning/distillation for task-specific workloads, and knowing when a small model beats an API call.
  • Traditional ML: classification, ranking, embedding fine-tuning; scikit-learn/PyTorch.
  • Recommender systems: candidate generation + ranking pipelines, personalization.
  • Forecasting and data analytics: time-series methods, cohort analysis, product analytics.
  • Big data processing/streaming: BigQuery at scale, Spark/Flink/Kafka or Pub/Sub streaming pipelines, dbt-style transformation workflows.

Our stack (so you know what you're signing up for)

Python · LangGraph/LangChain · OpenAI + Gemini + open-weight models (OpenRouter) · Milvus/Zilliz · pgvector · Neo4j · Cohere reranking · LangSmith · Django + PostgreSQL · Temporal · GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, GCS, BigQuery) · PostHog · OpenTelemetry/New Relic/Sentry · Next.js frontend over a WebSocket streaming protocol.

Bridge-it is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive, respectful remote-first workplace.

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects, and connects the technology of the world's well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across 19 markets in North America, EMEA and APAC, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. Vantage's business is growing exponentially, through a combination of greenfield market expansion and acquisitions.

Business Optimization & Vendor Management Department

The Business Optimization & Vendor Management team supports effective planning, financial visibility, operational discipline, and informed decision-making. The team partners with budget owners, business leaders, Finance, Procurement, and other stakeholders to maintain reliable planning information, monitor financial commitments, improve reporting, and strengthen processes that help the organization use its resources effectively.

Position Overview

The Business Analyst, Budget Planning & Financial Operations supports budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis activities that help business leaders effectively manage approved budgets and financial commitments throughout the year.

This role partners with budget owners and business leaders to maintain accurate forecasts, monitor spending, identify risks and opportunities, and keep assumptions aligned with current business needs. The analyst helps stakeholders avoid unexpected overspend while also identifying available funding and planned activities that may need action so approved resources are used effectively.

The ideal candidate is analytical, highly organized, and comfortable working directly with stakeholders. As the individual develops knowledge of the business and its planning processes, they will take an increasingly active role in recurring forecast discussions, budget reviews, and follow-up with assigned budget owners.

Essential Job Functions

Budget Planning & Forecast Management

  • Support annual budget planning and recurring forecast cycles, including non-labor operating expense and capital expenditure planning.
  • Maintain and update forecast workbooks, planning files, assumptions, and supporting documentation throughout the year.
  • Work with budget owners to understand spending plans, project timing, contract obligations, purchase commitments, and changing business priorities.
  • Help budget owners maintain realistic forecasts that reduce the risk of overspending and highlight opportunities to use approved funding before year-end.
  • Track forecast changes, open actions, and decisions to ensure planning information remains current and explainable.
  • Identify potential overages, unused funding, timing shifts, and other risks or opportunities, and raise them for timely discussion and action.
  • Support capital planning, project cost tracking, and workforce or position planning activities as assigned.

Budget Owner & Business Leader Partnership

  • Build productive working relationships with budget owners and business leaders.

  • Prepare for and participate in recurring budget and forecast review meetings.
  • Ask thoughtful questions, clarify assumptions, document decisions, and follow up on required updates.
  • Explain budget, forecast, actual, and committed-spend information in clear business terms.
  • Provide budget owners with timely information that supports prioritization and spending decisions.
  • With appropriate training and experience, independently lead routine forecast conversations and serve as a primary point of contact for assigned budget owners.
  • Coordinate with Finance and other stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and keep planning data aligned.

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze budget, forecast, actual, committed, and planned spend information.

  • Perform variance analysis and identify the operational drivers behind changes in financial performance.

  • Review spending trends and summarize relevant risks, opportunities, and recommended follow-up actions.
  • Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, meeting materials, and concise leadership summaries.
  • Support ad hoc analysis, project financial reviews, business cases, and return-on-investment analysis as needed.
  • Contribute to budget planning scenarios and longer-range analysis using documented assumptions.

Data Management, Controls & Process Improvement

  • Reconcile financial and operational information across systems, reports, and source files.
  • Validate data, investigate discrepancies, and document assumptions, methods, and exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of forecast updates, commitments, decisions, and supporting information.
  • Create and maintain reports, dashboards, process documentation, and user guidance.
  • Identify practical improvements that increase forecast accuracy, strengthen controls, and reduce manual effort.
  • Support small-scale reporting, process, or tool improvement initiatives.
  • Handle additional duties as assigned by management.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Analytics,or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Approximately 2 to 5 years of experience in business analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, operations, project controls, portfolio administration, or a related role.
  • Experience supporting budget planning, forecast maintenance, financial reporting, or variance analysis.
  • Working knowledge of operating expense and capital expenditure concepts.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and comfort working with detailed financial and operational data.
  • Ability to organize information, manage multiple priorities, and follow through on open actions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and communicate financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data quality, documentation, and confidentiality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams and adapt to changing priorities.

Preferred Experience

  • Budget owner or business-partner support.
  • Non-labor forecast management, project portfolio support, or contract and vendor spend analysis.
  • Capital planning, project cost tracking, or multi-year planning.
  • Executive-ready reporting, dashboards, KPI reporting, or data visualization.
  • Experience with Power BI, Workday, ERP or financial planning systems, procurement systems, or similar business tools.
  • Process improvement, requirements gathering, or small-scale project coordination.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Zephyr RTOS / Embedded Systems EngineerBefore You ApplyThis is a Full-Time Employment opportunity.
jobs.description:
Senior Zephyr RTOS / Embedded Systems Engineer

Before You Apply

This is a Full-Time Employment opportunity. We are not considering B2B, freelance, consulting, or independent-contractor arrangements for this position.

This is a hands-on Zephyr RTOS platform-engineering role.

We need an engineer who can work inside and around Zephyr itself — close to the MCU, BSP, drivers, interrupts, memory, timing, boot flow, and hardware.

If your experience is primarily developing applications on top of an RTOS without hands-on experience with Zephyr internals, BSP/board bring-up, DeviceTree/Kconfig, device drivers, MCU architecture, or low-level hardware/software debugging, this role will not be the right match.

About L4B Software

L4B Software develops secure, reliable operating-system platforms for embedded, regulated, and long-lifecycle products.

Our platforms include MediTUX OS (Embedded Linux), MedicDroid (Android/AOSP), and MediTUX-RT, our real-time operating-system platform for microcontroller-based systems.

Our engineering processes operate within an ISO 13485-certified quality management system, with software lifecycle and risk-management processes aligned with IEC 62304 and ISO 14971.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Zephyr RTOS / Embedded Systems Engineer to help build and evolve MediTUX-RT, L4B's real-time operating-system platform for embedded and medical-device applications.

This is a Senior Individual Contributor role requiring substantial technical ownership.

You will work directly with Zephyr, MCU platforms, BSPs, drivers, interrupts, memory, timing, boot processes, firmware, and hardware integration, while collaborating with embedded, Linux, cybersecurity, validation, and quality engineers.

What You'll Do

  • Develop, integrate, and maintain Zephyr RTOS-based embedded platforms.
  • Work directly with Zephyr internals, kernel configuration, Kconfig, DeviceTree, west, and the Zephyr build system.
  • Perform board bring-up and BSP development/integration for MCU-based hardware.
  • Develop, integrate, and debug device drivers and hardware interfaces.
  • Work with peripherals and buses including SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, GPIO, timers, ADC, PWM, and watchdogs.
  • Debug issues involving interrupts, concurrency, synchronization, scheduling, memory, timing, and hardware interaction.
  • Analyze and improve real-time behavior, determinism, latency, resource usage, and system reliability.
  • Work with bootloaders, firmware updates, flash layouts, and device startup flows.
  • Develop production-quality embedded C/C++.
  • Investigate complex problems using JTAG/SWD, GDB, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and hardware debugging tools.
  • Develop automated tests and platform-level validation.
  • Contribute to secure firmware design, including Secure Boot and secure update mechanisms where applicable.
  • Produce maintainable technical documentation and engineering evidence suitable for long-lifecycle and regulated products.
  • Collaborate with hardware, validation, cybersecurity, quality, and other platform-engineering teams.

What You Bring

Must Have

  • Strong professional experience in embedded systems and firmware development.
  • Significant hands-on experience with Zephyr RTOS.
  • Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, threads, interrupts, synchronization/IPC, timers, memory management, concurrency, and real-time constraints.
  • Strong embedded C development skills; C++ experience is valuable.
  • Hands-on experience with MCU-based systems, ideally ARM Cortex-M.
  • Experience with board bring-up, BSPs, and low-level hardware integration.
  • Experience developing or debugging device drivers.
  • Practical experience with Zephyr DeviceTree and Kconfig.
  • Strong hardware/software debugging skills.
  • Ability to investigate problems across the complete stack — from software behavior through RTOS and drivers down to the hardware.
  • Ability to independently own and resolve complex platform-level technical problems.

Technical Experience We Value

Experience in several of the following areas would be particularly valuable:

Zephyr Upstream Development | Custom Zephyr Boards/SoCs/Drivers | ARM Cortex-M | Nordic | NXP | STM32 | Renesas | Infineon | MCUboot | Secure Boot | Secure Firmware Updates | ARM TrustZone-M | Embedded Cryptography | BLE | CAN/CAN-FD | USB | Networking | Flash Storage | Power Management | HIL Testing | Python Automation | CI/CD

Experience with medical-device, safety-critical, security-sensitive, or other regulated embedded products is a strong advantage, including exposure to IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 61508, or comparable development environments.

What This Role Is Not

This is not primarily:

  • Embedded application development on top of an RTOS
  • Embedded Linux engineering
  • Android/AOSP engineering
  • Hardware design
  • Project management
  • People management

We need an engineer who can go deep into Zephyr, RTOS internals, MCU architecture, BSPs, drivers, and hardware/software interaction and independently solve difficult platform-level problems.

What Success Looks Like

You become a technical owner of significant parts of MediTUX-RT.

You can take a new MCU or board, understand what is required to support it, bring the platform up, integrate and debug the necessary components, and drive technical issues through to resolution.

When timing, memory, driver, interrupt, boot, or hardware-related problems occur, you can systematically diagnose them rather than treating the RTOS as a black box.

Most importantly, you help us build a reliable, secure, maintainable, testable, and production-grade Zephyr platform suitable for demanding and regulated embedded products.

Our Hiring Approach

We hire for demonstrated technical capability, relevant hands-on experience, problem-solving ability, and engineering ownership. A formal degree can be valuable, but equivalent practical experience is welcome where a degree is not essential to performing the work.

Sibiu, Romania | Remote | Full-Time Employment

No B2B, freelance, consulting, or independent-contractor arrangements.

If you have spent years working deep inside Zephyr and embedded systems — and enjoy solving difficult problems where software meets hardware — we would like to talk.

Bonus Points

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

EXTERNAL ENGAGEMENT SR. MANAGER, DEVICE SUPPLY

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead day-to-day supplier relationship management and execution for external manufacturing partners supporting device supply. The role will be accountable for ensuring reliable supply, technical and operational issue resolution, project execution, budget/proposal governance, and cross-functional alignment across Amgen, supplier sites, quality, supply chain, engineering, procurement, finance, and manufacturing network partners.

This role requires a strong technical and operational leader who can operate independently across complex supplier relationships, manage competing business priorities, and drive timely decision-making on supplier performance, capacity, component readiness, validation, packaging, technical changes, and commercial proposals.

Supplier relationship and operational leadership:

  • Own and manage critical supplier relationships for assigned external partners, acting as the primary External Supply point of contact for operational execution, escalation, and business continuity.
  • Ownership of projects to install capacity and capabilities at External Partner locations to meet Amgen projected demand
  • Lead structured engagement with suppliers to ensure delivery of supply, project, quality, technical, and commercial commitments.
  • Drive resolution of supplier-related issues affecting device availability.
  • Establish clear priorities with suppliers and internal stakeholders, ensuring urgent business needs are understood, resourced, and progressed to closure.

External manufacturing and technical execution:

  • Lead cross-functional execution for external manufacturing activities related to device manufacturing and supply.
  • Coordinate with engineering, quality, supply chain, CPO, manufacturing sites, and supplier technical teams to resolve manufacturing and product/process issues.
  • Support technical evaluations, impact assessments, change controls, specification updates, validation strategies, and supplier manufacturing investigations.
  • Ensure supplier decisions are grounded in appropriate technical rationale, GMP expectations, business priorities, and risk management principles.

Project, budget, and proposal management:

  • Manage supplier proposals, purchase requisitions, budget requests, and commercial follow-up for assigned programs and external partners.
  • Prepare and progress business cases for supplier spend, scrap proposals, spare parts, tooling, packaging solutions, and project-related expenditure.
  • Partner with finance, procurement, and leadership to secure approvals, track commitments, and ensure spend is aligned to program priorities.
  • Maintain visibility of open supplier proposals, financial risks, and urgent budget needs, escalating appropriately when business decisions are required.

Supply continuity and capacity planning:

  • Support capacity planning, supply risk assessment, and mitigation planning for external manufacturing operations.
  • Work with suppliers and internal teams to ensure component availability, production readiness, shipment planning, and inventory decisions support business and patient supply needs.
  • Identify risks to supply continuity and lead development of recovery or mitigation plans.
  • Support prioritization of activities across multiple suppliers, products, and business-critical programs.

Cross-functional leadership:

  • Lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, including supplier teams, quality, engineering, procurement, supply chain, finance, manufacturing sites, and program leadership.
  • Represent External Supply in internal working teams, supplier governance forums, project reviews, and escalation meetings.
  • Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders on status, risks, decisions needed, and recommended actions.
  • Coach and support team members or project contributors where needed, helping build capability in supplier engagement, technical problem solving, and business ownership.

Compliance and quality mindset:

  • Ensure supplier activities are conducted in line with Amgen quality expectations, GMP requirements, procurement processes, and applicable procedures.
  • Support investigations, deviations, impact assessments, specification updates, and change-related activity as needed.
  • Maintain strong documentation, decision rationale, and follow-through on actions.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma / GED and 12 years of supplier relationship experience OR
  • Associate’s degree and 10 years of supplier relationship experience OR
  • Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of supplier relationship experience OR
  • Master’s degree and 4 years of supplier relationship experience OR
  • Doctorate degree and 2 years of supplier relationship experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, combination product, packaging, or regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Background in supplier management, external manufacturing, technical operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, or manufacturing support.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical and operational issues across multiple functions and external partners.
  • Project Management experience.
  • Experience managing supplier proposals, purchase requisitions, budget requests, and business-case justification.
  • Strong understanding of GMP, change control, deviations/investigations, validation, technical documentation, and regulated supply operations.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives

About Human Agency

We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it, and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

The economic landscape is shifting in ways that demand a new kind of investment discipline. AI is not simply transforming industries — it is redrawing the boundaries of value itself. Political instability, labor displacement, structural economic shifts, and the concentration of technological power are creating conditions that most funds are ill-equipped to navigate. jobs.excerpt: Our Client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is looking for a creative and driven Toy Product Development Specialist to help the company develop new physical toys for its growing Amazon brand portfolio.
jobs.description:
Our Client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is looking for a creative and driven Toy Product Development Specialist to help the company develop new physical toys for its growing Amazon brand portfolio. In this role, you'll be responsible for turning product opportunities and market insights into thoughtful, appealing, and competitive toy concepts - from the initial idea through a production-ready concept.

This is not primarily a research role. Research is a tool you'll use to understand the market, customers, parents, and competitors and make better product decisions. Your main responsibility will be to transform those insights into toys that are fun, visually appealing, intuitive, and meaningfully better than what is already available on Amazon.

About the Company:

It is a fast-growing small company that manages Amazon accounts and runs its own brand, offering eco-friendly products. The team works fully remotely, allowing for flexibility and efficiency while maintaining strong collaboration.

The company operates in an international and rapidly evolving market, providing a dynamic work environment. It encourages creativity and initiative, giving team members the opportunity to bring new ideas to life and make a real impact.

Key Responsibilities:

  • You'll identify potential toy product opportunities using a structured and repeatable process. You'll evaluate different ideas against predefined criteria and use your judgment to decide which opportunities are genuinely worth developing further.
  • For selected products, you'll research the market to understand what customers actually want. This includes analyzing customer reviews, studying competing toys, researching relevant keywords, identifying common complaints and missing features, and understanding what both children and parents find appealing. The goal is not to create long research reports, but to extract practical insights that directly inform product decisions.
  • Using what you've learned, you'll develop actual toy concepts and explore different ways to make them more fun, appealing, useful, intuitive, and competitive. This may include the way the toy works, play features, shape and design, colors, themes, materials, size, construction, accessories, included components, variations, or meaningful improvements over existing products.
  • You'll use ChatGPT and other AI tools to explore ideas, develop different product directions, create mockups, and visualize concepts. You should be comfortable experimenting with multiple creative approaches before deciding which direction is strongest.
  • You'll find and communicate with suppliers to understand what can realistically be manufactured. This includes exploring existing products that can be customized, available materials and production options, customization possibilities, manufacturing limitations, and pricing. Supplier feedback should be used to refine your concepts and make sure the final direction is both creatively strong and realistically manufacturable.
  • You'll continuously iterate on your ideas rather than stopping at the first acceptable concept. You'll explore multiple directions, reject weaker ideas, improve promising ones, and keep refining until you reach a product concept you genuinely believe is strong. When useful, several strong final versions may be prepared and tested through customer surveys.
  • Once a product direction is approved, you'll prepare it for sampling. This includes finalizing the product concept, confirming specifications and manufacturing feasibility with the supplier, confirming pricing, and preparing the product for the sampling stage.
  • You'll be encouraged to challenge assumptions, ask questions, and take ownership of the product development process. The expectation is that you won't simply present several options for management to choose from - you'll use your own product judgment to determine which direction you believe the company should pursue.

Requirements:

  • Strong creative thinking and the ability to come up with original product ideas and meaningful improvements to existing toys.
  • Good product sense - an ability to understand what makes a toy fun, appealing, intuitive, and desirable.
  • Strong visual sense and good judgment around colors, shapes, proportions, themes, and overall product appearance.
  • Ability to understand both the child who will use the toy and the parent who will purchase it.
  • Ability to analyze customer reviews, competing products, and market information and turn those insights into practical product decisions.
  • Experience using ChatGPT, AI tools, or other creative tools to explore ideas and create product mockups or visual concepts.
  • Ability to communicate with suppliers and understand basic manufacturing, materials, customization, pricing, and production limitations.
  • Strong judgment and ownership - you should be comfortable rejecting weak ideas and deciding which concepts are genuinely worth pursuing.
  • Willingness to iterate, experiment, and refine ideas until you reach a strong final product.
  • Experience with Amazon, toy product development, private label, FBA, supplier communication, or physical product development would be a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote work with flexible hours (work from whatever place).
  • Competitive and timely salary.
  • Creative freedom and ownership over the entire product development process.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment.

About Advanced Energy United

Advanced Energy United is a national industry association representing businesses that provide the full range of advanced energy and transportation solutions. Our team works to educate, advocate, and activate in decisionmaker venues across the country.

We advocate for public policies that enable competition and work alongside our member companies to create economic opportunity, lower consumer costs, and bolster energy reliability and resilience across the country. We work with decision makers at every level of government as well as regulators of energy markets to build progress toward an economy built on advanced energy.

If you’re an entrepreneurial, innovative, analytical and thoughtful person looking to make an impact in the clean energy space, United might be the perfect place for you to share your talents. Team members at United are given the trust and responsibility to make big things happen, and myriad opportunities to learn new skills, explore new issue areas, and work with a broad cross section of the clean energy community. Being a team member at United also means working with a talented and diverse group of people, some who bring decades of experience spanning advocacy, philanthropy, clean tech, government and more—and our collaborative approach means we get to learn from each other, expert and novice, every day. And while our organization is fully remote, we are proud of the people-focused culture we have built and the connectedness of our team.

We work on serious issues, take our mission seriously, but never take ourselves too seriously.

Position Description

The Western United States is in the midst of the most significant wholesale electricity market transformation in a generation. CAISO's markets are transitioning to independent regional governance under the newly formed Regional Organization for Western Energy (ROWE), while SPP's Markets+ and RTO West represent parallel options for utilities across the region, and states and stakeholders are actively shaping how these markets — and the transmission system that underpins them — will work for decades to come. These decisions will determine how quickly and cost-effectively the West can integrate clean energy, unlock resource diversity across state lines, and deliver reliable, affordable power to consumers. Advanced Energy United is looking for a Senior Principal who can represent advanced energy companies at this pivotal moment, ensuring that market and transmission rules are designed to accelerate — not hinder — the clean energy transition.

The Senior Principal will support, and eventually lead, the organization’s advocacy related to western wholesale electricity market expansion and development. The role will have a primary focus on the development of the Regional Organization for Western Energy (ROWE) and its governance, markets, and services, and related initiatives at the California Independent System Operator (CAISO). Dependent on need and strategy, the Senior Principal may also engage in SPP Markets+ and RTO West, and in relevant non-market regional initiatives such as transmission planning, resource adequacy program design, and interregional coordination across the Western Interconnection. jobs.excerpt: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage.
jobs.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer, AI Agent Voice Experience to help build the next generation of AI-powered voice systems for the contact center. In this role, you will work at the intersection of speech, language, and real-time production systems, improving how AI listens, understands, reasons, empathizes, and responds in live customer conversations.

You will develop and improve machine learning systems that power voice experiences end to end, including automatic speech recognition, turn detection, agentic workflows, voice evaluation, text to speech, speech-to-speech models, and production optimization. You will partner closely with applied researchers, product managers, designers, forward deployed engineers, and platform engineers to ensure model and system improvements translate into measurable customer and business impact.

This role is ideal for someone who is excited by both model quality and production reality: designing rigorous evaluation frameworks, analyzing failure modes, improving latency and robustness, elevating caller interaction experience, and shipping systems that perform reliably at scale in real-time voice environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning systems that power real-time voice experiences, including speech to text turn detection, text to speech, speech to speech, reasoning and structured insight generation.
  • Improve the quality of voice AI systems through error analysis, data curation, metric design, benchmarking, and iterative model improvement, with a strong focus on real-world performance.
  • Build evaluation frameworks for complex voice and agentic systems, measuring metrics such as accuracy, robustness, latency, faithfulness, naturalness, professionalism, task completion, and cost.
  • Diagnose and mitigate failure modes across the voice stack, including transcription errors, hallucinations, tool misuse, prompt brittleness, context drift, and multi-step reasoning breakdowns.
  • Design, implement, and optimize low-latency ML systems that deliver delightful caller experience (e.g., backchanneling, focusing on foreground speaker, interpreting caller’s emotions, responding with empathy).
  • Partner with platform and backend engineers to productionize real-time inference, streaming pipelines, quality monitoring, and continuous model iteration.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, frontend, and backend teams to integrate voice intelligence seamlessly into Cresta’s platform.
  • Mentor engineers, contribute to technical strategy, and help shape the roadmap for Cresta’s voice AI systems.

Qualifications we value

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field; Master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience building, evaluating, and deploying machine learning systems in production.
  • Demonstrated experience in leading fast-moving, highly technical teams. Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional decisions and raise the engineering bar.
  • Distinctive technical vision for the future of voice AI.
  • Strong background in one or more of the following: speech recognition, speech processing, NLP, generative AI, or voice AI.
  • Deep experience with model evaluation, benchmarking, error analysis, and quality improvement for production ML systems.
  • Solid understanding of transformer-based models, embeddings, retrieval systems, and large-scale training or inference workflows.
  • Experience designing and deploying real-time ML systems with strong requirements around latency, scalability, and reliability.
  • Experience building data pipelines and tooling for experimentation, measurement, and large-scale quality analysis.
  • Ability to work across research and engineering boundaries and translate promising ideas into production-grade systems.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with ASR quality metrics such as WER and task-level evaluation methodologies.
  • Experience with RAG systems, agentic workflows, multi-step reasoning systems, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation methods.
  • Familiarity with streaming inference, real-time voice pipelines, or media systems.
  • Experience working closely with infrastructure or platform teams on production ML deployment, observability, and reliability.
  • Experience in contact center AI, conversational intelligence, or enterprise voice products.

Perks & Benefits

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO
  • Paid parental leave
  • Retirement savings support
  • Remote work setup budget or work-from-home stipend
  • Monthly wellness and communication allowance
  • In-office meal or lunch benefits for onsite employees

Compensation

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

Salary Range: $205,000–$270,000 + Offers Equity

Location: Remote (U.S. or Canada)

**A note before you read further**

The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

About Human Agency

We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

Our clients' missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it, and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

The Opportunity

The economic landscape is shifting in ways that demand a new kind of investment discipline. AI is not simply transforming industries — it is redrawing the boundaries of value itself. Political instability, labor displacement, structural economic shifts, and the concentration of technological power are creating conditions that most funds are ill-equipped to navigate. We are building one that is.

Human Agency is developing a fund with a single, clear thesis: how do we maximize the likelihood of real value twenty years from now, in a world being reshaped by AI? We have the conviction and the framework. We are looking for an experienced fund manager to bring the capital, the LP relationships, and the investment discipline needed to make it real.

As AI Resilience Fund Manager, you will build and run this fund from the ground up. This is a founding role — you will shape the portfolio strategy, lead fundraising, and execute investments across asset classes with a 20-year horizon. You will work closely with Human Agency's leadership team to refine the thesis as the landscape evolves and serve as a trusted advisor to fund investors navigating an uncertain economic future.

What You'll Do

  • Build and manage a fund focused on investments resilient to AI disruption, political instability, and structural economic shifts
  • Develop and own the investment thesis and portfolio strategy with a 20-year horizon
  • Lead capital raising from day one — sourcing, cultivating, and closing LP relationships is the core of this role
  • Source, evaluate, and execute investments across asset classes aligned with the resilience thesis
  • Advise fund investors on risk-adjusted positioning for an AI-transformed economy
  • Partner with Human Agency leadership to continuously refine and evolve the thesis as the landscape shifts

What We're Looking For

Experience and Skills

  • Deep experience in fund management, venture capital, private equity, or institutional investing
  • An established network of potential LPs and co-investors — you have raised capital and can do it again
  • Practical, informed conviction around AI's transformative and disruptive potential — not theoretical
  • Long-term investment orientation — you are building a portfolio for 2045, not optimizing for next quarter

Mindset and Traits

  • Exceptional integrity and trustworthiness — this role requires an extraordinary level of trust from investors and partners alike
  • Builder mentality — this fund does not exist yet, and you are the one who will bring it into the world
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a long time horizon — you make principled decisions in an environment that does not offer easy answers

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD/MTTR

  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO

  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM/security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments

  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows

  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence

  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules

  • Must be able to travel up to 30%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry-recognized certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, etc.

  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar.

Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance.

You own the models, pipelines, and tests that everything downstream depends on. You're not a ticket-taker: we expect you to understand why a metric matters before you model it, and to say so when the requirement as stated will produce a number that's technically correct and practically wrong.

This is an early-stage function, so you'll have unusual influence over how it's built.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead the migration of legacy Alteryx workflows into documented, tested dbt models on Redshift.
  • Design models with deliberate grain and clear lineage, building toward a certified set of marts that reporting reads from.
  • Own orchestration, monitoring, and alerting in Dagster (or Airflow), and the ingestion layer feeding it.
  • Keep Redshift fast and cost-effective.
  • Trace issues to the right root cause — reporting, data model, or upstream business process — and route each to the right fix.
  • Build the data foundations behind RevOps initiatives such as account-based marketing, customer health scoring, and predictive work like churn and lead scoring.
  • Use AI and LLM tooling thoughtfully in the engineering workflow, and help the team form a view on where it belongs.

What We're Looking For

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, leads with questions, and doesn't wait to be assigned work.
  • A translator who can explain a data problem to a Sales Director in terms of their quota, and a quota problem to an engineer in terms of a data model.
  • A systems thinker who looks upstream and downstream before proposing a fix.
  • Someone constructively skeptical who reconciles the numbers before shipping them.
  • Impact-focused — you deliver the "so what?", not just the data.
  • An owner who takes pride in the cleanliness of their code and their documentation.

Essential

  • 6 - 8+ years in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence with substantial hands-on modeling responsibility.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining production-grade dbt projects, including testing and documentation.
  • Hands-on production experience with Dagster or Airflow.
  • Advanced SQL and real experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake / BigQuery), including performance tuning.
  • Git-based workflow, code review, and CI as a normal part of how you work.
  • Strong working knowledge of the Salesforce data model.

Preferred

  • Salesforce-specific data modeling experience.

jobs.excerpt: The BIM & Information Management Coordinator will support the development, implementation and continual improvement of Information Management and Building Information Modelling (BIM) processes across the Euston and FNICAP projects.
jobs.description:
The BIM & Information Management Coordinator will support the development, implementation and continual improvement of Information Management and Building Information Modelling (BIM) processes across the Euston and FNICAP projects.

The role is responsible for maintaining project information management systems, supporting Common Data Environment (CDE) compliance, developing reporting and dashboards, coordinating BIM activities, delivering training, and ensuring project documentation remains aligned with ISO 19650 requirements and industry best practice.

The successful candidate will work closely with project teams, document controllers, engineers, suppliers and stakeholders to improve information quality, compliance, reporting and digital delivery performance.

Key Responsibilities

Information Management & CDE Administration

  • Create, maintain and continuously improve project BIM and Information Management SharePoint sites.
  • Ensure procedures, templates, guidance documents, training materials and useful resources remain current and accessible.
  • Support the administration and configuration of project Common Data Environments (CDEs), including REBIM.
  • Assist with the implementation and ongoing development of Information Management processes and controls.
  • Maintain project information structures, permissions and documentation repositories.

BIM Training & User Support

  • Issue, manage and analyse BIM competency and training questionnaires.
  • Identify knowledge gaps and develop targeted training programmes.
  • Create and deliver BIM and Information Management training, workshops, presentations and user guides.
  • Provide ongoing support and guidance to project teams, suppliers and document controllers.
  • Capture common queries and convert these into guidance notes, FAQs and training materials.

Reporting, Analytics & Performance Monitoring

  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to monitor Information Management performance.
  • Produce monthly compliance and document health reporting using data from REBIM and other project information sources.
  • Analyse key performance indicators relating to:
    • Document quality and compliance
    • Metadata completeness
    • Delivery against programme dates
    • Overdue documentation
    • Team and supplier performance
    • Information Management maturity
  • Identify trends, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement and communicate findings to stakeholders.

Information Management Compliance & Assurance

  • Develop and maintain compliance trackers and monitoring tools.
  • Conduct regular information assurance and housekeeping checks.
  • Monitor project compliance with document control and Information Management procedures.
  • Verify:
    • Document naming conventions
    • Metadata quality
    • Revision management
    • Status codes
    • Approvals and workflows
    • Filing structures
    • Information delivery requirements
    • TIDP and MIDP management
  • Record non-compliances, corrective actions and lessons learned.
  • Support teams in resolving compliance issues and improving working practices.

BIM Coordination & Model Management

  • Maintain project models within OpenTree and associated information repositories.
  • Manage superseded model versions and ensure current information is available to project teams.
  • Upload, organise and maintain approved model information.
  • Support model coordination activities and, where required, undertake or coordinate clash detection processes.
  • Monitor clash resolution activities and assist with the management of model coordination issues.
  • Develop model performance reporting and dashboards where appropriate.

Information Management Documentation

  • Maintain and update core project Information Management documentation including:
    • Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
    • Information Production Requirements (IPR)
    • BIM Execution Plans (BEP)
    • Project procedures
    • Templates and guidance documents
    • Responsibility matrices
    • TIDPs and MIDPs
  • Support the ongoing review and development of EIR and IPR documentation.
  • Ensure project documentation remains aligned with ISO 19650 standards and industry best practice.
  • Coordinate updates required following changes to standards, terminology, roles and responsibilities.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve BIM and Information Management processes.
  • Capture lessons learned, recurring issues and successful practices across projects.
  • Develop meaningful KPIs that demonstrate project performance and compliance.
  • Support project mobilisation activities through the application of lessons learned.
  • Contribute to the development of improved reporting, training, procedures and governance frameworks.

Professional Development

  • Maintain and develop technical BIM knowledge and Information Management expertise.
  • Undertake ongoing training in BIM and digital engineering software including Revit, Solibri and Navisworks.
  • Remain informed of developments in ISO 19650, Information Management standards and industry best practice.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Experience supporting BIM and Information Management activities on complex infrastructure, construction or engineering projects.
  • Understanding of ISO 19650 Information Management principles and requirements.
  • Experience working within Common Data Environments (CDEs).
  • Knowledge of document control processes and information governance.
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards and performance metrics using Power BI.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience maintaining BIM and Information Management documentation.
  • Ability to deliver training and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively across project teams.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Knowledge of clash detection and model coordination workflows.
  • Experience working on rail, defence, infrastructure or major programme environments.
  • Experience supporting TIDP and MIDP management.
  • Familiarity with digital assurance and compliance auditing processes.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are a fast-growing wellness brand rethinking the traditional protein bar — an all-natural, whole-food protein bar using clean, recognizable ingredients. As the brand expands across retail, our founders are documenting the behind-the-scenes journey of building the business — from travelling across the US and supporting retail launches to demos, events, and everyday startup life.

We're looking for a Long & Short-Form Video Editor to turn that raw footage into engaging, story-driven content. This role will primarily focus on editing long-form YouTube-style content, supported by short-form edits for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and the founders' personal social channels.

You'll receive raw footage from the founders and be responsible for turning it into polished, engaging content that captures the personality, energy, and reality of building a fast-growing consumer brand. We're looking for someone who is more than a technical editor — you should understand storytelling, pacing, humour, hooks, and retention, and be able to identify the moments within hours of footage that are actually worth watching.

Work Structure & Requirements

  • Location: Remote / Virtual
  • Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week)
  • Time Zone: EST business hours
  • Compensation:8 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities

1. Long-Form Video Editing

  • Edit raw founder footage into engaging YouTube-style episodes, typically around 15–25 minutes
  • Review several hours of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, storylines, and narrative arcs
  • Turn loosely structured footage into cohesive, entertaining stories
  • Cut unnecessary material while maintaining natural pacing and personality
  • Add music, sound effects, text, graphics, subtitles, and other elements where appropriate
  • Handle basic colour correction, audio cleanup, and overall visual consistency
  • Create strong openings and hooks that encourage viewers to continue watching
  • Incorporate B-roll and supporting footage to strengthen storytelling
  • Manage revisions and deliver polished final edits on schedule

2. Short-Form Content

  • Turn long-form footage and standalone clips into TikToks, Instagram Reels, and other vertical content
  • Identify short moments that can work independently as compelling social content
  • Edit clips with strong hooks, captions, pacing, and platform-native formatting
  • Create content for both the brand and the founders' personal accounts
  • Develop teasers and cutdowns that help drive audiences toward longer YouTube content
  • Repurpose existing footage efficiently to maximise the value of each shoot

3. Content & Editing Workflow

  • Organise raw footage, project files, and completed assets in a clear and repeatable system
  • Maintain consistent editing styles, fonts, graphics, and visual treatments
  • Work closely with the founders to understand their preferred style and continuously refine it
  • Manage multiple videos at different stages of the editing process
  • Proactively suggest opportunities to turn existing footage into additional content
  • Stay current with editing styles and content trends across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience: 3+ years of professional video editing experience
  • Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating both long-form and short-form editing; experience editing YouTube, documentary-style, vlog, founder-led, or behind-the-scenes content
  • Storytelling: Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, and audience retention; ability to take several hours of raw footage and independently determine what should make the final cut
  • Short-Form: Excellent short-form editing instincts for TikTok and Instagram Reels
  • Technical: Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software; comfortable with captions, motion graphics, sound design, and basic colour correction
  • Organisation: Highly organised and able to manage large volumes of footage
  • Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; able to work independently with limited direction
  • Bonus: Experience editing content for CPG, food, wellness, fitness, or lifestyle brands; experience editing founder-led YouTube series or startup/build-in-public content; basic motion graphics or After Effects experience; YouTube thumbnail design; familiarity with YouTube retention analytics; experience repurposing long-form content into multiple short-form assets

jobs.excerpt: About The Role:As Rightway rapidly scales, we are looking for an experienced Commercial leader to drive growth through strategic partnerships and channels.
jobs.description:
About The Role:

As Rightway rapidly scales, we are looking for an experienced Commercial leader to drive growth through strategic partnerships and channels. This person will have a unique opportunity to shape the partner distribution strategy and lead high-impact deals with significant revenue potential.

The role will have a regional remit, with focus on aggregators (captives, private equity firms, PEOs, TPAs, and coalitions) that are a fit for Rightway’s transparent PBM model and Navigation offering. Responsibilities will range from partnership targeting, vetting, pipeline development through contract negotiation, with the goal of establishing preferred relationships that drive ongoing committed pipeline and revenue growth. This role will lead Partnership Manager(s), who drive the ongoing health and success of the established partnership (ongoing relationship health, partnership performance, metrics tracking, etc)

This position will include travel as necessary to manage the business objectives of the role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish net new relationships with partner companies and nurture them toward contracted relationships with shared and committed commercialization goals
  • Expand existing opportunities / relationships and bring a fresh perspective to further accelerate them
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders and executives across partners and work with them to drive awareness and growth strategies
  • Manage all commercial processes with prospective partners, including but not limited to: initial discovery/capabilities meetings, Request for Proposal (RFP), finalist pitches, price negotiation and contracting, hand-off to Implementation and Client Management, and ongoing growth strategy
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Product, Analytics, Clinical, Operations, Implementation and others, to scope new opportunities and design optimal partner setup
  • Collaborate with the Client Management team to ensure successful ongoing management of strategic partner accounts once established
  • Contribute to the product roadmap and commercial strategy by surfacing feedback from partners and the market
  • Track activity in Salesforce and provide pipeline visibility through reporting / updates

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree Required
  • 10-15+ year background in healthcare industry and/or benefits consulting (with PBM fluency)
  • Deep expertise developing and managing partnerships
  • “Builder” experience and mindset
  • Strategic thinker that is continuously looking to drive toward strong and high performing partnerships
  • History of consistently attaining / exceeding growth metrics
  • Tenacious attitude in the face of challenges or unexpected obstacles
  • Proven organization, time management, and prioritization skills to manage multiple relationships and opportunities in various phases of the sales process
  • Excellent communication skills, organization, and strong follow-through
  • Comfort with the ambiguity of a fast-paced startup – ability to innovate and solve problems creatively
  • Collaborative mindset and pride in championing deals internally and externally

COMPENSATION: $144,000 - $180,000 annually, in addition to bonus and equity

Compensation offered will be determined by geographic location, experience, and qualifications.

CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS NOTICE

In response to ongoing and industry-wide fraudulent recruitment activities (i.e., job scams), Rightway wants to inform potential candidates that we will only contact them from the @ email domain. We will never ask for bank details or deposits of any kind as a condition of employment.

ABOUT RIGHTWAY:

Rightway is on a mission to harmonize healthcare for everyone, everywhere. Our products guide patients to the best care and medications by inserting clinicians and pharmacists into a patient’s care journey through a modern, mobile app. Rightway is a front door to healthcare, giving patients the tools they need along with on-demand access to Rightway health guides, human experts that answer their questions and manage the frustrating parts of healthcare for them.

Since its founding in 2017, Rightway has raised over $200mm from investors including Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, and Tiger Global. We’re headquartered in New York City, with satellite offices in Denver and Dallas. Our clients rely on us to transform the healthcare experience, improve outcomes for their teams, and decrease their healthcare costs.

HOW WE LIVE OUR VALUES TO OUR TEAMMATES:

We’re seeking those with passion for healthcare and relentless devotion to our goal. We need team members that embody our core values:

1) We are human, firstOur humanity binds us together. We bring the same empathetic approach to every individual we engage with, whether it be our members, our clients, or each other. We are all worthy of respect and understanding and we engage in our interactions with care and intention. We honor our stories. We listen to—and hear—each other, we celebrate our differences and similarities, we are present for each other, and we strive for mutual understanding.

2) We redefine what is possibleWe always look beyond the obstacles in front of us to imagine new solutions. We approach our work with inspiration from other industries, other leaders, and other challenges. We use ingenuity and resourcefulness when faced with tough problems.

3) We debate then commitWe believe that a spirit of open discourse is part of a healthy culture. We understand and appreciate different perspectives and we challenge our assumptions. When working toward a decision or a new solution, we actively listen to one another, approach it with a “yes, and” mentality, and assume positive intent. Once a decision is made, we align and champion it as one team.

4) We cultivate gritChanging healthcare doesn’t happen overnight. We reflect and learn from challenges and approach the future with a determination to strive for better. In the face of daunting situations, we value persistence. We embrace failure as a stepping stone to future success. On this journey, we seek to act with guts, resilience, initiative, and tenacity.

5) We seek to delightHealthcare is complicated and personal. We work tirelessly to meet the goals of our clients while also delivering the best experience to our members. We recognize that no matter the role or team, we each play a crucial part in our members’ care and take that responsibility seriously. When faced with an obstacle, we are kind, respectful, and solution-oriented in our approach. We hold ourselves accountable to our clients and our members’ success.

Rightway is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in the strength of diverse thought, beliefs, backgrounds, and education. We foster an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated to drive the best business decisions possible. We do not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, need, and performance.
