  • Work within our cross-platform TypeScript React Native app to build and maintain new innovative product features.
  • Actively learn new areas of the product, and collaborate with owners for different product features to gain insight and offer constructive suggestions for improvements
  • Be an active participant in design/architecture discussions sharing your ideas while building the next generation of features for the Sezzle platform
  • Hands-on with our codebase and a contributor to code reviews
  • Work with the team to continuously build clean, scalable, robust, and testable code
  • Assist in planning, estimations, and completion for projects brought up by the team stakeholders

What We Look For:

  • Experience solving technical problems as part of a team
  • Bachelor's in computer science (preferred) or equivalent related experience
  • Familiarity with modern Frontend Development, Javascript or Typescript, with React Native or React (web) experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience developing and delivering a mobile application to a mobile app store (App Store or Google Play Store)
  • Knowledgeable in writing automated tests for applications (unit, integration, end-to-end)
  • Familiar with the basic principles and design of React Native Apps, and RESTful APIs
  • Close familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.excerpt: About ProperProper is an AI-first accounting service built for property managers and real estate operators.
jobs.description:
About Proper

Proper is an AI-first accounting service built for property managers and real estate operators. We combine automation, our own technology and a global team of accounting experts to run financial operations that are faster and more accurate than what the industry has settled for.

We are 480 people across the US, Colombia and Mexico, serving 175 property management and real estate clients. We are a San Francisco based company and most of our accounting organisation is in Latin America.

The role

You will run a pod: roughly 20 client accounts, 4 to 6 direct reports, and the 20 or so people who sit under them. Your direct reports are Senior Accountants and Principal Accountants, and each of them leads a small team and owns a set of clients.

You are accountable for three things. Whether those clients stay. Whether the work reaching them is right. Whether the pod makes money.

What makes this job different from most accounting management roles is where you sit. You are not the client's day-to-day contact, and you are not the last person to review every deliverable. Your Senior Accountants do that work and report to you on it. Your job is to know independently whether their picture is accurate, and to coach what you find. That means opening the books yourself, listening to recorded client calls, and forming your own view of an account rather than accepting a status update. If that sounds like less control than you are used to, it is actually more responsibility, and it is the part of the role we care most about.

Key Responsibilities

  • Knowing the truth about every account. Run health-check style reviews on client books, looking for discrepancies and for what they say about how the accounting has actually been done. Review our client health dashboard and act on what it surfaces. Spot check financials and client communications. Track error rates. Stay close to escalations and confirm they get resolved.
  • Coaching your team. This is the biggest part of the week. You will coach Senior and Principal Accountants on two things at once: running their own teams, and running their clients well. That includes reviewing recorded client calls and giving feedback specific enough to change what happens on the next one.
  • Client relationships and value. You check in on accounts on a regular cadence, and you take escalations that need someone more senior. You make sure we are delivering everything the client contracted for, and that our work is not quietly being absorbed back by the client's own team.
  • Quality and process. Individual errors get fixed by the team. Your job is to notice when a pattern of errors means something upstream has to change, and then change it. You will drive documentation and standardisation of client processes, and you will be the front line for rolling out new processes and automation with our Operations, Product and Engineering teams, including making sure the feedback from your team actually reaches them.
  • The economics. You work with Finance and Workforce Management on capacity, cost to serve and gross margin per client, and you connect those numbers back to how your own pod is staffed and run.

Qualifications & Required Skills

    • At least two years managing senior individual contributors or managers, meaning people who had their own reports or owned their own client relationships. Managing a team of processors is not the same job.
    • You have personally owned external client relationships. Clients you can name, where you were the person they emailed.
    • Working knowledge of US GAAP including financial statement presentation. Enough to read a balance sheet, find something that does not tie, and challenge a senior accountant on it.
    • Advanced English. You will be on calls with US property owners.
    • Based in Mexico, with enough working-hours overlap to join US business-hours calls.
    • One process improvement you ran end to end, where you can tell us the number before and the number after.
    • A degree in accounting or demonstrated equivalent knowledge.

jobs.description:
About Zingtree

Zingtree helps high-stakes customer support teams deliver fast, consistent, and compliant answers—every time. Our AI Automation platform enables support-agents and end-consumers to follow complex procedures with ease, resolve issues faster, and ensure customers get the right outcomes in moments that matter. Zingtree helps leading customer support organizations transform self-service, streamline support agent workflows, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.
Zingtree is trusted by over 500 customers including industry leaders like Corpay, Experian, Optum / UnitedHealth Group, Allianz, SharkNinja, Sony, and Groupon to power intelligent automation across finance, healthcare, insurance, consumer services / products, and tech. These organizations rely on Zingtree to reduce handle times, increase FCR, improve CSAT, and stay compliant — all without overloading IT. As demand for governed AI and guided CX grows, we’re scaling our team to help more enterprises take control of their most complex support workflows.
We are seeking a Senior SaaS Solutions Architect with strong project management capabilities and a passion for building conversational AI workflows. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role ideal for someone who excels at guiding clients through the technical implementation of intelligent support solutions. In this role, you’ll own the end-to-end deployment process—from systems integration to the design, build, and launch of conversational AI workflows tailored to each customer’s needs. You’ll work closely with both client stakeholders and internal teams to deliver seamless automation, configure advanced integrations, manage timelines, and ensure a successful go-live. This position requires a unique blend of technical expertise, AI workflow design experience, and a customer-first mindset to drive real impact for support organizations.
The role reports into the COO and in order to best support our UK clients, we're only accepting applicants based on the East Coast of the U.S. or in the United Kingdom.

What You'll Do

  • Solution Design & Customization: Design, demo and build tailored AI-driven and conversational workflows that align with customer support objectives. Leverage decision trees and natural language interfaces to streamline complex support interactions.
  • Technical Configuration & Integration: Collaborate with client IT teams to configure and integrate Zingtree with CRMs, APIs, and third-party platforms—ensuring reliable data exchange and conversational AI compatibility.
  • Client Onboarding & Planning: Lead onboarding sessions to gather business requirements, understand customer support processes, and define project goals, with a focus on identifying opportunities for conversational automation.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle, providing regular updates and managing expectations. Operate as the technical liaison to translate requirements between client business and IT resources, as well internally with team members
  • Risk & Issue Management: Identify and mitigate project risks; resolve technical and process-related issues to prevent project delays.
  • Testing & Validation: Guide UAT (User Acceptance Testing) with clients, ensuring conversational workflows and integrations meet functional and experience goals.
  • Training & Enablement: Participate in platform and user training sessions to ensure customers are equipped to build and maintain AI-enabled conversational flows, workflows, and reporting.
  • Go-Live & Post-Implementation Support: Ensure successful go-live execution and provide a seamless transition to Customer Success and Support for ongoing enhancements and support.
  • Project Management: Coordinate and collaborate on multiple SaaS implementation projects concurrently - balancing technical execution, AI workflow development, and client alignment within defined timelines and scopes.

Who You Are

  • Work Experience: 7+ years in a solutions architect, customer engineering, technical project implementation roles, with at least 4+ years in enterprise B2B SaaS, preferably in customer support or contact center solutions, and with start-up experience.
  • Conversational AI & Technical Expertise: Proven hands-on experience with automation technologies and integration architectures, including APIs, authentication protocols, middleware, web services, and messaging patterns. Proficiency in technologies enabling conversational AI—such as large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, AI-led agentic workflows, and real-time decisioning. Strong front-end skills (JavaScript, CSS, JSON) and familiarity with ETL/data transformation. Experience integrating with CRMs (especially Salesforce and Zendesk) is a significant plus.
  • Business Acumen: Specializes in digesting complex business requirements and designing comprehensive and integrated workflow solutions that are flexible and adaptable to the client's needs.
  • Analytical Mindset: Proficient in troubleshooting technical challenges and collaborating with cross-functional teams to find solutions. Ability to quickly understand operational processes and identify areas the technology can condense and/or optimize the processes.
  • Client-Facing Expertise: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills; experience interfacing with customers to manage expectations, resolve issues, and ensure project success. Ability to clearly articulate technical topics to a non-technical audience, including experience working with executives.

  • Competitive Compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits (100% covered for employees)
  • Equity Stock Options
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible Remote Work Environment
  • $500 Home Office Stipend + Monthly Internet/Phone reimbursement
  • Co-Working Reimbursement up to $200/month

Our Core Values

  • Lead with Action – We move fast with purpose
  • People Really Matter – We win as a team and support each other fully
  • Ownership Leads to Results – We take responsibility and deliver
  • Expertise Creates Value – We build and apply knowledge
  • Transparency Builds Trust – We communicate clearly, directly, and with care.
    • As Zingers, we operate with a mindset that blends urgency, intelligence, and humanity.

Empowering teams to resolve complex customer issues with confidence, clarity, and control. We believe the future of customer experience belongs to those who can orchestrate outcomes—not just automate tasks.

Creating a world where every customer interaction is accurate, compliant, and effortlessly scalable.

jobs.description:
About the Company

Founded in 2018 by professors of Yale University and Columbia University, CertiK is a pioneer in blockchain security, utilizing best-in-class AI technology to secure and monitor blockchain protocols and smart contracts. CertiK’s mission is to secure the cyber world. Starting with blockchain, CertiK applies cutting-edge innovations from academia into enterprise, enabling mission-critical applications to be built with security and correctness. CertiK is one of the fastest growing and most trusted companies in blockchain security and has become a true market leader. Our clients include leading projects such as Aave, Polygon, Binance Smart Chain, Yearn, and Chiliz. Our investors include top VCs like Tiger Global, Coatue Management, Shunwei Capital and Hillhouse Capital as well as industry leaders like Coinbase Ventures and Binance.

About the Position

The primary focus of this role is to pioneer the development of an intelligent AI agent powered by large language models (LLMs) to enhance our security audit tools in the blockchain space. As a Blockchain Security Expert intern, you will work closely with our blockchain security team to bridge cutting-edge academic research with practical applications. Your efforts will be dedicated to designing, fine-tuning, and integrating LLM-driven AI agents that automatically analyze smart contracts and identify potential vulnerabilities. In this role, you'll be immersed in research and experimentation, exploring new methods to improve threat detection and risk assessment within our security audit platform, thereby directly contributing to more secure blockchain infrastructures.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with our blockchain security team to design and implement a large language model (LLM)-based AI agent for security audit tools.
  • Experiment with novel AI techniques to enhance threat detection and risk assessment in blockchain environments.
  • Assist in transforming cutting-edge research on AI agents into practical, scalable security auditing solutions.
  • Continuously research emerging trends in LLMs, AI agent architectures, and cybersecurity, and proactively propose improvements.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field, with a strong emphasis on machine learning, natural language processing, and/or cybersecurity.
  • Deep understanding of LLM architectures (e.g., transformers) and hands-on experience in training or fine-tuning such models.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Basic familiarity with blockchain technology and smart contract development is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical skills, problem-solving capabilities, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, innovative startup environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Bonus Points

  • Prior research or project experience in developing AI agents or automated security analysis tools.
  • Exposure to security audit methodologies and vulnerability assessment, particularly in blockchain or smart contract environments.
  • Familiarity with blockchain programming languages (e.g., Solidity) and platforms (e.g., Ethereum).
  • Publications or contributions to leading conferences/journals in AI, NLP, or cybersecurity.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate research insights into effective, production-ready tools.

jobs.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Director, Technical Product Operations

Role Summary

Real Chemistry is seeking a hands-on Director, Technical Product Operations to own the end-to-end management, operation, and security of our flagship client-facing SaaS products. These platforms are hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS), delivered to clients as a commercial product, engineered to be SOC 2 compliant, and increasingly powered by AI-enabled features.

This is a working leadership role — not a purely strategic one. The successful candidate is a technically credible, roll-up-your-sleeves operator who has personally implemented and run a product on AWS infrastructure, and who can lead a team while remaining directly engaged in architecture, deployment, security, and production support. You will be the single point of accountability for platform availability, performance, security posture, and the fully-supported client experience.

What you'll do:

Platform Ownership & AWS Operations

  • Own the full lifecycle of the client-facing SaaS products hosted on AWS — from infrastructure design and deployment through ongoing operation, optimization, and support.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain scalable, resilient AWS environments (compute, storage, networking, databases, backups) with clear separation across development, staging, and production.
  • Lead high-availability and disaster-recovery (HA/DR) design, including backup, failover, and recovery procedures, to meet client and contractual uptime commitments.
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and controlled promotion paths between environments.
  • Own observability — metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting — and drive continuous improvement of platform performance and cost efficiency (FinOps).

Security, Compliance & SOC 2

  • Maintain and continuously mature the platform's security posture, ensuring controls are designed, implemented, evidenced, and audit-ready.
  • Own SOC 2 compliance for the platform — partnering with Information Security and external auditors to sustain Type I and progress toward Type II attestation.
  • Enforce least-privilege identity and access management (AWS IAM), encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
  • Coordinate third-party penetration testing, vulnerability management, and remediation within defined risk timelines.
  • Ensure client-facing security, data-handling, and confidentiality requirements are met and clearly documented for client assurance.

AI-Enabled Product Features

  • Support the secure integration and operation of AI/ML and LLM-enabled features within the product, including approved AI providers, usage boundaries, and cost guardrails.
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to productionize AI capabilities with appropriate data classification, DLP, and human-in-the-loop controls where required.

Support, Reliability & Client Experience

  • Ensure the product is fully supported — establishing SLAs, incident response playbooks, on-call coverage, and runbooks for production systems.
  • Serve as senior escalation point for platform incidents, driving rapid resolution and transparent client communication.
  • Own change management, release governance, and post-incident reviews to continuously improve reliability.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Lead, and mentor the external IT / platform engineering team, setting technical standards and delivery discipline.
  • Partner closely with Information Security, Product, and Client-facing teams to align platform capabilities with commercial and client needs.
  • Communicate platform health, risk, and roadmap clearly to both technical teams and executive / C-suite stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with key vendors and third parties (AWS and supporting services).

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on track record — the candidate must be a practitioner who has personally implemented and operated a product on AWS infrastructure, not solely a manager of others who do.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing a product on AWS (compute, networking, databases, IAM, IaC) from build through production operation.
  • 7+ years in IT / platform engineering / cloud operations, including 3+ years operating production workloads in AWS.
  • Prior leadership or people-management experience, ideally leading external IT, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering functions.
  • Strong working knowledge of SOC 2 (and adjacent frameworks) and the practical implementation of the underlying controls.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secrets management, logging/audit).
  • Proven ownership of production reliability — SLAs, incident response, on-call, and HA/DR.
  • Excellent communication skills — equally comfortable with hands-on technical teams and C-suite stakeholders.

What you should have:

  • Experience delivering a client-facing / commercial SaaS product (multi-tenant, externally sold).
  • Experience productionizing AI / LLM-enabled features and governing AI usage, data handling, and cost.
  • Familiarity with regulated or enterprise-client environments (HIPAA-adjacent, GDPR, GxP).
  • Experience with containerization/orchestration (ECS/Fargate, EKS), AWS Lambda, and observability tooling.
  • Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps / Security, CISSP, CCSP).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

Pay Range: $200,000-$235,000

At Motional, we're transforming how autonomous vehicles discover critical intelligence hidden within petabytes of multimodal sensor data. Our next-generation autonomous driving stack depends on finding the rare edge cases, long-tail scenarios, and model errors that matter most. Omnitag, our ML-powered multimodal data mining framework, along with our Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and triage products, form the core platform that powers this discovery and enables external customers to diagnose and resolve complex driving scenarios.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the Data Mining team, you will serve as the technical anchor for our user-facing products, architecting the UI excellence and control plane services that power exploration across petabytes of data. You will build and scale high-performance APIs and intuitive interfaces that deliver visualization, telemetry, and data mining directly to enterprise users. Partnering closely with UX designers, ML engineers, and core platform teams, you will champion front-end best practices, establish bulletproof testing patterns, and ensure every production release delivers a flawless user experience.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive Front-End & UI Excellence: Serve as the technical anchor for customer-facing applications, setting standards for state management, component modularity, and performance using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Bridge UX & Production: Partner closely with UX/UI designers to translate complex workflows and design systems into responsive, performant web interfaces, interactive data visualizations, and telemetry tools.
  • Architect Control Plane APIs: Build and scale low-latency REST and gRPC microservices in Python and Node.js/TypeScript to efficiently manage and retrieve massive multimodal query payloads.
  • Guarantee Reliability & CI/CD: Establish robust testing strategies (unit, integration, and E2E automation) and CI/CD pipelines to ensure flawless releases and prevent UI/UX regressions across client deployments.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Collaborate with ML researchers, data mining engineers, and platform teams to translate cutting-edge data curation and triage needs into intuitive product features.
  • Mentorship & Communication: Mentor engineers on full-stack best practices while clearly articulating architectural strategies to both technical peers and stakeholders.

What We're Looking For (Must-Haves):

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, with 6+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience building and scaling production web applications.
  • Proven track record in modern front-end frameworks (React, Next.js, TypeScript) paired with strong backend development in Python and Node.js to design and operate high-performance REST and gRPC services.
  • Practical experience designing high-performance APIs and managing cloud infrastructure using AWS (EKS, Lambda) and AWS CDK (TypeScript) or Terraform.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing automated testing pipelines (e.g., Cypress, Playwright) and maturing CI/CD practices to safeguard user experience across deployments.
  • Track record of collaborating with UX designers, ML engineers, and data teams to transform complex technical domain needs into intuitive tools.

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Prior experience in autonomous vehicles (AV), robotics, or real-time spatial/sensor data applications.
  • Product design sensibilities or direct UI/UX experience.
  • Familiarity with 3D visualization, Canvas/WebGL, or 3D math/linear algebra fundamentals for handling sensor data viewers.
  • Background in internal developer tooling, log ingestion, telemetry viewers, or data annotation systems.

We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.

Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

jobs.excerpt: About Amperity—Why This, Why NowMost customer data is a lie by omission.
jobs.description:
About Amperity—Why This, Why Now

Most customer data is a lie by omission.

Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap—between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true—is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.

With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being—in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands—like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running—trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.

Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company—not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.

So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like—alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus—this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.

We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.

The Opportunity

We’re always eager to connect with driven and customer-focused sales professionals who are passionate about helping organizations unlock the full potential of their customer data. While we don't currently have an open position available, we’re growing and regularly hire for a range of sales roles.

At Amperity, our Sales team plays a pivotal role in shaping the company’s growth and success. From identifying opportunities and building lasting relationships to delivering strategic solutions that address complex business challenges, you’ll help prospects and customers discover the value of our platform and achieve their goals. Whether your strengths are in new business development, pre-sales solutions consulting, operations, enablement, business value consulting, or strategic partnerships, you’ll collaborate closely with prospects and customers to create meaningful impact.

If you’re interested in joining Amperity’s Sales team but don’t see an opportunity that fits right now, please submit your resume. We’ll keep your information on file and reach out when we find a match!

jobs.title: Data Scientist — Blockchain Intelligence
jobs.excerpt: ⚡️ About Merkle ScienceMerkle Science provides blockchain transaction monitoring and intelligence solutions for web3 companies, digital asset service providers, financial institutions, law enforcement and government agencies to detect, investigate, and prevent illicit use of cryptocurrencies.
jobs.description:
⚡️ About Merkle Science

Merkle Science provides blockchain transaction monitoring and intelligence solutions for web3 companies, digital asset service providers, financial institutions, law enforcement and government agencies to detect, investigate, and prevent illicit use of cryptocurrencies. Our vision is to make cryptocurrencies safe and provide infrastructure for the safe and compliant growth of cryptocurrencies.
Merkle Science is headquartered in New York with offices in Singapore, Bangalore and London. The team has combined experience across Bank of America, Paypal, Luno, Thomson Reuters and Amazon. The company has raised over $27M from SIG, Beco, Republic, DCG, Kenetic, GGV and several others.

About the role

We turn raw on-chain activity into trustworthy intelligence — clustering addresses into real-world entities, attributing them to services and actors, and surfacing risk for compliance and investigations teams. We're looking for a data scientist who is as comfortable shipping a heuristic to production as they are designing it: someone who can move from a messy hypothesis to a working pipeline without waiting on someone else to wire up the data.

You'll work closely with our attribution and clustering leads on models and heuristics that run across billions of transactions and multiple chains (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tron, Solana, and more).

What you'll do

  • Design, test, and ship clustering and attribution heuristics, and measure them with real precision/coverage metrics rather than vibes.

  • Own your data end to end — pull, clean, join, and model large on-chain datasets without depending on a separate team for every query.

  • Build and maintain the pipelines that take a heuristic from notebook to production, including backfills, incremental runs, and validation.

  • Investigate edge cases (mixers, bridges, exchange hot wallets, consolidation patterns) and translate findings into repeatable logic.

  • Partner with investigations and product to define what "correct" looks like and benchmark against ground truth.

  • Prototype quickly, then harden what works.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years building data science or data engineering systems that actually shipped (not just notebooks).

  • Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with large datasets and the gotchas of joins, dedup, and skew at scale.

  • Solid grasp of clustering, graph/network analysis, or entity resolution — and a habit of validating results, not just producing them.

  • Ability to reason about precision vs. coverage trade-offs and defend your metrics.

  • Self-directed: you can scope an ambiguous problem, get the data yourself, and drive it to a result.

Our tech stack

You don't need to have used all of these, but here's what you'd be working with day to day:

  • Databricks — our lakehouse and processing backbone. Large-scale on-chain datasets are transformed and modeled here via Spark and SQL; most heuristics run as Databricks jobs against billions of transactions.

  • Kafka — real-time ingestion of on-chain and transaction data. New blocks and events stream in continuously, so a lot of our work is designed to run incrementally rather than as one-off batch jobs.

  • Python — the primary language for everything from exploratory analysis to production heuristics and pipeline code.

  • TigerGraph — our graph database, where addresses, transactions, and entities live as a network. Clustering, traversals, and relationship queries (who funds whom, consolidation paths, entity linkage) happen here.

Supporting cast you'll likely touch:

  • SQL everywhere — for ad-hoc analysis, validation, and defining ground-truth datasets.

  • Columnar / analytical stores (e.g., ClickHouse) for fast aggregate queries over large tables.

  • Orchestration & scheduling for backfills and recurring pipeline runs.

  • Git / GitHub for version control and code review — we expect pipelines and heuristics to be reviewed like any other code.

  • GCP as our cloud environment.

How we work

Small, high-trust team. You'll have a lot of ownership and very little bureaucracy. We prototype fast, measure honestly, and ship.

❤️ Well Being, Compensation and Benefits

We care about your well-being. Along with excellent health insurance, we offer flexible time off, learning & development initiatives and hours that are designed to provide work/life balance. We regularly host team-building sessions and encourage discussions around mental health.
We reward talent and believe in acknowledging people for their contributions. We offer industry-leading compensation, along with generous equity. As a rapidly growing business, there are endless opportunities to grow your career with Merkle Science.

You also drive the automation of security controls and governance processes while supporting teams across the business in the secure and compliant use of AI technologies.

Your mission

  • You advise on and assess internally developed and externally sourced AI systems, Generative AI applications, LLM-based workflows, and agentic AI solutions from a security perspective

  • You build automated security controls and integrate AI security checks into DevSecOps, CI/CD, and MLOps processes
  • You establish monitoring and detection capabilities for AI applications and collaborate with Security Operations teams to investigate security events and abuse patterns

Your experience & skills

  • You hold a degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, or a comparable qualification
  • You have several years of experience in Security Engineering, Application Security, Cloud Security, or a related Cyber Security field
  • You have hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), modern AI platforms, and cloud technologies such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
  • You have experience with threat modeling, security assessments, architecture reviews, and modern DevSecOps, CI/CD, or MLOps practices
  • Knowledge of AI security frameworks and standards such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, or similar approaches is a plus
  • Ideally, you have experience with AI Red Teaming, RAG architectures, vector databases, agentic AI concepts, or regulatory frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIS2, and the EU AI Act

The Quality Group (TQG) is an innovative provider of sports nutrition products, bringing together the successful brands ESN and More Nutrition since 2021.

ESN has been the German market leader in sports nutrition since 2004, offering products like protein powders, bars, and supplements designed for ambitious fitness goals. Founded in 2017, More Nutrition focuses on healthy, reduced-sugar foods, providing solutions for conscious nutrition and weight management without compromise.

TQG’s vision is to help people become the best version of themselves. With passion and innovation, the company develops high-quality products that promote health, performance, and joy in life.     ● Translate product requirements and designs into scalable, maintainable frontend implementations

    ● Own features from technical design and development through testing, release, and production monitoring

    ● Improve application performance, responsiveness, and Core Web Vitals

    ● Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for critical user journeys

    ● Debug production issues using logs, monitoring, browser profiling, and observability tools

    ● Participate in code reviews and contribute to frontend engineering standards

    ● Collaborate with Product, Design, Backend, and QA while maintaining strong ownership of delivery

    ● Continuously identify opportunities to simplify the codebase and improve the customer experience

Minimum Qualifications:

    ● 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience building production web applications

    ● Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS

    ● Strong experience with a modern frontend framework such as Vue.js, React, or Angular

    ● Good understanding of component architecture, state management, routing, and frontend application design

    ● Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs

    ● Strong understanding of browser fundamentals, asynchronous programming, and client-side performance

    ● Ability to convert product and design requirements into maintainable technical solutions

    ● Experience debugging complex frontend issues using browser developer tools and observability platforms

    ● Understanding of frontend testing practices including unit, integration, and E2E testing

    ● Strong problem-solving skills and ability to independently own moderately complex features

Preferred Qualifications:

    ● Strong experience with Vue.js / Vue 3

    ● Experience building complex SaaS, CRM, productivity, task-management, or workflow products

    ● Experience working with large datasets, virtualized lists, complex tables, filters, search, drag-and-drop, or Kanban-style interfaces

    ● Familiarity with frontend performance optimization and Core Web Vitals

    ● Experience with component libraries or design systems

    ● Experience with frontend observability and monitoring tools

    ● Familiarity with Node.js and the ability to understand or debug backend APIs

    ● Experience with automated E2E frameworks such as Playwright or Cypress

    ● Understanding of accessibility and responsive design

    ● Portfolio, GitHub profile, or examples of production applications you have contributed to

Tech Stack:

    Frontend: Vue.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML, CSS

    Backend: Node.js, Go

    Architecture: REST APIs, Microservices

    Infrastructure & Observability: Cloud-native infrastructure, monitoring and

    observability tooling

What Success Looks Like:

    Within this role, you:

    ● Independently deliver medium-to-large frontend features from requirement to production

    ● Build interfaces that feel fast, intuitive, and reliable for customers

    ● Write maintainable code rather than solutions that only solve the immediate requirement

    ● Think through edge cases and failure states before they become production bugs

    ● Identify and resolve frontend performance bottlenecks

    ● Maintain strong engineering quality through testing, code reviews, and observability

    ● Make sound trade-offs between delivery speed, technical quality, UX, and performance

    ● Take ownership of production issues instead of treating deployment as the end of development

    ● Gradually take ownership of larger areas of the CRM frontend architecture

What We Look For:

    We value engineers who combine strong frontend fundamentals with a product mindset.

    You should care about more than making a UI match a design. We want engineers who ask:

    Is this interaction intuitive?

    What happens with 10,000 records instead of 10?

    What happens when the API is slow or fails?

    Can this component be reused?

    Will this architecture remain maintainable six months from now?

    How do we know this is working correctly in production?

Why Join Us:

    ● Build products used by businesses around the world

    ● Work on complex frontend problems beyond standard CRUD applications

    ● Own meaningful product areas rather than isolated tickets

    ● Work in a fast-moving engineering environment with frequent production releases

    ● Opportunity to influence frontend architecture, performance, and engineering standards

    ● Remote-first culture focused on ownership and outcomes

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The 'Pronto' team serves as the UK's leading provider of mobile policing applications, supporting 50% of the country's 45 police forces and over 70,000 active officers each day. The Hosted Applications team takes primary responsibility for managing the Pronto application across the hosted environment. Our dedicated group remotely oversees these Pronto instances for all hosted customers, directly ensuring platform stability, driving optimal performance, and maintaining continuous operational monitoring.


Job Description

This role is primarily remote, with occasional travel to offices.

Operating within Motorola Solutions’ Hosted Applications Team, the Systems Engineer holds a highly technical role combining application lifecycle engineering with client-facing responsibilities. Leveraging over 3 years of engineering expertise, you will share accountability for managing and sustaining the operational resilience of the mission-critical Pronto Digital Policing application for frontline emergency services and police forces.

In this position, you will assist with key deployment initiatives for standard product enhancements and customised client features. You will act as a technical link between software engineering and shared platform services teams while maintaining direct customer engagement. Key responsibilities involve assisting in analysing software issues, supporting patch rollouts and release cycles, and contributing customer feedback towards application enhancements.

Serving as a technical point of contact, you will support client-facing operations, help align infrastructure and application workflows, and participate in technical discussions during weekly meetings and service reviews. You will also monitor platform health and key performance metrics to help uphold strict Service Level Agreement (SLA) standards, working alongside project managers to resolve technical issues for customers.

You will help maintain SQL Server clusters, which house essential Pronto application data. You will support data security, system reliability, and standard operational processes aligned with the daily needs of our police and emergency service teams.

Key responsibilities of Systems Engineer:

  • Service Reviews & Client Engagement:Participate in regular customer service reviews and weekly meetings with key police force stakeholders to assist in presenting system performance, address operational concerns, and support customer satisfaction efforts.

  • SLA & Delivery Oversight:Assist in monitoring system performance against agreed contractual SLAs, supporting team efforts to minimise downtime and prevent service-impacting incidents.

  • Software Engineering Liaison:Act as an operational liaison for the core Pronto Software Engineering team. Help gather operational insights and support release management activities, including application hotfixes, feature rollouts, and platform deployments.

  • Shared Services Collaboration:Work closely with the internal Shared Services team to align application demands with technical specifications and assist in submitting change requests as needed.

  • Documentation:Contribute to and maintain customer-facing Interface Control Documents (ICDs), detailing technical specifications and protocols required for external system integration with the Pronto platform.

  • Problem & Incident Management:Support the incident management team in investigating and resolving system issues, helping implement effective solutions and preventative measures.

  • Continuous Learning & Knowledge Sharing: Engage in active knowledge sharing within the team, participating in peer learning and documenting technical workflows to support team development.


Basic Requirements

  • Experience:3+ years of progressive experience in Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Hosted Application Operations within enterprise or public safety environments.

  • Security Clearance: Must be eligible for and maintain regional security vetting (e.g., UK NPPV Level 3 and SC Clearance for public safety cloud environments).

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, System Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Driver's License: Must hold a valid driver's license and own a vehicle for travel to customer sites.

  • On-Call Support:Must be willing and available to participate in an on-call rotation to support mission-critical systems and emergency operational needs.

Technical requirements:

  • Architecture & System Lifecycle:Understanding of enterprise architecture principles, end-to-end system workflows, and standard software deployment lifecycle practices.

  • Cloud & Hosting Environments:Hands-on experience supporting hosted application environments across AWS, Azure, or Private Cloud infrastructure.

  • OS & Web Infrastructure: Practical experience administering Windows and Linux operating systems, along with working knowledge of web/application servers, SSL/TLS certificates.

  • Database Management:Practical capability in supporting, querying, and resolving operational issues within enterprise relational databases (such as SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL).

  • Automation & Scripting:Proficiency using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to assist with routine tasks, build basic automation scripts, and monitor application health.

  • Observability & Telemetry:Familiarity with maintaining and using enterprise monitoring tools (such as Grafana, Prometheus, or the TIG stack) to maintain visibility over system health.

  • Incident Resolution & Diagnostics:Strong problem-solving and diagnostic skills to troubleshoot system incidents and support root cause analysis.

  • Stakeholder Alignment & Communication:Effective communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional technical teams, convey technical updates clearly, and support client interactions.

​In return for your expertise, we’ll support you in this new challenge with coaching & development every step of the way. Also, to reward your hard work you’ll get:

  • Competitive salary and reward package

  • 25 days holiday entitlement + bank holidays

  • Attractive Pension Scheme

  • Career development support and wide-ranging learning opportunities

  • Corporate Social Responsibility Initiatives including support for volunteering days

This role is primarily remote, with occasional travel to offices.

Operating within Motorola Solutions’ Hosted Applications Team, the Senior Systems Engineer holds a pivotal, highly technical role combining application lifecycle engineering with key client-facing responsibilities. Leveraging over 7 years of engineering expertise, you will maintain end-to-end accountability for managing and sustaining the operational resilience of the mission-critical Pronto Digital Policing application for frontline emergency services and Police forces.

In this position, you will drive key deployment initiatives for standard product enhancements and customised client features. You will serve as an operational liaison between software engineering and shared platform services teams while maintaining direct customer engagement. You will also evaluate platform health, monitor key performance metrics to uphold strict Service Level Agreement (SLA) standards and work with customer technical project managers to resolve technical issues for their customers.

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Dane Street is seeking an experienced New York Liability IME Specialist to support our growing Liability division. This role serves as the medical-legal subject matter expert throughout the Independent Medical Examination (IME) process, ensuring that the appropriate physician is selected, medical records are thoroughly analyzed, and IME reports are accurate, well-supported, and defensible.

Ideal candidates include insurance defense paralegals, New York bodily injury/liability claims adjusters, IME coordinators or specialists, and other litigation professionals with substantial New York auto liability experience.

This is not an entry-level operations role. The position requires extensive knowledge of New York automobile liability claims, bodily injury litigation, personal injury matters, medical terminology, and Independent Medical Examinations. The successful candidate will exercise sound judgment, critical thinking, and strong analytical skills to evaluate complex medical-legal documentation and support high-quality client deliverables.

Dane Street’s success relies on individual and team contributions every day. We care for our customers, each other, and Dane Street. It is the responsibility for all of us to maintain a positive working environment that promotes client satisfaction and results.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Medical-Legal Case Analysis

  • Review referrals to determine the appropriate medical specialty and expert(s) based on the allegations, claimed injuries, treatment history, and litigation strategy.
  • Analyze Bills of Particulars, medical records, diagnostic studies, operative reports, deposition testimony, and attorney correspondence.
  • Interpret complex medical terminology and treatment records to understand the nature and progression of injuries.
  • Identify missing documentation, inconsistencies, or additional information needed prior to physician review.
  • Physician Selection & Case Strategy
  • Match cases with the most appropriate New York liability medical expert based on specialty, expertise, venue, injury type, and case complexity.
  • Maintain working knowledge of New York IME physicians across multiple specialties.
  • Assist in identifying physician recruiting needs based on client demand and market gaps.

IME Report Review & Quality Assurance

Review IME reports to ensure all client questions have been fully addressed.

Evaluate reports for medical accuracy, consistency, completeness, and defensibility.

Identify inconsistencies between:

  • Bills of Particulars
  • Medical records
  • Diagnostic imaging
  • Physician examination findings
  • Disability assessments
  • Prior and current treatment

Recognize unsupported medical opinions or insufficient rationale requiring clarification.

Coordinate report revisions directly with physicians when necessary.

Client & Physician Collaboration

  • Serve as a medical-legal resource for internal teams and clients.
  • Communicate professionally with physicians, physician offices, claims professionals, attorneys, and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist with complex referrals and resolve case-specific issues.
  • Collaborate with Scheduling, Operations, QA, Credentialing, and Sales to ensure timely case completion.
  • Additional Responsibilities
  • Stay current on New York liability trends, medical specialties, and IME best practices.
  • Support process improvement initiatives and special projects.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in one or more of the following:
  • New York automobile liability claims
  • Bodily injury claims
  • Personal injury litigation
  • Insurance defense litigation
  • Independent Medical Examination (IME) operations

  • New York automobile liability claims
  • Bodily injury and personal injury litigation
  • Independent Medical Examinations (IMEs)

  • Medical terminology
  • Medical records interpretation
  • Diagnostic studies and treatment records
  • New York liability physician specialties and defense experts

  • Exceptional analytical and critical thinking abilities.

Why Join Dane Street?

Dane Street is a national leader in Independent Medical Examination and medical review services. As a New York Liability IME Specialist, you will play a critical role in supporting insurance carriers, third-party administrators, and defense counsel by ensuring every case is matched with the appropriate expert and every medical opinion is supported by sound clinical rationale.

This is a unique opportunity for an experienced medical-legal professional to apply their New York liability expertise in a collaborative, fast-paced environment while helping deliver high-quality, defensible IME services.

We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. At ReversingLabs, our software supply chain security and threat intelligence solutions have become essential to advancing cybersecurity maturity around the globe. We're on a journey to expand adoption and accelerate growth by hiring top talent across the security industry.

Notable breaches such as SolarWinds, CircleCI, and 3CX have elevated software supply chain security as a top initiative across every organization developing or purchasing software. Only ReversingLabs delivers the software package analysis speed and intelligence needed to protect against this critical area of risk.

Our vision is clear. Arming every company with end-to-end insights to ensure development releases securely, IT purchases safely, and the SOC can effectively detect, isolate, and respond.

Your future role as a Senior Software Engineer is extremely important for the success of our solution – a Spectra Assure platform for software assurance. This is a game-changing opportunity.

Our company is at the forefront of innovation, with many aspects built from scratch, fostering an engineering-driven approach. We prioritize developer experience and the development of high-quality, well-documented, and tested code within our Research organization.

You and your teammates will work on developing a scalable and resilient SaaS platform. You will also be able to directly influence the architecture decisions and will be responsible for developing large parts of the new product. We are looking for people who can work independently, but also be a part of a team, and who adhere to the best practice engineering principles for clean and maintainable code. Crucially, if you identify more with being a skilled developer familiar with frontend technologies than strictly a frontend developer, you'll be a great fit for our team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop a scalable and resilient SaaS platform, ensuring seamless integration between frontend and backend components for optimal performance and stability.
  • Influence architecture decisions by offering strategic insights and recommendations based on expertise and best practices.
  • Write, maintain, and optimize efficient, reusable, and reliable TypeScript and Python code.
  • Stay up to date with industry best practices, emerging technologies, and modern design patterns.
  • Translate UX designs into high-quality, user-friendly interfaces.

  • Engage proactively with the product, understand its features, and contribute to its continuous improvement.

  • 7+ years of experience in software development

  • Experience with setting up and maintaining frontend and backend tooling (build and test)

  • Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken) are essential for this role.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Experience with implementing complex workflows
  • Experience with Docker and related technologies

A BIG PLUS

  • Experience with Redux Toolkit, Material-UI, Webpack, and Storybook
  • Experience with Django, PostgreSQL
  • Experience with writing secure code

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Paid annual leave, including public holidays
  • Statutory sick pay and parental leave
  • Workplace pension contributions
  • A safe, inclusive, and supportive work environment

And because we believe in supporting the whole employee experience, Beyond statutory benefits. We offer a thoughtfully designed total rewards package and additional perks that supports your well-being, growth, and long-term success.

Compensation & Financial Security

  • A competitive compensation package, including base salary and performance-based bonus or commission (role-dependent), as well as equity, so you share in the success you help build.

Work-Life Balance & Flexibility

  • Quarterly Wellness Weekends: company-wide 3-day breaks built into the year to truly rest and reboot.
  • Monthly phone allowance to help offset mobile expenses
  • Medical allowance to support your healthcare needs
  • Volunteer Time Allowance: 8 paid hours annually to support a charitable organisation you care about
  • Complimentary Calm app membership to support mindfulness, focus, and stress management

Growth, Learning & Culture

  • Continuous learning and development with full access to Udemy Business
  • Clear paths for advancement, internal mobility, and ongoing career development
  • A collaborative, innovative, and remote-first environment where your work has real impact

Workplace Recognition

ReversingLabs is proud to be recognized as a Best Workplace by Inc. (2025) and a Best Place to Work by Built In (2025 & 2026) across multiple categories. Reflecting our commitment to building a workplace where people feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow.

We have been honored with numerous awards through the years including the 2023 Global InfoSec Award, 2022 CDM Global Infosec Awards, 2021 SC Media Trust Award for Best Threat Intelligence Technology, a 2020 Stevie Award, and the 2017 JPMorgan Chase Hall of Innovation Award for our truly unique malware and explainable threat intelligence products.

jobs.description:
At Tutored by Teachers (TbT), we are on a mission to advance equity in education. We believe that when you put a teacher in front of a student, magic happens. Backed by some of the biggest names in EdTech venture including GSV, A-Street Ventures, and TMV, we are on a mission to close the opportunity gap and need a talented and motivated Account Executive to join our team. As an Account Executive at TbT, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on student outcomes by bringing our virtual academic support programs to schools, districts, and charter networks across the country.

The Role:

We're currently looking for a passionate, driven Account Executive to join our Sales team. We’ve already built relationships with some of the largest school districts in the United States, and we’re ready to start scaling our offerings even further!

In this role, your core job duties will include:

  • Owning the end-to-end sales cycle, from identifying and prospecting new district partners and stakeholders all the way through negotiating contracts and closing deals.
  • Building and maintaining a healthy pipeline of new opportunities.
  • Developing and executing strategic sales plans to meet and exceed sales targets.
  • Consulting with school administrators to understand their exact needs, and demonstrating how our services can support both their students and teachers.
  • Conducting presentations and product demonstrations to key decision-makers.
  • Constantly evaluating and refining your sales process and methodologies to identify potential areas of improvement or close knowledge gaps.
  • Developing processes for identifying at-risk deals and working across departments to mitigate concerns.
  • Using the knowledge gained through conversations with leads and new clients to help the Tutored by Teachers team continue to refine our product further. Communicating with other members of the Tutored by Teacher about
  • Collaborating with the Customer Success team and other departments across the organization to ensure successful onboarding and implementation of new clients, and to establish meaningful and trusted relationships within TbT.
  • Staying up-to-date with market trends and competitor activities
  • Traveling as needed to conferences or partner schools.

Requirements

There’s no such thing as a perfect candidate—if you read the qualifications below and feel like you’d excel in this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t match 100% of the qualifications. Traits that we’ve found are strong indicators of success in this role include:

  • Previous administrative experience at the school or district level (i.e. experience as a Principal, Assistant Superintendent, Superintendent, etc.). This is probably the trait we value most highly; selling to school administration often involves being able to closely understand the challenges that school districts face. We’ve found that AEs with experience in admin have found the most success.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You’ll be speaking regularly with school administrators: over email, conference calls, and occasionally in person. Being able to clearly and concisely communicate in writing and speech is vital to this role.
  • The ability to build trust and rapport. People buy from those they trust and like. We’re looking for someone who embodies compassion, warmth, and friendliness.
  • A desire to learn and grow. Maybe you’re always listening to a new sales podcast, or reading a new book. Whatever the case, you find genuine joy in learning and improving, demonstrated by your curiosity and willingness to explore new ideas and concepts.
  • The ability to pivot and adapt. Tutored by Teachers is a startup, and that means that what you do right now might not be exactly what you’re doing in 6 months. To succeed in this role, that should not only be expected, it should sound exciting. We’re looking for someone scrappy: someone who can dive in and start problem-solving wherever needed, and who genuinely enjoys it when solutions aren’t immediately obvious.
  • Success in sales, especially education or service-related sales. Ideally, we’re looking for someone who already has 3+ years of proven success in sales, especially if you’ve worked in edtech or (even better) in service sales—Tutored by Teachers is tech-enabled, but ultimately we’re selling tutoring services, which can be different than selling SaaS. However, we most value candidates who are quick on their feet and motivated to learn and develop, so if you tick the other boxes but don’t have as much sales experience as desired, please apply anyway.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Business, Education, or a related field.
  • Experience working remotely or in a virtual sales environment. Working remotely is incredibly fulfilling, but can be a tricky transition to make at first. Ideally, you'll have some experience with remote work.
  • A passion for education and closing the opportunity gap. We believe passionately in our mission to ensure that every child has the resources they need to succeed. We want every one of our employees to believe in that mission, too.

What can you expect in your first year?

Within 1 month

  • Gain a thorough understanding of Tutored by Teachers' services and value proposition.
  • Sit in on as many sales calls with our existing AEs as possible.
  • Begin identifying potential opportunities for partnership.

Within 3 months

  • Develop a pipeline of leads and begin actively nurturing those leads.
  • Actively engage with school administrators to understand their needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop customized solutions and proposals for prospective clients.

Within 6 months

  • Secure new partnerships with school districts, exceeding initial sales targets.
  • Establish yourself as a trusted advisor to school administrators, providing valuable insights and support.

And beyond

  • Continuously expand and strengthen relationships with existing clients, identifying opportunities for upselling and expansion.
  • Play a key role in driving the growth and success of Tutored by Teachers, contributing to our mission of advancing educational equity.

Benefits

  • 100% healthcare coverage for you and your family
  • Access to 401k to help save for the future
  • Well-rounded wellness benefits, including access to free and low cost mental health resources and support services
  • Fully remote work environment and a flexible schedule
  • Annual in-person team retreats
  • Unlimited vacation policy to help recharge
  • The chance to make a meaningful impact on students' lives and contribute to the advancement of educational equity

jobs.description:
Desafío Élite: Desarrollador Web Senior (.NET) para Escalar Sistemas de Misión Crítica

Ubicación/Modalidad: Remoto (Con opción de movilización a Costa Rica según necesidades del proyecto).

Tu rol/misión en la Empresa: Actuar como ingeniero experto sobre la plataforma Microsoft (.NET) para el análisis, diseño, mantenimiento evolutivo y desarrollo de nuevos módulos y aplicaciones distribuidas de alta disponibilidad, integradas en ecosistemas de gran escala.

¿Quiénes somos en Initium Software?

En Initium Software no somos una consultora tradicional; somos socios estratégicos que creemos en el impacto real a través de la tecnología. Conectamos al mejor talento técnico con los proyectos de ingeniería más desafiantes e innovadores del mercado. No buscamos programadores pasivos; buscamos profesionales de alto desempeño que deseen integrarse a una línea de servicio de vanguardia especializada en Tecnologías Microsoft, bajo un modelo de staff augmentation por demanda para un gran concurso estipulado a 4 años de ejecución.

Tu Misión (Tus desafíos y responsabilidades)

Como referente técnico del equipo, tu día a día estará impulsado por el propósito y el impacto sistémico a través de las siguientes actividades:

  • Diseñar y Construir: Ejecutar el ciclo completo de desarrollo (análisis, diseño, código, mantenimiento e implementación) de requerimientos complejos tanto en aplicaciones web maduras como en arquitecturas totalmente nuevas.
  • Garantizar la Continuidad: Atender con excelencia técnica y agilidad incidentes y requerimientos del cliente final bajo ventanas de servicio críticas (atención 7x24x365 según el rol asignado).
  • Orquestar con Agilidad: Gestionar tareas, estados y evidencias de ingeniería de software utilizando la herramienta institucional líder del cliente (Azure DevOps Services).
  • Cultura de Ingeniería: Documentar con rigurosidad técnica cada entregable y proveer código robusto que asegure una garantía técnica de 6 meses por paquete recibido conforme.
  • Sincronía Estratégica: Alinear tus entregables para el cumplimiento mensual de los objetivos de eficiencia de los proyectos, asegurando que la arquitectura web responda directamente a los planes estratégicos de Initium.

Tu Arsenal (¿Qué buscamos en ti?)

Este rol requiere un perfil de ingeniería senior integral, respaldado por títulos formales, certificaciones internacionales vigentes y verificables en línea, y un dominio técnico intachable.

1. Requisitos Académicos y Legales (Imprescindibles)

  • Titulación: Bachillerato universitario mínimo en una carrera de Ciencias de la Computación (deberá aportarse copia certificada o copia simple para personal extranjero en primera etapa).
  • Idioma: Español nativo o nivel alto (lectura, escritura y conversación fluida), ya que el 100% de la documentación y el servicio se ejecutan en este idioma.
  • Historial Limpio: Capacidad absoluta para aportar hoja de certificación de no poseer antecedentes ni causas penales abiertas (apostillada/consularizada si resides fuera de Costa Rica).(máximo 2 meses de emitida)

2. Certificaciones Obligatorias (Vigentes y Verificables en Línea)

Deberás adjuntar el enlace o código de validación de los siguientes fabricantes:

  • Scrum: Certificaciones aceptadas: Scrum Foundations Professional Certificate, SFC, Scrum Foundations, Scrum Open Assessment, ICP, SMC o superiores equivalentes.
  • DevOps:DevOps Foundation, DASA DevOps Fundamentals, DEPC o superior equivalente.
  • Microsoft Azure:AZ-900 o AZ-204, o superiores equivalentes verificables directamente con Microsoft.

3. Experiencia Comprobada en Producción

  • Mínimo 3 años comprobados en desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones web dentro de los últimos 3 años anteriores. (Es indispensable que las fechas no tengan vacíos y se puedan detallar de forma exacta los meses de uso por herramienta).
  • Mínimo 1 proyecto en producción activa ejecutado y liberado con éxito dentro de los últimos 3 años previos, con datos completamente verificables del cliente.
  • Referencias: Mínimo 2 referencias laborales con contacto telefónico y correo electrónico activos y confirmados (esenciales para el proceso de validación en 2 días hábiles).

4. Stack Tecnológico Requerido (Tu Caja de Herramientas)

Deberás demostrar experiencia práctica acumulada en los siguientes entornos (indicando meses de uso por tecnología):

  • Backend & Frameworks: C# avanzado con Visual Studio (versiones 2008 a 2026 o superior); .NET Framework, .NET Core y .NET versiones 5, 6, 7, 8 o superiores.
  • Frontend & Web: HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, TypeScript, React, AngularJS / Angular 8 o superior, Web Responsive y JSON.
  • APIs & Arquitectura: Web API / REST API, WCF, Web Services, Workflow Foundation. Prácticas de diseño bajo TDD (Test-Driven Development) y principios SOLID. Arquitecturas Web, MVC y Aplicaciones Distribuidas.
  • Bases de Datos: SQL Server (2008 a 2022 o superior), T-SQL avanzado, SSMS, optimización de queries y procedimientos, así como la suite de BI clásica: SSIS, SSRS y SSAS.
  • DevOps & Servidores: IIS (8.5/10 o superior), Git/GitHub y entornos de automatización con Azure DevOps Services.
  • Ecosistema Cloud & Identidad: Servicios nativos de Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Active Directory (AD), AD FS y Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Opcionales (Deseables según asignación de proyecto): Java 8 o superior, Kotlin.

¿Cómo mediremos tu impacto?

En Initium valoramos la meritocracia y los objetivos claros. Tu éxito será evaluado mediante:

  • Cumplimiento mensual estricto de los objetivos de eficiencia en los proyectos asignados.
  • Alineación y ejecución efectiva de la arquitectura de software respecto al plan estratégico del cliente final.
  • Resolución óptima de incidentes dentro de los niveles de servicio (SLA) acordados en las ventanas de atención.

¿Qué te ofrecemos? (Beneficios que marcan la diferencia)

  • Estabilidad a Largo Plazo: Proyecto de gran envergadura con una duración estimada de 4 años.
  • Compensación Profesional: Salario fijo negociable, estructurado de forma competitiva según el cumplimiento directo de tu perfil y tu desempeño en la entrevista técnica.
  • Flexibilidad Global: Modalidad 100% remota con una cultura corporativa fundamentada en la autonomía, la colaboración activa y el dinamismo.
  • Entorno de Alto Rendimiento: Un espacio donde se celebra tu iniciativa, se documenta el éxito, se reconoce tu impacto en sistemas de misión crítica y se te desafía a evolucionar continuamente junto a otros ingenieros de élite.

"En Initium no solo desarrollamos tecnología: creamos un entorno donde las personas pueden evolucionar, aportar valor y dejar huella."

Alertas del Proceso de Selección (Lectura Obligatoria para Postulantes)

  1. Evaluación en 2 Etapas: Al postularte, afrontarás primero una rigurosa revisión documental y validación técnica por parte del equipo interno de Initium (Verificación de la Matriz de Cumplimiento contra tu CV). Los perfiles aprobados pasarán directamente a la entrevista de defensa técnica con el cliente final. Debe existir disponibilidad inmediata para ambas fases.
  2. Trazabilidad Absoluta: Tu nombre, número de identificación, fechas de proyectos (mes/año) y tecnologías declaradas deben coincidir de forma exacta y matemática entre tu CV, títulos, certificaciones y referencias laborales, sin ningún tipo de vacío cronológico.
  3. Fe de Juramento: La experiencia técnica declarada se formaliza mediante una declaración jurada individual. Exigimos transparencia radical: declare únicamente experiencia real y verificable.

¡Llegó el momento de dejar huella!

Si buscas un escenario donde tu código dicte el comportamiento de plataformas críticas, donde tu arsenal de tecnologías Microsoft se potencie al máximo y tu rigurosidad técnica sea valorada, este es tu lugar.

Aplica ahora y hablemos del futuro que puedes construir. Envíanos tu expediente digital completo (Hoja de vida detallada con meses/tecnologías por proyecto, copias de certificaciones vigentes con enlace de validación, copia de título y matriz técnica) a nuestro canal oficial de reclutamiento o postula mediante este enlace.

¡Hablemos de tu próximo gran hito en Initium Software!

Willkommen in der Welt der medizinischen Innovationen!

Bei Mesalvo geht es nicht nur um Technologie – es geht um Menschen, um Fortschritt und um die Verbesserung der Gesundheitsversorgung für alle. Wir sind ein Unternehmen, das von der Leidenschaft für Gesundheit und modernste Technologien angetrieben wird. Unsere Vision ist klar: ein maßgeschneidertes, digitales Gesundheitsmanagement, das den Klinikalltag erleichtert.

Unsere Geschichte begann 2021, als wir fünf renommierte Unternehmen der Health Care IT-Branche unter einem Dach vereinten. Diese Fusion brachte nicht nur verschiedene Expertisen und Werte, sondern auch 460+ hochmotivierte Mitarbeitende an insgesamt 7 Standorten in Deutschland, Belgien und Spanien zusammen.

Klingt das nach einem Umfeld, in dem du dich entfalten möchtest?   • Du wirkst aktiv am Neuaufbau und der Weiterentwicklung der Cortexplattform mitDu sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme höchsten Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Datenschutz und Kosteneffizienz gerecht werden

  • Du bringst idealerweise Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Krankenhausinformationssystemen mit
  • Du kommunizierst sicher in Deutsch und Englisch

Unser Angebot als Arbeitgeber

Unser Herz schlägt für IT und wir leben Diversity
