jobs.title: Application Architect
jobs.excerpt: At Polaris Inc. , we have fun doing what we love by driving change and innovation.
jobs.description:
At Polaris Inc., we have fun doing what we love by driving change and innovation. We empower employees to take on challenging assignments and roles with an elevated level of responsibility in our agile working environment. Our people make us who we are, and we create incredible products and experiences that empower us to THINK OUTSIDE.

Position Overview:

Polaris is seeking an Application Architect to provide architecture leadership for backend services and APIs supporting digital and connected-vehicle experiences (i.e. Polaris Ride Command). You will guide the design and evolution of scalable, secure, resilient, and high-performing applications built primarily with C#/.NET and AWS, while collaborating across mobile, web, data, integration, and connected-vehicle platforms. This role partners with application, solution, and enterprise architects, engineering teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to align solutions with enterprise standards and make pragmatic modernization decisions. The position offers the opportunity to shape the long-term direction of a high-volume services and vehicle-data platform while addressing monolithic architecture, distributed systems, and event-streaming complexities.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own application architecture direction for cloud-based backend services and APIs, including a multi-year roadmap that supports vehicle growth, increasing data volumes, and evolving system integrations.
  • Assess existing monolithic and distributed applications and recommend pragmatic strategies for modernization, simplification, consolidation, decomposition, service boundaries, and incremental delivery.
  • Design and evolve scalable, secure, resilient, highly available applications using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, AWS, RESTful APIs, distributed-system patterns, asynchronous messaging, and event-driven architectures.
  • Evaluate architectural options and trade-offs across modular architectures, microservices, synchronous APIs, messaging, streaming, relational and NoSQL databases, distributed caching, and search technologies.
  • Provide architectural direction for Kafka, Confluent, and related vehicle-telemetry enrichment pipelines, including platform scalability, reliability, operability, data use, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure application designs incorporate appropriate security, authentication, authorization, data protection, secure configuration, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, performance, resiliency, and fault tolerance.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, create architecture decision records and solution blueprints, and clearly communicate technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance and mentorship to engineering teams, including reviewing code and designs, challenging technical approaches, troubleshooting complex production issues, and supporting continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with product owners, engineering teams, integration teams, Application Architects, Solution Architects, Enterprise Architects, and other stakeholders within established architecture guardrails and technology strategies.
  • Promote responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot for codebase analysis, modernization, development, testing, documentation, and code review, with appropriate human validation, security, and maintainability controls.
  • Identify and reduce technical debt, software obsolescence, architectural complexity, duplicated capabilities, security vulnerabilities, and operational inefficiencies across deployed solutions.
  • Research emerging technologies and development practices, evaluate their applicability, and maintain architecture diagrams, technical standards, solution documentation, and support materials.

Desired Competencies:

  • Leadership: You inspire, guide, and empower others to achieve their best by setting clear direction, fostering trust, and creating an environment where people feel supported, motivated, and accountable for delivering results.
  • Critical Thinking: You analyze information objectively, evaluate options, and apply sound judgment to solve problems and make informed decisions.
  • Communication: You clearly convey information, ideas, and expectations to diverse audiences, adjusting your message to ensure understanding and alignment.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of software or application design and development experience, including deep hands-on expertise architecting and developing C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and REST API-based services in enterprise production environments.
  • 2+ years of experience in an Application Architect or comparable technical architecture role.
  • Proven experience designing scalable, resilient, cloud-native applications using AWS and supporting high-volume, highly available, customer-facing production systems.
  • Deep knowledge of distributed application architecture, including modular architectures, microservices, APIs, service boundaries, application integration, asynchronous messaging, event streaming, and the associated technical trade-offs.
  • Demonstrated experience assessing and modernizing monolithic and distributed applications, defining service and API boundaries, reducing technical debt and duplicated capabilities, and delivering incremental change without disrupting active product delivery.
  • Experience designing and governing application architectures within enterprise architecture standards, API guidelines, reference patterns, architecture decision records, and engineering best practices across multiple applications or teams.
  • Working knowledge of relational and NoSQL data technologies, data-access patterns, containerized delivery, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated quality gates, and modern DevOps practices.
  • Strong knowledge of application security and observability practices, including authentication, authorization, secure configuration, data protection, structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, service health monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to create and communicate architecture diagrams, technical documentation, solution designs, and architectural decisions and trade-offs for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot for codebase analysis, development, modernization, testing, documentation, and code review with appropriate human validation.
  • Experience with Kafka, Confluent or comparable event-driven streaming platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with IoT, connected-device, vehicle telemetry, or comparable high-volume event-driven systems.
  • Familiarity with telemetry-driven solutions, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch, AWS Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, S3, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or OpenTelemetry is preferred.
  • Remote based role. Candidate must be US-based and able to travel to Polaris locations based on business need
    ​

The starting pay range for Minnesota is $150,000 to $175,000 per year. Individual salaries and positioning within the range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills, and geography. While individual pay could fall anywhere in the range based on these factors, it is not common to start at the high end or top of the range.

#REMOTE

To qualify for this position, former employees must be eligible for rehire, and current employees must be in good standing.

We are an ambitious, resourceful, and driven workforce, which empowers us to THINK OUTSIDE.Apply today!

At Polaris we put our employees first, by offering a holistic approach to their health and financial wellbeing. Polaris is proud to offer competitive compensation, including a market-leading profit-sharing plan that is fundamental to our pay-for-performance culture. At Polaris, employees are owners of the company through company contributions to our Employee Stock Ownership Plan and discounted employee stock purchases plan. Employees receive a generous matching contribution to 401(k), financial wellness education and consultation to plan for their financial future. In addition to competitive pay, Polaris provides a comprehensive suite of benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance, wellness programs, paid time off, gym & personal training reimbursement, life insurance and disability offerings. Through the Polaris Foundation and our Polaris Gives paid volunteer time off, we support employees who actively volunteer their time, efforts, and passions to improve the health and wellbeing of the communities in which they live, play and work. Employees at Polaris drive our success and are rewarded for their commitment.

About Polaris

As the global leader in powersports, Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII) pioneers product breakthroughs and enriching experiences and services that have invited people to discover the joy of being outdoors since our founding in 1954. Polaris' high-quality product line-up includes the Polaris RANGER®, RZR® and Polaris GENERAL™ side-by-side off-road vehicles; Sportsman® all-terrain off-road vehicles; military and commercial off-road vehicles; snowmobiles; Slingshot® moto-roadsters; Aixam quadricycles; Goupil electric vehicles; and pontoon and deck boats, including industry-leading Bennington pontoons. Polaris enhances the riding experience with a robust portfolio of parts, garments, and accessories. Proudly headquartered in Minnesota, Polaris serves more than 100 countries across the globe.

Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte :

Au sein d’une équipe technique dédiée, vous contribuez à la modernisation d’une plateforme SaaS de télérelève exploitée en production et traitant une forte volumétrie de données en séries temporelles.

Missions :

Avec l’appui du lead technique, vous prenez en charge vos chantiers du cadrage technique jusqu’à la mise en production :

  • Refondre progressivement les mécanismes d’export et de reporting à destination de systèmes tiers.
  • Optimiser les requêtes SQL et les traitements de masse, en mesurant et en documentant les gains obtenus.
  • Mettre en place une couche ORM sur l’existant, en maîtrisant ses impacts sur les performances.
  • Moderniser le code legacy : remise sous tests, suppression du code mort et réduction de la dette technique.
  • Contribuer à la migration progressive des clients vers le socle cible.
  • Conteneuriser les services et les intégrer aux chaînes CI/CD.
  • Mettre en place l’observabilité applicative pour faciliter le suivi et le diagnostic en production.
  • Développer et maintenir les tests unitaires et d’intégration.

Compétences attendues :

1. Indispensables :

  • Maîtrise confirmée de C# et .NET.
  • Solides compétences en SQL, PostgreSQL et utilisation d’ORM.
  • Expérience des traitements batch, des chaînes d’export et du messaging avec RabbitMQ.
  • Expérience d’applications à forte volumétrie, avec une exposition réelle à la production.
  • Expérience d’une modernisation de système legacy sans réécriture globale.
  • Capacité à démontrer des optimisations de requêtes par des mesures avant/après.

2. Compétences complémentaires appréciées :

  • Expérience en conteneurisation, CI/CD et observabilité.
  • Appétence pour approfondir les sujets d’industrialisation et de plateforme.

Livrables attendus :

  • Évolutions et refontes livrées par incréments, accompagnées de tests unitaires et d’intégration.
  • Améliorations de performance documentées et mesurées avant/après.
  • Services conteneurisés, instrumentés et intégrés aux chaînes CI/CD.

Expertise souhaitée

Profil recherché :

Vous savez comprendre un existant avant de le faire évoluer et privilégiez des changements progressifs, testés et maîtrisés. Vous assumez les travaux de maintenance et de nettoyage nécessaires à la pérennité du code.
Votre approche de la performance repose sur la mesure. Vous êtes capable d’expliquer vos choix techniques, de documenter leurs résultats et de prendre en charge vos développements jusqu’à leur mise en production.
Si vous utilisez l’IA générative dans votre travail, vous en gardez une lecture critique et restez responsable de la compréhension, de la validation et de la qualité du code produit.

Non renseigné

jobs.description:
Position: Chief Revenue Officer

Company: Solen Software Group

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: US, Canada, UK

About Solen Software Group

Solen Software Group is an evergreen holding company that acquires and operates proven software businesses that have significant growth potential in a variety of vertical markets, enabling them to be market leaders in their niche industry. Solen owns several software companies in various market spaces: Human Resource Technology, Fleet Telematics, Asset Management, E-Health, Document Management, and other innovative software solutions in a variety of industries. Solen is backed by a group of advisors and investors that have built software businesses of material scale (10-100M in ARR) and advised many.

About The Role

The Chief Revenue Officer will own revenue growth across Solen's Hyper Growth Portfolio, starting hands-on at our anchor portfolio company, the fastest-growing business in the portfolio, and then scaling a proven go-to-market playbook across additional Portfolio Companies.

This role is responsible for building an engineered, predictable sales machine on a common RevOps stack, accelerating organic ARR growth, launching new sources of revenue, and making AI the default across every revenue function. The CRO will recruit and lead GTM leadership across sales, marketing, and customer success, and partner closely with portfolio company CEOs and founders.

This is a highly strategic, hands-on leadership role for a vertical-agnostic operator who builds systems, not heroics.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Growth

  • Accelerate organic ARR growth above target at the anchor portfolio company, then roll the same playbook out to other Portfolio Companies in scope.
  • Own pipeline coverage, net revenue retention (NRR), gross revenue retention (GRR), and CAC payback across the Portfolio Companies in scope.
  • Balance growth with efficiency, using Rule of 40 as a portfolio guardrail.
  • Lead Monthly Business Reviews on revenue performance with portfolio leadership.

Growth Opportunities

  • Identify, size, and launch new sources of revenue, each backed by an approved ROI case.
  • Drive internal growth through cross-sell and referral motions between Solen Portfolio Companies, upsell and expansion, and pricing and packaging improvements.
  • Drive external growth through new customer segments, channels, partnerships, and markets.
  • Track each new motion as a separate revenue source in the CRM from launch.

Engineered Sales Machine & RevOps

  • Build a vertical-agnostic Solen go-to-market playbook covering ICP and segmentation, sales stages, pricing guardrails, compensation plans, and forecasting cadence.
  • Stand up a common RevOps stack so every Portfolio Company in scope runs the same stages, metrics, and forecast cadence in one system.
  • Prove the playbook at the anchor portfolio company, then roll it out to additional Portfolio Companies, shortening rollout time with each one.
  • Deliver accurate forecasts and keep sales and marketing spend within plan.

AI-Driven Go-to-Market

  • Make AI the default across prospecting, lead scoring, deal coaching, forecasting, renewals, and customer success.
  • Raise revenue per GTM employee at each Portfolio Company while ARR grows at or above target.
  • Build a shared AI GTM toolkit on the Solen RevOps stack that is reused across Portfolio Companies rather than rebuilt in each one.

Talent Density

  • Own recruitment and development of GTM leadership (sales, marketing, and customer success leaders) across the Portfolio Companies in scope, with a reporting line to the CRO.
  • Place A-Players in Key Seats and apply the Unlock, Replace, Redeploy, Expand, and Duplicate framework.
  • Improve quota attainment and reduce new-rep ramp time through coaching, enablement, and process.
  • Lead portfolio company CEOs and founders through influence as well as authority.

What We're Looking For

  • Builds sales machines, not heroics: You work hands-on first, then design the process, compensation, metrics, and tooling that make revenue predictable and repeatable across companies. You have proven this in more than one company.
  • Efficient growth operator: You have a track record of hitting ARR growth targets while improving NRR, GRR, and CAC payback in B2B SaaS.
  • Growth hunter: You find and size new growth opportunities, inside and outside a portfolio, and back each with an ROI case.
  • Vertical-agnostic operator: You learn a new market fast and run one playbook across different businesses, adapting only where it matters.
  • Data- and AI-native: You run the business from the numbers and are an early, practical adopter of AI and RevOps tooling that makes revenue teams measurably more productive.
  • Talent magnet and multi-company leader: You recruit, coach, and retain A-player GTM leaders, hold a high bar across several companies at once, and win the support of CEOs and founders.
  • Lives the Solen-isms: You operate by the Solen-isms and the Solen Principles of Transformation.

What Success Looks Like

  • Organic ARR growth at the anchor portfolio company accelerates above target within 12–18 months.
  • Portfolio Companies in scope deliver 20%+ annual organic ARR growth, with NRR ≥ 110%, GRR ≥ 90%, CAC payback ≤ 18 months, and a Rule of 40 score ≥ 45.
  • Within 18 months, 15%+ of new ARR across the Portfolio Companies in scope comes from new growth motions.
  • The Solen GTM playbook is proven at the anchor company within 6 months and rolled out to at least 3 more Portfolio Companies within 18 months, with rollout time falling from 6 to 4 to 3 months.
  • Forecast accuracy is within ±10%, and sales and marketing spend stays within plan.
  • Revenue per GTM employee rises 25%+ within 18 months, powered by a shared AI GTM toolkit.
  • GTM Talent Density reaches 90%+, with 70%+ of quota-carrying reps at or above plan and new-rep ramp time down 25%+.

Solen-isms (How We Operate)

  • Ownership Mindset: We own the mission. We don't wait to be told. We lead, fix, and build as if it were ours. When problems arise, we run toward them, not away.
  • Benchmark to Best: We seek out excellence. We measure ourselves against the best and adapt quickly, always looking for the edge that moves us forward.
  • Openly Self-Critical: Leaders go first: they surface their misses early, ask for direct feedback, and turn “game film” into better decisions and better systems.
  • Disagree & Commit: Leaders disagree openly and constructively, regardless of title or tenure, because truth is how we avoid bureaucracy and benchmark to best.
  • Figureitoutiveness: Embracing challenges, fostering growth, and taking initiative, leaders thrive on hard work and high failure tolerance.
  • Mutual Elevation: Committed to growth, elevating teams, developing future leaders, and removing barriers to mastery and joy.
  • Learn-it-alls: Learn-it-alls, not know-it-alls, embracing failure as part of growth and progress.
  • Pioneering: Pioneering driven by opportunity, using first principles thinking and unbound by tradition or rules.
  • Will to Win: Leaders relentlessly pursue potential, reject mediocrity, and get what they tolerate.
  • Dialectical: We learn through conversation. We ask, listen, question, and evolve — valuing disagreement as a tool for alignment and deeper understanding.
  • Frugality: Achieving more with less, focusing on quality, long-term value, and company-wide responsibility.
  • Candor: We communicate with integrity, transparency, and respect in all conversations.
  • Kaizen: Kaizen is continuous improvement as a way of life. Leaders make hundreds of small upgrades that compound, turning lessons into standards and standards into durable systems.

Recruitment Disclaimer

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

What makes you stand out:

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Responsibilities

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

The Associate Cloud Engineer is responsible for supporting Azure and AWS environments, with a focus on pre-production connectivity, installation readiness, and first-line troubleshooting for Managed Services customers.

This role will act as the frontline contact with Cloud Products during pre-sales, pre-implementation and post-sales activities, working closely with application, security, and platform teams to keep environments reliable and production-ready. The role develops technical skills through training and senior-engineer guidance, with complex issues escalated to the appropriate teams. This role may require participation in an on-call rotation following training, with senior escalation support.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the first point of contact for Managed Services connectivity, troubleshooting, production issues across assigned environments and escalating high complexity challenges as appropriate.
  • Support Azure and AWS installation readiness by gathering project requirements, access details, customer dependencies and outstanding actions before implementation.
  • Coordinate with Cloud Products and project teams to clarify customer requirements, confirm agreed service scope and track technical actions through pre-sales, pre-implementation and post-sales handoffs.
  • Support pre-production networking and connectivity checks, including DNS, firewall rules, VPN connections and load balancers, using approved procedures and senior-engineer guidance.
  • Support integrations between Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) and client-facing dependencies, including storage, databases, messaging, DNS resolution, firewall rules, private endpoints, and service connectivity.
  • Support secure environments through approved access, configuration and change-management procedures.
  • Coordinate installation change requests for Change Advisory Board (CAB) review including, but not limited to, gathering the business need, scope, risk, implementation, validation and rollback details. Confirm CAB review and required change(s) with the change owner, track approvals before work proceeds and confirm completion afterward.
  • Support approved deployment and installation activities, including readiness checks and follow-up on missing requirements or approvals, under senior-engineer guidance.
  • Use observability tools, including Azure Monitor, Amazon CloudWatch and Elastic/Kibana, to review alerts, logs and application health for assigned systems.
  • Collaborate with application and cloud teams to investigate issues spanning Smile CDR, related Smile Digital Health applications and dependent services (database, messaging, network). Follow approved runbooks and escalate unresolved issues.
  • Provide first-response support for cloud and application incidents including, but not limited to, gathering detailed troubleshooting logs, timestamps, request identifiers, customer impact and steps taken, following data-handling policies, and communicating progress through resolution or accepted escalation.

Requirements:

  • 1-3+ years of experience in technical support, cloud operations or systems administration. Hands-on projects, coursework or internships may be considered in level of experience.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or similar and/or equivalent working experience.
  • Strong continuous learning mindset for technical knowledge specifically Azure, AWS and Smile applications.
  • Fundamental knowledge of operating systems, networking, storage and access controls.
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking concepts and hands-on experience troubleshooting connectivity issues.
  • Demonstrated experience understanding and executing runbooks, collecting diagnostic evidence with ability to identify when to escalate complex issues.
  • Exposure to Azure or AWS services and troubleshooting network-layer dependencies (DNS, firewall, private endpoints), including but not limited to, lab and/or academic project experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to be both self-driven and partner effectively across technical and non-technical cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to convey technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles, with practical exposure to Terraform preferred.
  • Basic understanding of Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD tooling, preferred.
  • Experience reviewing logs and alerts using monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor, Amazon CloudWatch or Elastic/Kibana, preferred.
  • Demonstrated scripting skills in Bash, Python or PowerShell, preferred.
  • Associate Azure or AWS certification or in progress, preferred.

jobs.title: Senior FinOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Ensono, our purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and enabling our clients to Do Great Things.
jobs.description:
At Ensono, our purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and enabling our clients to Do Great Things. As a trusted technology adviser and managed services provider, we help clients navigate continuous change and embrace innovation. We deliver world-class transformational services across hybrid cloud, infrastructure, mainframe, data, IdAM, and cloud-native solutions, simplifying complex business challenges and creating new pathways to success. Headquartered in the USA and backed by private equity, Ensono has a strong track record in the UK and Europe, with growth plans built on trusted partnerships and deep industry expertise.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior FinOps Engineer to join our growing SRE and Cloud Services team and help deliver a consistent, outcome-focused FinOps-as-a-Service capability. This is a foundational role in building and scaling our FinOps-as-a-Service offering across enterprise clients. You will combine hands-on cloud cost engineering, governance, reporting and stakeholder engagement to improve cost visibility, accountability and value from cloud investment. Working within each client’s environment and toolchain, you will partner with engineering, SRE, finance and business stakeholders to prioritise achievable outcomes, deliver recommendations and implementation-as-code, and maintain clear client approval for production changes and commercial commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Optimise

  • Create and maintain an opportunity register that records each optimisation opportunity, estimated value, implementation effort, status and realised benefit;
  • Perform rightsizing analysis of compute, database and storage resources using observed utilisation, performance and service requirements;
  • Model Reserved Instance and Savings Plan coverage and utilisation, presenting evidence-based recommendations while recognising that commitment purchases remain the client’s decision;
  • Participate in architecture and solution reviews, providing cost models, options and trade-offs for proposed cloud services;
  • Identify idle, orphaned and unattached resources and recommend safe, prioritised remediation;
  • Submit optimisation changes, including storage lifecycle and tiering controls, as pull requests to client Infrastructure-as-Code repositories with cost analysis; validate in non-production where available and promote only following client approval.

Govern

  • Define and maintain an Infrastructure-as-Code-aligned tagging taxonomy and supporting policies; monitor tagging compliance and manage remediation exceptions;
  • Develop reusable policy-as-code modules and cost gates for client delivery pipelines;
  • Establish anomaly detection and route alerts into agreed incident workflows; triage anomalies, coordinate investigation and record dispositions;
  • Own budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis, including billing reconciliation and agreed baselines;
  • Apply proportionate financial governance controls that respect client approval, risk and change-management requirements.

Enable

  • Build and maintain cost, allocation and unit-economics dashboards using agreed business measures;
  • Deliver showback and chargeback reporting, with clear attribution of cost and consumption;
  • Participate in sprint and planning ceremonies, jointly prioritising work within available capacity, surfacing trade-offs and agreeing delivery and reporting cadence;
  • Create and maintain a joint FinOps roadmap, tracking priorities, dependencies, outcomes and progress;
  • Provide knowledge transfer and present the current cost position, optimisation activity, realised savings and roadmap progress to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Engage

  • Lead operational onboarding by establishing access to the client environment, billing and cost APIs or exports, and delivery toolchain; assess the current cost position, utilisation, commitment coverage and tagging quality; agree priorities and cadence; and establish initial reporting;
  • Work inside client toolchains and governance processes, collaborating through pull requests and evidence-based cost analysis rather than making unilateral production changes;
  • Own agreed monthly reporting covering cost and usage variance, allocation, unit economics, optimisation activity and realised savings, budget and forecast variance, anomaly dispositions, tagging compliance and billing reconciliation, plus quarterly commitment coverage and utilisation reviews;
  • Act as a trusted adviser and coordinate with Ensono SRE and other services. Deliver recommendations and implementation-as-code within scope, make client approval and prioritisation explicit, and communicate that savings depend on client decisions, implementation and usage.

What You Will Bring to Ensono

Must-Have

  • Demonstrable senior-level experience delivering an operational FinOps or cloud economics service, including onboarding new client environments and establishing repeatable delivery;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure billing and cost management, including cost exports or APIs, Azure Cost Management, Azure Advisor and Azure Monitor;
  • Experience delivering Infrastructure-as-Code changes through client repositories and CI/CD pipelines, including pull requests, cost analysis, peer review and non-production validation;
  • Strong understanding of cloud pricing, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and commitment coverage and utilisation modelling;
  • Experience maintaining opportunity registers, estimating value and effort, and tracking realised benefits without over-stating or guaranteeing savings;
  • Strong capability in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, allocation, showback or chargeback, and billing reconciliation;
  • Experience with tagging compliance, policy-as-code, cost gates, anomaly detection and operational triage;
  • Ability to create clear cost and unit-economics dashboards and present service performance to technical, financial and business stakeholders;
  • Proven client-facing communication and consultancy skills, with the ability to manage prioritised outcomes within proportional capacity and surface delivery trade-offs.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with AWS cost management (Cost Explorer, Trusted Advisor, Compute Optimizer);
  • Experience with GCP billing and cost optimisation;
  • FinOps Foundation certification (FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Professional);
  • Experience with FinOps platforms such as CloudHealth, Apptio Cloudability, Kubecost or native cloud cost tools;
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes cost management and container rightsizing;
  • Understanding of unit economics and the ability to report cost against business measures;
  • Experience building dashboards and reporting using tools such as Power BI, Grafana or Looker;
  • Cloud certifications (Azure, AWS or GCP) at associate level or above.

What We Can Offer You

We are a people-first business, which means people are at the heart of everything we do here. We offer our associates a safe environment where learning, knowledge sharing, and open communication is encouraged.

We believe that great work deserves great rewards. In return for your ideas, commitment and ambition, we'll give you a very competitive base salary and a range of benefits as soon as you join. On top of your highly competitive base salary, we offer:

  • Flexible and remote work opportunities
  • Performance bonus
  • Training and development programs
  • Worldwide career opportunities
  • Community outreach and mentoring opportunities
  • Learning platforms
  • My Benefit system
  • Wellness Platform support from Virgin Pulse
  • Associate equity program
  • Life insurance
  • Lunch card
  • Study leave
  • One paid day off for charity events
  • Sabbatical
  • Extended parental leave
  • Rental or co-financing of office equipment
  • Referral bonus program

jobs.excerpt: About MISUMI AmericasMISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions.
jobs.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

About Compass

Compass is a new venture incubated within MISUMI Americas. We’re building it with the deep manufacturing expertise of Fictiv, MISUMI’s digital manufacturing platform.

Every physical product starts as a CAD model, and most of what it will cost is decided right there. Yet cost and manufacturability are still checked after the drawings are released, by hand and in spreadsheets, when every change is slow and expensive. The result is redesigns, missed schedules, and money left on the factory floor. Compass fixes that at the source. An engineer uploads an assembly, and Compass reads every part the way an expert manufacturing engineer would. It checks each feature against the processes that could make it, prices the part at the volume that matters, reads tolerances and GD&T straight off the drawing, and ranks exactly what to change. It does this across the entire bill of materials, reruns on every revision, and learns from every correction engineers make.

The problems underneath are genuinely hard: making sense of real-world geometry, modeling cost across machining, casting, molding, sheet metal, and additive, interpreting engineering drawings, and building AI that gets measurably better from expert feedback. The stakes are real, too. Our customers are enterprise engineering teams, including aerospace and defense programs, where the platform has to be as secure and trustworthy as it is smart. Compass is a small team that moves fast and gives engineers real ownership. You won’t inherit a finished system. You’ll help define the architecture, the security foundation, and the product that the most demanding customers in manufacturing will rely on.

About the Role

We’re looking for a cross-functional software engineer who thrives at the intersection of application development and cloud infrastructure. We’re scaling the product, fast-tracking SOC 2 Type I and Type II, and building an ITAR-ready environment for aerospace and defense customers. You’ll be one of the engineers who makes all three happen.

We don’t need a pure DevOps specialist managing servers all day. We need an engineer who treats infrastructure as code, automates our cloud environment to satisfy security audits, and writes clean application code to ship features customers use.

You’ll own our AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. In your first months, much of your time will go to building our compliance foundation. Over time, the role settles into roughly 30% platform automation and 70% full-stack feature development.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Accelerate SOC 2 compliance. Work with leadership to implement, automate, and maintain the AWS security controls SOC 2 requires: encryption at rest and in transit, least-privilege IAM, logging, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Build our ITAR environment. Help design and run an isolated AWS GovCloud environment for customers with export-controlled data, with access restricted to US persons.
  • Own the platform. Manage, monitor, and scale our AWS environment using infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or Pulumi), with no manual configuration drift.
  • Build across the stack. Design, write, and deploy maintainable backend APIs and frontend features for our core product.
  • Automate everything. Maintain CI/CD pipelines (such as GitHub Actions) with automated testing, dependency scanning, and secure deployments built in.
  • Keep the architecture lean. Favor managed AWS services so the infrastructure needs minimal babysitting and you can focus on product.

Experience

  • A hybrid mindset. You’re a product-minded developer who moved toward DevOps because you wanted your code to ship faster, safer, and more securely.
  • AWS expertise. Deep hands-on experience with managed and serverless AWS services, such as Elastic Beanstalk, Lambda, RDS, SQS, Cognito, IAM, and CloudTrail.
  • Infrastructure as code. Proven experience managing cloud environments entirely through code (such as Terraform or AWS CDK) rather than the console.
  • Security and compliance experience. You’ve configured cloud environments to pass frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA. Experience with Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe is a big plus.
  • Full-stack proficiency. Strong production experience with Node.js and TypeScript, React, and PostgreSQL.
  • Startup agility. You’ve been an early engineer or on a lean team where you owned your deployments and wore multiple hats.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with queue-based background processing (SQS), PDF and CAD file processing, or LLM-backed features in production.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud, FedRAMP, NIST 800-171, or CMMC.
  • Experience supporting customers with ITAR or other export-controlled data.
  • A passion for CAD, hardware, or manufacturing.

Please Note: This role requires access to export-controlled technical data (ITAR/EAR) and controlled unclassified information. Applicants must be a U.S. person as defined under ITAR (22 CFR 120.62), or otherwise eligible for the export authorization required to access this information under applicable law. MISUMI Americas will not discriminate based on citizenship status or national origin except as required to comply with export control law.

Physical Demands

Standard office/remote work environment with extended periods of computer use, video calls, and phone work.The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K plan
  • Parental leave programs
  • Paid volunteer days
  • And much, much more!

Salary Range: $160,000 to $185,000 per year, based upon experience

Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

  • Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
  • Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
  • Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
  • Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
  • Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

Chez nesto, nous avons à cœur de remettre en question le statu quo, d'offrir une meilleure expérience hypothécaire et d'aider les Canadiens à économiser sur leur hypothèque. Nous cultivons une culture de collaboration, de transparence et de créativité, où chaque membre de l'équipe est encouragé à prendre ses projets en main, à avoir un impact concret et à évoluer.

Si vous souhaitez relever des défis stimulants et trouver des solutions à des enjeux importants aux côtés de collègues ambitieux, passionnés et toujours prêts à s'entraider, vous vous sentirez chez vous chez nesto.

Technologie et structure d'équipe

Dès le début, nous avons créé une plateforme technologique moderne et native du cloud respectant les normes les plus élevées de l'industrie en termes de processus de développement et d'exploitation. Notre interface utilisateur est écrite en TypeScript avec React et notre back-end en Go, sous forme de microservices conteneurisés docker bien découplés via des API RESTful et des files d'attente pub-sub, et isolés derrière différents portails API. Ces conteneurs sont orchestrés à l'aide de Kubernetes et instrumentés avec Datadog. Nos pipelines CI/CD sont automatisés à l'aide de Google Cloud Build et Codefresh et notre infrastructure est gérée à l'aide de Pulumi.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Collaborer et diriger des projets techniques complexes, en assurant une livraison de haute qualité et dans les délais impartis, tout en maintenant l'excellence technique.
  • Mener des initiatives visant à améliorer la qualité du code et les flux de travail, en contribuant activement aux discussions et aux présentations lors des réunions front-end.
  • Rédiger des tests automatisés et collaborer avec l'équipe QA pour garantir un code robuste et solide.
  • Tirer parti des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour améliorer les flux de travail, l'efficacité et la qualité du code.
  • Effectuer des revues de code, offrir des commentaires constructifs et fournir des conseils sur les meilleures pratiques.
  • Favoriser une culture d'excellence en ingénierie, d'inclusivité et de curiosité technique, où les ingénieurs peuvent s'épanouir et développer leurs compétences.
  • Agir en tant que mentor technique auprès des ingénieurs juniors, les aidant à développer leur expertise technique et leur parcours professionnel.

Qui nous recherchons

  • Plus de 7 ans d'expérience professionnelle en développement Front-End.
  • Vaste expérience avec TypeScript, l'écosystème React (Next.js est un plus) et les bibliothèques de gestion d'état modernes.
  • Solide expertise en CSS/SASS, les frameworks CSS modernes et les principes de conception adaptative (responsive design).
  • Expérience en optimisation et en surveillance des performances front-end.
  • Compréhension de l'architecture microservices et des modèles d'intégration d'API.
  • Capacité à anticiper l'impact sur l'entreprise et les risques techniques.
  • Capacité avérée à influencer les décisions techniques et à mener le changement, avec une expérience dans un rôle de leadership ou d'influence.
  • Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, facilitant une collaboration efficace avec les ingénieurs de tous niveaux.
  • Engagement à écrire du code de haute qualité et à améliorer continuellement les projets.
  • Solide compréhension des meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle, y compris les patrons de conception (design patterns), les méthodologies de test et les processus de développement Agile.
  • Passion pour le développement logiciel avec un historique d'apprentissage et de croissance continus.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Programme hypothécaire pour les employés : taux préférentiels exclusifs.
  • Couverture santé complète : couverture étendue de premier ordre (santé, dentaire, vision) avec couverture des médicaments à 100 %.
  • Accès à un régime d'épargne-retraite collectif REER/RPDB avec des contributions de contrepartie compétitives de l'entreprise.
  • Télémédecine et soutien familial (programmes de complément pour les congés de maternité/parentaux).
  • Lieu de travail flexible : entièrement à distance ou dans l'un de nos bureaux (Montréal, Québec, Toronto, etc.).

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Contribuez à moderniser l'industrie hypothécaire canadienne.
  • Entreprise certifiée B Corp, soulignant notre engagement social et environnemental.
  • Nous avons remporté le prix CLA du prêteur hypothécaire de l’année 2023, 2024 et 2025, qui reconnaît notre excellence en matière de services de prêt.

Diversité et inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons fermement que la créativité et la collaboration sont le fruit de la diversité. Nous sommes engagés à favoriser, à cultiver et à préserver une culture de diversité, d’équité, d’inclusion et d’appartenance, et sommes fiers d’assurer des pratiques impartiales et inclusives pour accéder à l’emploi et à la croissance professionnelle. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront pris en considération sans égard à leur âge, leur couleur, leur handicap, leur origine ethnique, l’état familial ou matrimonial, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, leur langue, leur capacité physique et mentale, leur affiliation politique, leur religion, leur orientation sexuelle, leur situation sociale, leur statut de vétéran et toutes autres caractéristiques qui rendent nos employés uniques.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff Fullstack Software Engineer for Stytch, where you'll shape the next generation of identity products.

About the job

This position is needed to help scale Stytch’s core product as we bring Stytch capabilities to Twilio’s full customer base, delivering secure, developer-first identity experiences. You’ll design and lead implementation of products that power authentication, authorization, and emerging agentic and non-human identity use cases. You’ll partner closely with product and engineering leadership to set direction, deliver high-impact features, and evolve our platform for Twilio’s scale. This is a rare chance to operate like a startup within Twilio: you’ll work in a high-ownership environment with startup speed, backed by Twilio’s reach and scale.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build and own products for Stytch’s identity platform on Twilio—shipping core authentication flows, including agentic and non-human identity use cases.
  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, reliable frontend and backend systems, optimizing for security, performance, and developer experience.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to set direction, translate customer needs into technical plans, and deliver high-impact roadmap features.
  • Collaborate across Twilio and Stytch teams to align on architecture, integrate platform capabilities, and unblock cross-team initiatives.
  • Operate with deep ownership: take features from idea to launch, author design docs, drive key product and technical decisions, review code, and stay close to what you ship.
  • Build in ambiguity—break down complex problems, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and adopt new technologies or strategies when they improve outcomes.
  • Improve production quality and resilience through strong observability, incident response and remediation.
  • Mentor and support other engineers through pairing, feedback, and knowledge-sharing, helping raise the team’s technical bar and culture.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 6+ years experience building and shipping high-quality, customer-facing web applications in production.
  • Strong experience with modern frontend technologies, including React and TypeScript.
  • Working experience with a backend language (such as Go) and RESTful API design.
  • Experience designing technical services and leading teams through implementation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related industry experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Schedule: ability to work non-standard, on-call rotation weekend and holiday hours.


Desired:

  • Familiarity with React, Typescript, HTML, CSS, Go, and DynamoDB.
  • Experience building developer tools and/or internal platforms that improve velocity and reliability.
  • Experience owning features end to end and working closely with product and design. You’ve helped decide what gets built, not just how.
  • Builder at heart. Through a hobby or your profession, you are passionate about being hands on and seeing your work come to life.

Location:

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, CT, NJ, NY, WA, PA or Washington DC area.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.


Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland (outside of the DC area), Massachusetts, Minnesota, or Vermont: $171,120 - $213,900.
  • Based in New York (outside of the New York City area), New Jersey (outside of the New York City area), Washington State (outside of the Seattle area), Washington D.C., Washington D.C. area, Maryland, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $181,200 - $226,500.
  • Based in California (within the San Francisco Bay area), New York (within the New York City area), New Jersey (within the New York City area), or Washington State (within the Seattle area): $201,280 - $301,920.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.


Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until February 1st 2027, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Job ID 9530

Life at Ness

At Ness, people come first. Here, you'll be part of a vibrant team that values curiosity, innovation, and growth. We work with industry-leading clients on projects that truly make an impact while supporting every team member in carving out their unique career path. With resources for learning, certifications, and hands-on experiences, Ness offers you more than just a job—it’s a place where your ideas, ambition, and well-being matter.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Java Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of scalable, high-performance enterprise applications. This role involves hands-on development, mentoring team members, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver robust solutions across front-end and back-end systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications using Java and modern front-end frameworks.
  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable and efficient technical solutions.
  • Write clean, efficient, and testable code aligned with development standards and best practices.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Guide junior team members by sharing technical expertise and best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver end-to-end features.
  • Ensure performance, reliability, and security of applications.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues and perform root cause analysis.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking with a results-driven mindset.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Passionate about clean code, performance optimization, and software quality.
  • Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

Core Skills

  • 6–9 years of professional experience in Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful microservices.
  • Hands-on experience with Angular (v2+) or React.js for front-end development.
  • Solid understanding of design patterns, data structures, and object-oriented principles.
  • Experience working with RDBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL).
  • Proficiency in tools like Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps workflows.
  • Experience deploying applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) is preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to system observability/monitoring tools.
  • Experience in the financial domain or large-scale enterprise systems.
  • Familiarity with unit testing (JUnit/TestNG), E2E testing, and automation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of messaging systems like IBM MQ or Redis Cache.
  • Experience with front-end build tools and performance tuning.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You have 6–9 years of experience in full-stack development with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful microservices.
  • Hands-on experience with modern front-end frameworks like Angular (v2+) or React.js.
  • Solid understanding of design patterns, data structures, and object-oriented principles.
  • Skilled in working with RDBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL) and writing optimized queries.
  • Proficient in DevOps tools such as Git, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines, with experience deploying applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and performance tuning for enterprise applications.
  • Comfortable participating in architectural discussions, mentoring junior developers, and collaborating in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Bonus: Experience with system observability tools, financial domain projects, messaging systems (IBM MQ, Redis), and automated testing frameworks.

Why Join Us

At Ness, you will work with diverse, talented professionals who are dedicated to making an impact through technology. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement, we’d love to connect with you if this role excites you. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates each team member’s unique talents.

With flexible remote options, diverse projects, and access to development resources, joining Ness means building a career that’s meaningful and impactful.

What to Expect Next

We believe great experiences start with transparency—and that includes our hiring process. Here’s what you can typically expect after you hit "Apply":

1. HR Interview – A conversation to get to know you better and align on expectations.
2. Technical Interview – A chance to showcase your skills and experience.
3. Client Interview – Ensuring mutual fit between you and the client team.
4. Offer Stage – If everything aligns, we’ll be happy to make it official.

While many of our roles involve just 2–3 steps, some client processes may include additional conversations. Regardless of the path, we aim to keep every step transparent and respectful of your time.

Ready to Start Your Journey?

jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

Join a collaborative development team working on a SCADA system used by dispatchers around the clock to balance a power perimeter across Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands. The platform is being expanded to cover a wider geographical area and to integrate additional smaller, flexible assets.

The team develops tools for the real-time control of power plants, the integration of flexibility assets and compliance with European grid codes in support of the energy transition. These tools are used to:

  • Monitor production assets and the available capacity of power plants.
  • Exchange information between TSOs and the real-time SCADA system, or Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition system.
  • Calculate real-time setpoints for power plants based on the production plan, real-time acquisition and other inputs such as FCR, aFRR and mFRR, helping to keep the power perimeter in balance.

FCR stands for Frequency Containment Reserve, aFRR for Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserve and mFRR for Manual Frequency Restoration Reserve. Similar balancing mechanisms are used in other countries.

As part of the development team, you will:

  • Develop and maintain the Hitachi Energy MicroSCADA X SYS600 platform, including custom logic and algorithms for real-time automated decision-making.
  • Write and maintain back-end logic in SCIL, the native language of the SCADA platform.
  • Design and develop clear, responsive web interfaces for dispatchers using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript or TypeScript within the MicroSCADA framework.
  • Work with Git and contribute to the further development of the SCADA landscape through ongoing projects.
  • Apply architectural design and software craftsmanship principles such as SOLID, DRY, KISS and YAGNI to create scalable, clean, maintainable and resilient code.
  • Collaborate in an Agile environment with analysts, dispatchers and technical teams.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to reduce repetitive work, generate tests, document code and understand unfamiliar parts of the code base, including during incident investigations. You remain responsible for the design and quality of the resulting work.
  • After a full onboarding, take part in a shared, compensated on-call rotation that is mostly remote, helping to ensure system availability and grid stability. Critical incidents are handled with support from the team.

Previous SCIL knowledge is not required. You will receive training and coaching from the team, and the skills you develop can be applied beyond this specific platform.

📝 Your profile

  • You have relevant experience in an industrial OT environment.
  • You are fluent in spoken and written English. This is essential for the role.
  • You care about building reliable software and systems.

💼 Offer

You will be part of a growing Belgian SME where initiative and personal development are encouraged. We will provide you with an enjoyable work environment with fun colleagues. We will work out a career plan with you, with attention and a budget for extra education/certification. You can count on an attractive salary, supplemented with extra-legal benefits, including a company car.

(Freelance is also possible)

Lead a team of engineers and data scientists building AI that runs in real mines and processing plants, and help define what an AI-native way of building software looks like.

About IntelliSense.io

At IntelliSense.io, we are pioneering the future of industrial decision intelligence. Our platform is trusted by Tier 1 and Tier 2 global mining leaders and cutting-edge secondary metal recycling operations.

We combine digital twins of individual industrial processes with AI agents for machines and humans, including role-specific solutions like a "Digital Metallurgist" or "Digital Geologist", predictive ambient agents, and a 24/7 site memory that survives shift changes and staff turnover. As an AI-first company, we harness intelligence across everything we do to cut time-to-value and scale rapidly.

Our Product Teams combine software engineers and data scientists, working alongside mining domain experts and embedded QA. As a Technology Team Lead, you lead one of these teams: you own how it delivers, how well it ships and how its people grow. Our senior engineers and data scientists shape the architecture; your job is to make sure the team has the clarity, cadence and culture to do its best work, with AI coding agents and modern tooling built into everyday practice and human judgement firmly in the loop.

A short call with our People team, a technical and leadership interview, a meeting with the team, and a final meeting with the CEO. All stages can be held online. We aim to complete the process within 8 weeks.

We want our teams to reflect the range of people who use and are affected by our technology. We welcome applications from everyone and will make reasonable adjustments at any stage: just tell us what you need. If you meet most, but not all, of the essentials, we would still like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our tech team and help build the future of neuro-contextual advertising at global scale.

Who We Are

At Seedtag, our mission is to transform advertising by proving that effectiveness and user privacy can truly coexist.

As the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company, we combine Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and neuroscience to understand not only what content is about, but how it makes people feel and what they intend to do next.

Our proprietary AI, Liz, enables brands to connect with audiences across the open web and Connected TV without cookies or user tracking. Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown to 500+ Seedtaggers in 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and operates today as a global ad-tech leader.

If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building AI-driven systems at scale, you’ll feel right at home here.

Your Challenge

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will:

  • Collaborate with engineering teams at Seedtag to set direction and build platforms that enhance customer experience, while providing necessary operational support.

  • Contribute to the professional growth and performance optimization of the Platform Engineering (SRE) team by offering helpful feedback and guidance.

  • Foster and cultivate trust within the SRE team, empowering them to implement solid engineering practices and principles.

  • Ensure reliability, security and compliance of Seedtag's cloud foundations, aligned with the Google Cloud Architecture Framework and NIST/ISO controls (logging, vulnerability and secrets management, hardening, backup and restore).

  • Design, build and operate the internal developer platform (GKE, networking, IAM, CI/CD, GitOps) so product teams can ship autonomously under a "you build it, you run it" model.

  • Share knowledge, review peers' work and raise the bar on engineering practices in the team.

  • Take part in the Platform on-call rotation, lead incident response and write blameless postmortems, turning recurring issues into automation and lasting fixes.

  • Partner with engineering teams to understand their needs and communicate roadmap, trade-offs and progress transparently.

  • Operate and evolve our streaming and data infrastructure (Redpanda and self-hosted databases), including migrations, upgrades and the discontinuation of legacy components.

  • Own the observability stack (VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, alerting, PagerDuty), tackling scalability problems such as high-cardinality metrics, and define SLIs/SLOs and a service maturity model with engineering teams.

  • Drive cost efficiency (FinOps): capacity planning, node and instance right-sizing, quota management and cost anomaly detection.

  • Reduce toil and enable self-service: replace tickets with tools, golden paths and reusable CI/CD workflows, and keep documentation and runbooks fresh.

  • Apply AI to platform operations: build and operate agents and automations (e.g. cost anomaly detection, PR review, incident triage), define MCP integrations, and contribute to AI governance with Security.

Our Core Values

Outcome over Output
We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code.

Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must
Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast.

We Are All Scouts
We take ownership and leave things better than we found them.

We Are Data-Driven
Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results.

Tech Stack

Our stack includes:

  • Languages & Automation: Python, Go

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, Terraform Cloud

  • CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD

  • Observability: VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, PagerDuty

  • Streaming & Data: Redpanda, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis

  • Security & Networking: IAM, VPC, Cloudflare, secrets management

  • AI & Automation: LLM-based agents, MCP integrations

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Technical Experience: Minimum of 4 years of experience in SRE/DevOps/Platform/Cloud Engineering roles, preferably in large-scale, high-traffic product companies, with proven technical proficiency and the ability to engage in deep technical conversations with the team.

  • Collaboration and Prioritization: Service-oriented mindset: understands stakeholders' problems, communicates clearly and prioritizes across several concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment. Experience with Kanban or Scrum.

  • Automation and Programming: Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Go or similar) to automate operations and build internal tooling (operators, agents, CI/CD workflows).

  • Cloud Services: Deep hands-on knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or an equivalent hyperscaler (VPC and peering/PSC, IAM, GKE, CloudSQL, GCS), including networking and migrations between projects or organizations.

  • Incident Management and On-call Responsibilities: Proven on-call and incident management experience, with strong problem-solving skills under pressure and a track record of root-cause analysis and blameless postmortems.

jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
